Second, it operationalizes the principle of metric independence: re-scoring with execution-level assertions that share no code with the training-side feature extractor reveals that self-referential evaluation substantially overstates conditioning benefit. This methodological lesson applies broadly to evaluation design for conditional generation tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: CADCON is a five-feature binary design-intent header (CIRCLE, NGON, THIN, TALL, MULTI_PART) prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs (transpiled from DeepCAD histories). Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B is LoRA-fine-tuned under this conditioning. Two methodological innovations carry the study: (1) Metric independence—adherence is re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid, sharing no code with the training-side regex extractor used to build header labels. The full evaluation matrix ({0%, 40%} prefix × {correct, wrong, masked} header × 3 seeds × both tokenizations) and all decision rules are pre-registered before scoring. (2) Causal control—a derangement-trained control group receives shuffled ground-truth headers (each program gets another program's header), so the header marginal distribution is byte-identical to standard training but the header↔program correlation is destroyed. If the control shows no performance drop under wrong headers, the harm can be attributed to the learned header→program mapping rather than a mechanical distribution-shift confound.
summary_en.experiments: Four key findings: (1) A semantically wrong header hurts more than no header. In the 40%-prefix conditional completion regime, wrong headers degrade geometric adherence from 0.425 to 0.305 (text headers) / 0.215 (token headers), direction-unanimous across three seeds and both tokenizations (token-side p ≤ 8e-4 per seed, ~1e-5 for two seeds). The effect survives on the valid-geometry subset, ruling out a validity artifact. (2) The harm requires the learned header→program mapping. The derangement-trained control remains competent but shows no correct→wrong drop, while the standard model drops sharply. The control produces identical geometric feature sets under correct and wrong headers on 71–98% of jointly-executable outputs, versus 35–43% for the standard model. The interaction is significant on 3/3 seeds (p = 4.2e-3 / 6.7e-6 / 3.6e-6). (3) The independent metric deflates conditioning benefit. The apparent gain of a correct header shrinks substantially relative to the regex metric (text +31% vs +52% relative; token +4% vs +46%), quantifying metric circularity in conditioning claims. (4) The harm is regime-specific. At 0% prefix the unconditional baseline cannot produce valid CAD at all (0/100 executable), so "wrong < none" is undefined and does not hold there.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~20–30 minutes. Focus on §1 for the crisp framing of the three unexamined questions, and §3 for the derangement-control experimental design—this is the most methodologically valuable part of the paper. Figure 1 and §4.4's argument for ruling out the marginal-distribution confound are worth careful reading. For pretraining researchers, the takeaway is the diagnostic framework (conditioning success can be partly metric circularity, and wrong conditioning can be actively harmful) rather than the CAD domain specifics.

recommendation.zh: 因果控制+独立可执行metric的评测协议可直接复用在LLM条件微调/SFT的能力诊断中，只看§3实验设计和核心结果表即可。
recommendation.en: Clean causal evaluation protocol with independent executable metric is directly reusable for diagnosing LLM conditional fine-tuning/SFT; read §3 and core result tables only.

paper.title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs
paper.abstract: Parametric retrieval enables LLMs to retrieve tools implicitly by assigning each API a unique virtual token and training the model to generate it via constrained beam search. Toolsense shows that this regime has two critical drawbacks: it destroys parametric tool knowledge during training, and its beam-search decoding is too slow for real-time deployment. We introduce TRACE (Tool Retrieval via Augmented Chain-of-thought and Enterprise rules), a two-stage curriculum that resolves this dissociatio

summary.core_problem: 参数化工具检索方法在训练时会破坏模型已有的参数化工具知识，且依赖的束搜索解码延迟过高，无法满足企业实时部署需求。
summary.importance: 方法改进，提出两阶段推理课程训练方案，在保留工具知识的同时实现单束贪婪解码，降低部署延迟。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段课程训练：第一阶段复用ToolSense的多格式记忆SFT，通过LoRA植入工具知识；第二阶段训练模型在生成工具token的JSON列表前输出思维轨迹，训练数据包含ToolSense的RRB对和基于领域专家业务规则合成的查询，均增强推理轨迹标注。
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型参数量与数据集规模，以ToolSense为baseline，训练后保留了第一阶段的MCQ和QA探测精度，同时支持单束贪婪解码。

summary_en.core_problem: Parametric tool retrieval methods destroy existing parametric tool knowledge during training, and their beam-search decoding has too high latency for real-time enterprise deployment.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement proposing a two-stage reasoning curriculum that preserves tool knowledge while enabling single-beam greedy decoding for lower deployment latency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage curriculum training: Stage 1 reuses ToolSense's multi-format memorization SFT to seed tool knowledge via LoRA; Stage 2 trains the model to emit a thinking trace before generating a JSON list of tool tokens, using RRB pairs from ToolSense and queries synthesized from domain expert-curated business rules, both augmented with reasoning traces.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model size or dataset scale disclosed; compared to ToolSense baseline, the method preserves Stage 1 MCQ and QA probing accuracy while enabling single-beam greedy decoding.

recommendation.zh: 企业场景的工具检索SFT课程方案，思路可参考但通用性较弱，仅扫读摘要了解参数化工具检索的训练痛点即可。
recommendation.en: Enterprise-focused SFT curriculum for tool retrieval with limited generalizability; skim the abstract only to understand training pain points of parametric tool retrieval.

paper.title: The Intruder Threshold: A Spectral Law for LoRA Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: LoRA fine-tuning can create intruder dimensions: new leading singular vectors of the updated weight matrix $W+BA$ that are nearly orthogonal to all pretrained singular vectors and that drive catastrophic forgetting. Since their discovery, no theory has predicted, layer by layer on measured spectra, when they appear. We derive a per-layer critical update strength $s^\ast=\barθ/(γσ_1(BA))$, computed from the measured spectrum of $W$ alone through the rectangular spiked-deformation transform, toget

summary.core_problem: LoRA微调会产生“入侵者维度”——更新后权重矩阵的新增顶奇异向量几乎与所有预训练奇异向量正交，是灾难性遗忘的主要驱动因素，但此前没有理论能够仅基于实测的预训练谱，逐层预测入侵者维度出现的更新强度阈值。
summary.importance: 为LoRA微调中的遗忘预测与控制提供了仅需测量预训练权重谱的原则性框架，对持续预训练、领域适配、LLM参数高效适配的实践有直接指导意义。逐层阈值无需训练数据或参数拟合，可直接接入现有微调流程。
summary.technical_approach: 基于矩形尖峰变形理论推导出逐层临界更新强度s* = θ̄/(γσ₁(BA))，其中θ̄是仅由预训练权重谱计算得到的普适临界尖峰强度，无拟合参数。提出了更新后谱的精确secular方程刻画，以及一种低维核心矩阵SVD方法，无需对大矩阵做全量SVD即可计算更新后奇异向量与预训练基的重叠。还发现训练得到的adapter存在“反对齐偏差”，导致入侵者出现的时间比通用位置预测早1.2-1.5倍。
summary.experiments: 在4个稠密Transformer家族、状态空间模型、混合专家模型、编码器-解码器模型上完成了预注册验证：82.2%的层的阈值预测误差在2倍以内；遗忘拐点与逐层中位数阈值的预测位置一致；范数匹配的因果干预显示，超临界层的遗忘量最高可达亚临界层的240倍；无投影的逐层预算规则在最脆弱的模型上减少了62%的遗忘，且无任务性能损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先快速浏览第2节的核心阈值公式和第3节的预注册验证结果，如无随机矩阵理论的专门研究需求，可跳过详细的谱理论推导。预计阅读时间30-45分钟。若关注遗忘控制的实践方法，可重点看第4节的干预实验和逐层预算规则。

summary_en.core_problem: LoRA fine-tuning produces "intruder dimensions" — top singular vectors of the updated weight matrix that are nearly orthogonal to all pretrained singular vectors and drive catastrophic forgetting. No prior theory can predict, layer by layer from measured pretrained spectra alone, at what update strength these intruders emerge.
summary_en.importance: Provides a principled, measurement-only framework for predicting and controlling forgetting in LoRA fine-tuning, with direct practical relevance to continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and parameter-efficient adaptation of LLMs. The per-layer threshold requires no training data or fitting, and can be directly integrated into existing fine-tuning pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Derives a per-layer critical update strength s* = θ̄/(γσ₁(BA)) using rectangular spiked-deformation theory, where θ̄ is a universal critical spike strength computed solely from the pretrained weight spectrum with no fitted parameters. Develops an exact secular equation characterization of the updated spectrum, and a low-dimensional core matrix SVD method to compute overlaps between updated singular vectors and the pretrained basis without full large-matrix SVD. Identifies an "anti-alignment bias" in trained adapters that causes intruders to emerge 1.2–1.5× earlier than the generic-position prediction.
summary_en.experiments: Pre-registered validation across four dense Transformer families, a state-space model, a mixture-of-experts model, and an encoder-decoder model: threshold predictions are within a factor of 2 for 82.2% of layers; forgetting knees align with median per-layer threshold predictions; norm-matched causal interventions show supercritical layers carry up to 240× more forgetting than subcritical layers; a projection-free per-layer budget rule cuts forgetting by 62% on the most fragile model with no task performance cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 2 (core threshold formula) and Section 3 (pre-registered validation results) first; skip detailed spectral theory derivations unless you have specific research interest in random matrix theory applications to LLMs. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes. For practical forgetting control methods, focus on Section 4's intervention experiments and per-layer budget rule.

recommendation.zh: LoRA intruder维度的闭式阈值推导扎实，跨7类架构验证，做PEFT的直接可用，预训练侧可参考权重谱稳定性结论
recommendation.en: Closed-form threshold for LoRA intruder dimensions is rigorously derived and validated across 7 architecture families; directly usable for PEFT design and pretrained weight spectrum analysis

paper.title: Data Quality over Capacity: Internalizing Documents into LoRA Adapters for Closed-Book QA
paper.abstract: We study baking documents directly into the weights of a 4-bit Gemma-4-e4b model via LoRA, so a system can answer questions about a corpus closed-book: no retrieval and no context-window budget. Across roughly 100 training runs from single documents to a 99-document corpus, we find that once adapter capacity is adequate, training-data quality is the dominant lever on closed-book accuracy, outweighing LoRA rank, learning rate, and two alternative architectures combined; capacity itself is a hard

summary.core_problem: 在 closed-book QA 场景下，把文档知识直接写入 LoRA adapter 时，决定效果的主要因素究竟是参数容量还是训练数据质量。
summary.importance: 贡献更像一个小规模、受控的经验分析：它不是预训练论文，但对“知识内化”“参数容量门槛”“数据质量优先级”这些问题给出了一些可操作信号。对研究 pretrain↔post-train 接口的人有边缘参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 4-bit Gemma-4-e4b 上做约 100 次 LoRA 训练，从单文档扩展到 99 文档语料，系统比较 LoRA rank、学习率、两种替代架构与数据清洗策略。核心发现是：容量不足时任何数据改进都无效；一旦容量过门槛，训练数据质量成为主导因素。作者还发现 rank 与学习率存在耦合，早期曾误判其作用。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Gemma-4-e4b 4-bit 模型，任务是闭卷回答给定文档语料的问题。摘要给出的关键结果是：在 15 文档语料上，仅做一次数据整理——把 gold answer 压缩为 1-6 词 canonical span 并去掉 trivia——准确率从 57.7% 提升到 85.7%；内部化 adapter 在 15 文档切片上达到 84.2%，接近检索基线。实验规模不大，外推到大模型预训练需谨慎。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者，工作更像小规模受控实验笔记，而非大规模工业级结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether adapter capacity or training-data quality is the main driver when baking documents into LoRA weights for closed-book QA.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it offers a useful controlled study on knowledge internalization, capacity thresholds, and the relative value of data curation. It is mildly relevant for researchers thinking about the pretrain–post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using a 4-bit Gemma-4-e4b model, the author runs around 100 LoRA training experiments from single-document to 99-document corpora, varying LoRA rank, learning rate, two alternative architectures, and data curation. The main claim is that capacity is a hard gate, but once capacity is sufficient, data quality dominates.
summary_en.experiments: The setup uses closed-book QA over document corpora. The headline result is that on a 15-document subset, a single curation pass—short canonical answer spans and removal of trivia—raises accuracy from 57.7% to 85.7%, larger than any architectural tweak. The internalized adapter reaches 84.2%, close to a retrieval baseline. The scale is small, so extrapolation should be cautious.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher, and the work reads more like a careful small-scale empirical note than a large-lab foundation-model study.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“容量是硬门槛、过线后数据质量压过结构改动”这个结论值得记；只看实验表和数据清洗细节即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that capacity is a hard gate and data quality dominates after that is worth keeping; read the tables and the curation details, not the whole thing.

paper.title: IFCLoRA: Topology-Aware Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models, but its performance depends strongly on how a fixed rank budget is distributed across Transformer modules. Existing adaptive-rank methods usually rely on local gradient statistics collected during training, which introduces extra memory and computation and overlooks task-conditioned global information flow. We propose IFCLoRA, a topology-aware rank allocation method applied before fine-t

summary.core_problem: LoRA 在固定总 rank 预算下如何分配到不同 Transformer 模块，会显著影响微调效果；现有 adaptive-rank 方法多依赖训练中的局部梯度统计，额外开销较高，也忽略跨模块信息流。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是参数高效微调方法改进。它不直接推进预训练，但用冻结模型和校准集估计模块适配重要性，对理解后训练中哪些模块承载任务变化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IFCLoRA，在微调前一次性完成 topology-aware rank allocation。方法用小校准集和冻结预训练模型构建稀疏的 task-conditioned interaction graph，图节点对应可插入 LoRA 的模块；再结合全局 information-flow topology prior 与局部 gradient sensitivity，计算 Information-Flow Centrality，用 multi-hop propagation 估计模块适配重要性，并在全局 rank 预算下分配各模块 rank。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个模型、任务和低 rank 设置下验证 IFCLoRA，但未给出模型参数量、任务列表、baseline 名称或提升幅度。核心对比应包括均匀 rank LoRA 和依赖训练时梯度统计的 adaptive-rank 方法。

summary_en.core_problem: LoRA performance depends strongly on how a fixed rank budget is allocated across Transformer modules; existing adaptive-rank methods often rely on local gradient statistics during training and ignore global task-conditioned information flow.
summary_en.importance: This is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. It does not directly advance pretraining, but its frozen-model calibration approach is useful for diagnosing which modules carry task adaptation signals during post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes IFCLoRA, a topology-aware rank allocation method performed once before fine-tuning. With a small calibration set and a frozen pretrained model, it builds a sparse task-conditioned interaction graph whose nodes are LoRA-compatible modules. It combines a global information-flow topology prior with local gradient sensitivity to compute Information-Flow Centrality, estimating module importance under multi-hop propagation, then assigns ranks under a global budget.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that IFCLoRA is evaluated across multiple models, tasks, and low-rank settings, but does not provide parameter counts, task names, baseline details, or effect sizes. The key comparisons are expected to include uniform-rank LoRA and adaptive-rank methods based on training-time gradient statistics.

recommendation.zh: 只看 rank 分配公式和消融即可；若提升主要来自校准集选择，它更像 PEFT 工程调参而非模块机制结论。
recommendation.en: Read only the rank-allocation formula and ablations; if gains hinge on calibration-set choice, this is PEFT tuning rather than a module-mechanism result.

paper.title: Procedural Knowledge Is Not Low-Rank: Why LoRA Fails to Internalize Multi-Step Procedures
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA have become the default for adapting large language models, succeeding across instruction following, style transfer, and factual adaptation. We show that for procedural knowledge--the ability to follow multi-step procedures with conditional branching through to terminal states--LoRA fails to match full fine-tuning at the ranks where it retains its efficiency advantage. In a systematic ablation (r = 16--128) on a procedural travel booking task (14

summary.core_problem: 研究 LoRA 在需要多步流程、条件分支和终止状态跟踪的程序性知识任务上，为什么不能接近全量微调。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练机制分析。它把 LoRA 的常见成功边界从风格、事实和指令适配，推进到更难的程序内化场景，指出低秩更新可能不足以写入复杂状态机式知识。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造程序性对话任务，对不同 LoRA rank 做系统消融，并与全量微调对比。重点不是提出新 PEFT 方法，而是用受控流程任务检验低秩适配是否能学习多步条件过程。
summary.experiments: 主实验是 14 个节点的旅行预订流程任务，LoRA rank 覆盖 r=16 到 r=128。所有 LoRA 配置任务成功分数不超过 2.54，而全量微调达到 4.11，差异显著；同时 LoRA 仍保持 95% 到 99% 的对话完成率，说明失败不只是拒答或中断。作者还在 Zoom 支持 14 节点和保险理赔 55 节点任务上用 8B 模型复现，LoRA 在 r=32 和 r=128 下平均落后全量微调 0.8 到 2.2 分，复杂流程差距最大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why LoRA fails to match full fine-tuning when a model must internalize multi-step procedures with branching and terminal-state tracking.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis of post-training limits. It sharpens the boundary of LoRA’s success: style, factual, and instruction adaptation do not imply reliable acquisition of state-machine-like procedural knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors run controlled procedural dialogue tasks and sweep LoRA ranks against full fine-tuning. The contribution is diagnostic rather than a new PEFT algorithm: it tests whether low-rank updates can encode conditional multi-step procedures.
summary_en.experiments: The main travel-booking task has 14 procedural nodes and evaluates LoRA ranks from 16 to 128. LoRA stays at or below 2.54 task-success score versus 4.11 for full fine-tuning, with statistically significant gaps, despite 95–99% conversation completion rates. The result is replicated on 14-node Zoom support and 55-node insurance-claims procedures with 8B models, where LoRA trails full fine-tuning by 0.8–2.2 points on average at ranks 32 and 128, with the largest gap on the most complex procedure.

recommendation.zh: 结论不够到 must-read，但“完成率高、流程成功低”的拆分值得记住，PEFT 评测别只看表面对话指标。
recommendation.en: Not a must-read, but the completion-versus-procedure-success split is a useful warning against shallow PEFT evaluations.

paper.title: Scaling Laws for Hypernetwork-Based Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Injecting factual knowledge into large language models (LLMs) reliably and at scale remains an open challenge. Hypernetworks provide a promising solution to large-scale knowledge injection. Although hypernetworks are typically applied for test-time adaptation, we explore their use in train-time knowledge injection, where, given a large corpus of facts, we train a hypernetwork to generate a fixed LoRA adapter that, when inserted into the target model, enable the model to answer questions about th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是一般意义上的知识编辑，而是更接近“训练时知识内化”：给定一个固定事实库 Ω，用一个超网络把这批事实压缩成目标模型可插拔的固定 LoRA 适配器，并要求模型在推理时不再访问原始事实库。核心问题有两个。第一，超网络做大规模知识注入到底能不能稳定工作，而不是只在小规模编辑场景里有效。第二，这种能力如何随超网络宽度、深度、目标模型规模、注入事实数量而变化，是否存在可预测的 scaling law，以及它与 LoRA 微调、全量微调相比在 ID 与 OOD 上各自处于什么位置。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在三个层面。其一，它把“参数化知识写入”从单点编辑推进到可规模化研究对象，并且给出了较完整的缩放刻画，这对 continual pretrain、domain adaptation、私有知识内化都有参考价值。其二，它把比较重点放在 OOD 泛化而不是只看训练域记忆率，结论是：随着目标模型变大，超网络方案的 OOD scaling 更陡，这一点比单纯比较最终精度更有信息量。其三，它提供了一个可控 benchmark——MegaWikiQA，用 Wikidata5M 构造单跳和多跳问答，并显式区分 OOD split，这使“知识注入”不再只是零散案例，而可以像预训练 recipe 一样做系统实验。贡献量级上，它更像一篇把问题定义清楚、把实验轴搭完整的研究，而不是直接给出新的通用最优方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计的关键是把“注入容量”与“目标模型容量”解耦。具体做法是：先把待注入事实库表示为结构化事实集合，再由一个 transformer 型超网络读取这些事实表示，输出一组固定的 LoRA 权重；这些 LoRA 插入到冻结的目标语言模型中，形成一个针对该事实库的适配版本。这里超网络并不是按样本在线生成权重，而是在训练阶段学习一种从事实库到适配器的映射，因此研究对象是 train-time compression，而不是常见的 test-time editing。

从建模角度看，这个设计有几个值得注意的点。第一，它避免直接改动 base model 参数，因此天然绕开一部分 catastrophic forgetting 问题；同时，注入知识被限制在 adapter 子空间里，便于分析容量瓶颈。第二，作者刻意把超网络规模、目标模型规模、事实数量分开扫描，这样可以区分“是 target LM 不够会用这些知识”，还是“是 hypernetwork 不够会写这些知识”。第三，论文强调超网络生成的是固定 LoRA，而不是 query-conditioned adapter，这意味着它考察的是知识压缩质量，而不是检索增强或条件计算能力。

与 LoRA 微调、全量微调相比，差异不在于参数量省多少，而在于训练机制不同。微调方法直接优化目标模型或其低秩增量去拟合 QA 任务，容易把训练分布模式也一并写入；超网络则先学习“如何把事实库编码成参数更新”，更像在学习一个 knowledge-to-weights 编译器。论文的一个核心观察是：在 ID 上，微调略占优；但在 unseen entities、unseen relations、多跳组合等 OOD 设置下，超网络的泛化随 target model scale 提升更快。这说明超网络学到的不只是记忆事实对，而是某种更结构化的参数化映射。

论文还分析了深度与宽度扩展。结论是两者带来的收益大致可比，没有明显哪一项更优；而扩大目标模型通常比扩大超网络更有效。这一点很重要，因为它说明瓶颈往往不在“写入器”本身，而在“被写入的语言模型是否有足够表达能力去消费这些 adapter”。如果这个结论成立，那么后续工作在预算固定时，优先把算力放在 target LM 而不是一味堆 hypernetwork，通常更划算。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖四条主轴：超网络宽度、超网络深度、目标模型大小、注入事实数量。文中给出的超网络规模范围约为 167M 到 2.8B 参数，这是这篇工作最有分量的部分之一，因为它不是只做一个小模型可行性验证。数据方面，MegaWikiQA 从 Wikidata5M 抽取 subject-relation-object 三元组，构造可控的单跳与多跳 QA，并设置显式 OOD 划分，用来测试未见实体、未见关系以及组合泛化。

关键结果可以概括为四点。第一，超网络知识注入呈现平滑、可预测的缩放趋势，没有参数编辑类方法常见的尖锐失效区间。第二，扩深和扩宽都有效，但边际收益会递减，而且两者收益量级接近。第三，扩大目标模型比扩大超网络带来的收益更大，尤其在泛化指标上更明显。第四，与 LoRA 微调和全量微调相比，超网络在 ID 验证集上通常只是相当或略弱，但在三个 OOD split 上 scaling slope 更陡，并且这种优势会随着 target model 变大而扩大。

从消融角度，最值得注意的不是某个单点数字，而是相对趋势：微调方法在训练分布内更容易把事实“背下来”，但当问题需要跨实体、跨关系或多跳组合时，超网络生成的 adapter 更稳。这暗示超网络可能更接近“把知识结构写进参数”，而不是“把问答映射拟合进参数”。如果你关心 continual pretrain 或私域知识内化，这个差异比绝对分数更重要。

摘要中没有给出完整表格数字，现有全文片段能确认的硬数字主要是超网络参数范围 167M–2.8B，以及 benchmark 基于 Wikidata5M、支持百万级事实扩展。若要抓具体提升幅度，需要重点看 Section 5.3、5.5、5.6 和 Table 1、相关 scaling fit 图。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但不要只看引言和结论。建议先看 Section 3，弄清 MegaWikiQA 的构造方式、OOD split 定义、多跳问题是如何确定性生成的。这个部分决定了后面结果是否可信。然后看 Section 4.2 的方法图，理解超网络输入是什么、输出哪些 LoRA 权重、target LM 哪些部分被冻结。接着重点看 Section 5.3 和 Table 1，那里回答“扩 hypernetwork 还是扩 target model”这个最实际的问题。最后看 Section 5.5 和 5.6，比对 hypernetwork、LoRA finetune、full finetune 在 ID/OOD 上的 scaling 曲线。

阅读时建议带着三个问题。第一，作者是否真正控制住了训练 token、adapter rank、目标模型容量这些混杂因素。第二，OOD split 是否足够干净，尤其 unseen relation 与 compositional split 有没有被模板泄漏。第三，超网络方案的优势究竟来自更好的知识压缩，还是来自训练目标与 benchmark 更匹配。预计 40–60 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要复现实验设计，数据构造和 scaling fit 细节需要再花一轮时间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies train-time knowledge internalization rather than standard test-time editing. Given a fixed fact corpus Ω, a hypernetwork is trained to compress those facts into a fixed LoRA adapter for a frozen target LM, and the adapted model must answer questions without any inference-time access to Ω. The core questions are: can hypernetworks support reliable large-scale knowledge injection beyond small editing settings, and how does this ability scale with hypernetwork width, depth, target model size, and the number of injected facts? A second question is comparative: how does this mechanism behave against LoRA finetuning and full finetuning on both in-distribution and OOD generalization?
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is not that it proposes a universally better adaptation method, but that it turns parametric knowledge injection into a scaling-law problem with controlled axes. That matters for continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and private-corpus internalization, where retrieval may be undesirable or unavailable. A particularly useful contribution is the emphasis on OOD scaling rather than only memorization on held-out IID QA. The reported pattern is that hypernetwork-based injection scales more favorably on OOD splits as the target LM grows. The release of MegaWikiQA also matters: it provides a structured benchmark with deterministic multi-hop QA and explicit OOD partitions, which makes this line of work easier to study systematically instead of through isolated editing case studies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main design choice is to decouple injection capacity from target-model capacity. A transformer hypernetwork consumes representations of a fact corpus and outputs a fixed set of LoRA weights, which are then inserted into a frozen target LM. This is not a query-conditioned adapter generator and not a retrieval pipeline. The object of study is a train-time mapping from facts to weights, so the method is closer to corpus compression into parameters.

This setup has several implications. First, the base LM is not directly updated, which reduces the usual catastrophic-forgetting concerns associated with finetuning. Second, because the injected knowledge is constrained to live in an adapter subspace, the capacity bottleneck becomes easier to analyze. Third, by scaling hypernetwork size and target LM size separately, the paper can ask whether failures come from an insufficient “writer” or from an insufficient “reader”.

Compared with LoRA finetuning and full finetuning, the difference is not mainly parameter efficiency. Finetuning directly optimizes the target model or its low-rank increments on QA supervision. The hypernetwork instead learns a knowledge-to-weights mapping, effectively a compiler from a fact set to an adapter. The central empirical claim is that finetuning is slightly better on in-distribution validation, but hypernetwork-generated adapters improve more steeply on OOD splits as target model scale increases. That suggests the hypernetwork is learning a more structured parameterization of knowledge rather than only fitting question-answer associations.

The paper also studies depth-vs-width scaling of the hypernetwork. The reported result is that increasing depth and width yields broadly comparable gains, while scaling the target LM is substantially more effective than scaling the hypernetwork. This is an important practical takeaway: under a fixed budget, the main bottleneck may be the target model’s ability to use the injected adapter, not the hypernetwork’s ability to emit it.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments sweep four axes: hypernetwork width, hypernetwork depth, target LM size, and the number of injected facts. Hypernetwork sizes range from roughly 167M to 2.8B parameters, which is large enough to make the scaling analysis meaningful rather than anecdotal. The benchmark, MegaWikiQA, is built from Wikidata5M subject-relation-object triples and supports deterministic single-hop and multi-hop QA, together with explicit OOD splits for unseen entities, unseen relations, and compositional generalization.

The main findings are fourfold. First, hypernetwork-based knowledge injection shows smooth and predictable scaling, unlike the sharp failure modes often seen in parametric editing. Second, scaling depth and width both helps, with similar gain profiles and diminishing returns. Third, scaling the target LM is more beneficial than scaling the hypernetwork, especially for generalization. Fourth, compared with LoRA finetuning and full finetuning, the hypernetwork is usually comparable or slightly weaker on in-distribution validation, but exhibits steeper OOD scaling across all three OOD splits, and the gap grows with target model size.

The most informative ablation is not a single headline number but the trend difference. Finetuning methods are better at fitting the training distribution, while hypernetwork-generated adapters are more robust when the evaluation requires unseen entities, unseen relations, or multi-hop composition. That pattern is more relevant than raw accuracy if one cares about continual pretraining or domain knowledge internalization.

From the available full-text excerpt, the hard numbers we can confirm are the hypernetwork scale range of 167M–2.8B and the use of Wikidata5M-derived MegaWikiQA with million-scale fact coverage. For exact gains and fitted exponents, the key places to inspect are Section 5.3, Sections 5.5–5.6, Table 1, and the scaling plots.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it still deserves more than the abstract. Start with Section 3 to understand how MegaWikiQA is constructed, how the OOD splits are defined, and how multi-hop questions are generated deterministically. Then read the method overview around Section 4.2 and Figure 1 to see what the hypernetwork takes as input and which LoRA weights it emits. After that, go directly to Section 5.3 and Table 1 for the practical question of whether to scale the hypernetwork or the target LM. Finish with Sections 5.5 and 5.6, where the ID/OOD scaling comparison against LoRA finetuning and full finetuning is made explicit.

Three questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. Did the authors properly control for confounders such as training budget, adapter rank, and target-model capacity? Are the OOD splits genuinely clean, especially for unseen relations and compositional generalization? And is the observed advantage due to better knowledge compression, or partly due to a benchmark that aligns well with the hypernetwork objective? Around 40–60 minutes should be enough to capture the main argument.

recommendation.zh: 看 scaling setup 是否真的解耦 target 能力；若实验干净，LoRA 注入容量曲线可作为 continual pretrain 的弱替代信号。
recommendation.en: Check whether the scaling setup truly decouples target capability; if clean, the LoRA injection-capacity curves are a useful weak proxy for continual-pretrain studies.

paper.title: LAARA: Layer-Aware Adaptive Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation is widely used for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, yet existing methods typically assign the same adapter rank to every transformer layer despite their heterogeneous adaptation requirements. In this work, we show theoretically and empirically that uniform rank allocation is fundamentally suboptimal. Motivated by this observation, we propose LAARA (Layer Aware Adaptive Rank Allocation framework), a search-free framework that dynamically allocates ranks using lightweight diago

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类参数高效微调方法中各 Transformer 层使用统一 rank 的问题；论文认为不同层、不同投影矩阵的适配需求并不相同。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练阶段的 PEFT 方法改进。它不改变预训练范式，但对大模型微调成本控制有参考意义，尤其是用训练中信号动态分配 adapter 容量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LAARA，一个无需搜索的 layer-aware adaptive rank allocation 框架。方法用轻量 diagonal Fisher estimate 估计 adapter 重要性，并结合 projection-wise normalization、logarithmic compression、blended importance estimation 和 vote-to-change dampening，使 rank 调整更稳定。
summary.experiments: 在 GLUE 和 MathInstruct 上比较 LoRA、AdaLoRA、DyLoRA、BitFit 等方法。摘要称 LAARA 在更少可训练参数下能匹配或超过这些基线，但未给出模型规模、具体参数节省比例和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the uniform-rank assumption in LoRA-style parameter-efficient fine-tuning, arguing that different Transformer layers and projections require different adaptation capacity.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental but relevant PEFT contribution for post-training. It does not affect pretraining methodology directly, but it is useful for thinking about how adaptation capacity should be allocated under a fixed parameter budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: LAARA is a search-free adaptive rank allocation framework. It uses lightweight diagonal Fisher estimates during training, then stabilizes rank updates through projection-wise normalization, logarithmic compression, blended adapter-importance estimation, and a vote-to-change dampening mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on GLUE and MathInstruct against LoRA, AdaLoRA, DyLoRA, and BitFit. The abstract reports matching or better performance with fewer trainable parameters, but does not expose model scale, exact savings, or absolute gains.

recommendation.zh: PEFT 增量工作；只看 Fisher rank 分配规则即可，别把 GLUE 提升外推到预训练容量分配。
recommendation.en: An incremental PEFT paper; read the Fisher-based rank allocation rule, but do not extrapolate GLUE gains to pretraining capacity allocation.

paper.title: Selective State-Space Adaptation and Retrieval for Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation introduces a static learned update applied identically to every input. The update provides task-level adaptation but does not explicitly represent token-level or instance-level state variation. A family of adapters is proposed that introduces selective state-space recurrence at two complementary granularities. At the token level, \textbf{MaLoRA} (Mamba-modulated low-rank adaptation) makes the adapter's scaling factor a dynamic input-dependent function with recurrent state acr

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类低秩适配器对所有输入使用静态更新、缺少 token 级和实例级状态变化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是适配器架构改进：把 Mamba/选择性状态空间机制引入 LoRA 调制和检索适配，使 frozen backbone 在多跳推理任务上获得动态、输入相关的适配。它对基座预训练不是直接贡献，但对 SSM 与 Transformer 混合适配有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个组件。MaLoRA 在 token 级用 Mamba recurrence 生成输入相关的 adapter scaling factor，使低秩更新随上下文状态变化；MaRA 在 context 级维护跨 segment 状态，并在生成前选择与查询最相关的 segment。两者都服务于冻结语言模型上的动态适配。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 frozen backbone：Qwen-2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B；两个多跳推理 benchmark：MuSiQue 和 2WikiMultihopQA。摘要称 3×2 所有组合均提升，平均 +6.8 F1，约 +10.5% 相对提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of LoRA-style adapters: the learned low-rank update is static and does not explicitly represent token-level or instance-level state variation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an adapter architecture change. It introduces selective state-space recurrence into LoRA modulation and retrieval-style adaptation, giving frozen backbones input-dependent behavior on multi-hop reasoning tasks. It is not a base pretraining method, but it is relevant to SSM-Transformer hybrid adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes two components. MaLoRA uses Mamba recurrence at the token level to produce an input-dependent adapter scaling factor, so the low-rank update changes with recurrent context state. MaRA operates at the context level by tracking cross-segment state and selecting segments most relevant to the query before generation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover three frozen backbones, Qwen-2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Gemma-2-9B, on two multi-hop reasoning benchmarks, MuSiQue and 2WikiMultihopQA. The abstract reports gains in every cell of the 3-by-2 grid, averaging +6.8 F1, or about +10.5% relative.

recommendation.zh: 这是动态 LoRA 的一个干净小信号；看方法图和 3×2 表即可，别把多跳 QA 提升外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: A clean small signal for dynamic LoRA; read the method diagram and 3-by-2 table, but do not extrapolate QA gains to pretraining.

paper.title: PoLoRA: A Preconditioned Orthogonalized LoRA Optimizer
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) makes finetuning large language models cheaper by adding to each weight matrix a trainable low-rank update parameterized as the product of two matrices. These matrices are usually trained with Adam, which treats them as a single flat vector of parameters and ignores both the matrix and product structure of LoRA. Applying a matrix-aware optimizer such as Muon to each factor does not consistently improve over Adam, and neither do the product-aware Muon variants proposed

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 LoRA 优化器没有利用低秩乘积结构的问题。标准做法用 Adam 分别更新 A 和 B，把 LoRA 参数看成扁平向量；直接把 Muon 这类矩阵感知优化器套到两个因子上，也没有稳定收益。论文关注的是：优化器约束应当作用在有效权重更新 BA 上，而不是分别作用在 A、B 两个因子上。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 post-training 和参数高效微调，但对预训练优化研究有参考价值。它把 Muon 的“谱范数约束下的 steepest descent”思想迁移到 LoRA，并指出低秩因子化会改变优化几何。对基座研究员的启发有两点。第一，矩阵感知优化不能机械套用到重参数化后的变量上，优化器需要匹配模型实际看到的有效参数。第二，LoRA rank、scaling、更新幅度之间的耦合会影响调参稳定性，这对大规模 SFT、持续学习和多 adapter 训练有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: PoLoRA 由三个部分组成。第一是 product-aware spectral update direction。论文先回顾 Muon：在谱范数球约束下，对线性化 loss 求最陡下降方向，解是梯度矩阵的 matrix sign，也就是 SVD 的 UV^T。对 LoRA 来说，层实际看到的是 W = W0 + BA。更新 A、B 时，一阶有效更新是 ΔB A + B ΔA，因此谱范数约束应加在这个合并更新上，而不是分别加在 ΔA 和 ΔB 上。这得到 Product Muon 类方向。第二是 curvature preconditioning。论文从控制 per-sample loss change 出发，引入曲率估计，对正交化方向做预条件，使更新不只控制层输出最大变化，也考虑样本损失局部敏感度。第三是 magnitude rule。Product Muon 主要给方向和谱范数界，但没有充分控制因子更新的大小；PoLoRA 额外设置因子更新和合并权重更新的幅度规则，避免低秩乘积的尺度自由度造成不稳定。
summary.experiments: 实验在不同 base model、数据集和 LoRA rank 上比较 PoLoRA、Adam、直接对因子使用 Muon，以及 product-aware Muon 变体。论文报告 PoLoRA 相比调好的 Adam，达到相同 held-out loss 需要的 step 数减少 1.2–1.7 倍，每步额外开销不超过 3%。在 Llama-3.2-1B 的数学微调实验中，PoLoRA 优于若干 matrix-aware LoRA baseline。消融显示，去掉 curvature preconditioning 和 magnitude rule 后会退化到接近 Product Muon；这两个组件各自贡献了约一半的加速差距。论文还观察到 PoLoRA 的学习率更容易调：最优学习率在不同 rank 间更稳定，性能对 learning rate 的敏感性低于 Adam。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的推导，尤其从 Muon 的 spectral LMO 到 LoRA product-aware LMO 的变化；再看 curvature preconditioning 和 magnitude rule 的定义，它们是区别于并发 Product Muon 类工作的关键。Section 3 看主结果表和 Llama-3.2-1B math 曲线即可。Section 3.3 的消融最重要，因为它回答了 PoLoRA 的收益来自哪里。若关心大规模训练优化器，可把 Appendix B 的证明和 Appendix E 的实现细节作为补充，特别是 polar factor 近似和额外计算开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an optimizer mismatch in LoRA fine-tuning. Adam treats the two LoRA factors as a flat parameter vector, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon applied independently to A and B do not reliably help. The effective parameter seen by the layer is the product BA, so the optimizer should constrain and scale the merged update rather than the two factors in isolation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in post-training and parameter-efficient adaptation, but the optimization lesson is relevant to pretraining research. Reparameterization changes the geometry seen by the optimizer. A matrix-aware optimizer that works for full weight matrices may fail when the trainable variables are low-rank factors. The paper is also useful for large-scale SFT and continual adaptation, where LoRA rank, scaling, and update magnitude interact with stability and tuning cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: PoLoRA combines three ingredients. The first is a product-aware spectral direction. Muon can be viewed as constrained steepest descent under a spectral-norm ball; the linear minimization oracle returns the matrix sign of the gradient, UV^T from the reduced SVD. For LoRA, with W = W0 + BA, the first-order merged update is ΔB A + B ΔA. PoLoRA therefore applies the spectral constraint to this merged update, not separately to ΔA and ΔB. This recovers a Product-Muon-like direction. The second ingredient is curvature preconditioning derived from controlling the per-sample loss change, so the orthogonalized direction accounts for local sensitivity of the loss rather than only the worst-case layer-output change. The third ingredient is a magnitude rule that controls both factor updates and the merged weight update. This is needed because product-aware spectral directions alone do not fully determine the scale of A and B updates under the low-rank factorization.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare PoLoRA against tuned Adam, naive Muon on LoRA factors, and product-aware Muon variants across base models, datasets, and adapter ranks. PoLoRA reaches the final held-out loss of tuned Adam in 1.2–1.7x fewer steps, with at most 3% extra per-step overhead. On Llama-3.2-1B math fine-tuning, it outperforms the tested matrix-aware LoRA baselines. Ablations show that removing curvature preconditioning and the magnitude rule brings the method close to Product Muon; each component explains roughly half of the remaining speedup gap. The paper also reports easier learning-rate tuning: the optimal learning rate is more stable across ranks and performance is less sensitive to the learning-rate choice than Adam.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Focus on Section 2, especially the transition from Muon's spectral LMO to the product-aware LoRA LMO. The definitions of curvature preconditioning and the magnitude rule are the main technical additions beyond concurrent Product Muon-style methods. In Section 3, the key items are the main efficiency tables and the Llama-3.2-1B math curves. Section 3.3 is the most informative experimental part because it separates where the speedup comes from. For implementation-oriented readers, Appendix B and Appendix E are useful for the proofs, polar-factor approximation, and overhead details.

recommendation.zh: 做SFT/持续预训练中LoRA recipe的人重点看§3的三组件消融，可直接尝试把曲率预条件和幅值规则迁移到内部实验。
recommendation.en: For researchers working on LoRA recipes for SFT / continual pretraining, focus on §3 ablations of the three components; curvature preconditioning and magnitude rules are worth porting to internal experiments.
