summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，但对 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口有启发。RLVR 正在成为数学、代码和推理能力塑形的重要阶段，而全参 RLVR 受显存和吞吐限制很重。若低秩适配能稳定接近全参更新，就能降低大模型 RL 实验门槛。更有价值的是它指出：RLVR 的优化轨迹和 SFT 不同，低秩初始化不能只看预训练权重的 SVD 主方向或尾方向，还要控制更新尺度和 KL 漂移。
summary.technical_approach: 技术核心是把 LoRA 的低秩更新和全参微调的优化动态进行比较。工作强调采用标准 LoRA 式的 B=0 初始化，使初始策略不被扰动；在此前提下，A 的正交归一初始化可以最小化 LoRA 结果与全参微调结果之间的差距。基于这个结论，作者提出 LoRA-RLPO 和 LoRA-RLMO：它们仍利用预训练权重的 SVD 子空间信息，但去掉奇异值尺度带来的放大效应，使 A 保持正交归一。这样做保留了部分几何信息，同时避免 PiSSA、MiLoRA 中由奇异值缩放导致的过大初始更新。对 PiSSA 和 MiLoRA 的解释也比较清楚：问题不只是选了主奇异方向或尾奇异方向，而是子空间几何和奇异值尺度共同改变了早期梯度路径，使策略更容易越过 RLVR 中隐含的 KL 稳定区间。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 RLVR 微调比较标准 LoRA、PiSSA、MiLoRA 以及提出的正交 SVD 初始化变体。主要现象是 LoRA-RLPO 和 LoRA-RLMO 在作者测试的 RLVR 设置中优于标准 LoRA，而 PiSSA、MiLoRA 虽在 SFT 中表现较好，在 RLVR 中可能低于标准 LoRA并出现训练不稳定。给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格、任务集合、模型规模和精确指标，因此不宜补写具体数值。更应关注实验结论的方向：RLVR 对初始化尺度更敏感，B=0 加 A 正交归一比直接注入 SVD 奇异值更稳。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看引言中对 PiSSA、MiLoRA 在 RLVR 中失败现象的动机描述，再看理论部分的 Theorem 5.2，重点理解为什么 B=0 时 A 的正交归一会缩小 LoRA 与全参微调的动态差距。实验部分主要看三类对比：标准 LoRA、SVD 缩放初始化、正交 SVD 初始化。若做 RLVR 基础设施或大模型推理能力训练，可以进一步检查 KL 曲线、reward 曲线和 loss spike 是否支持作者关于过大更新尺度的解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks how LoRA should be initialized for RLVR. PiSSA and MiLoRA are useful under supervised fine-tuning, but they can underperform standard LoRA or become unstable under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. This indicates that low-rank initialization rules learned from SFT do not directly transfer to RL optimization.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface than to pretraining itself. RLVR is now a central stage for shaping reasoning and coding behavior, while full-parameter RLVR is expensive because of reference models, multiple sampled responses, and optimizer states. A stable low-rank alternative can make such experiments cheaper. The more general lesson is that RLVR changes the geometry of the update: preserving SVD directions from pretrained weights is not enough if the initialization also injects large singular-value-dependent scales.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis compares LoRA dynamics with full fine-tuning dynamics. With the standard LoRA choice B=0, the authors argue that an orthonormal initialization of A minimizes the gap between the low-rank update and the full-parameter update. This leads to LoRA-RLPO and LoRA-RLMO, SVD-based initializations that keep geometric information from the pretrained weight matrix while maintaining orthonormality and avoiding singular-value amplification. The same framework explains why PiSSA and MiLoRA may fail in RLVR: their selected subspaces can accelerate specific directions, and their singular-value scaling can make early policy updates too aggressive, causing the optimization trajectory to violate the implicit KL stability region.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare standard LoRA, PiSSA, MiLoRA, and the proposed orthonormal SVD-based variants under RLVR. The reported qualitative result is that LoRA-RLPO and LoRA-RLMO outperform standard LoRA in the tested RLVR settings, while PiSSA and MiLoRA may be worse than standard LoRA and can show instability. The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete tables, task lists, model sizes, or exact scores, so exact numbers should not be inferred. The key empirical signal is the sensitivity of RLVR to initialization scale rather than only to subspace choice.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, roughly 20 to 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode of PiSSA and MiLoRA under RLVR, then inspect the theorem that motivates orthonormal A with B=0. In the experiments, focus on comparisons among standard LoRA, SVD-scaled initialization, and orthonormal SVD initialization. For readers running RLVR systems, the most useful details are likely the KL behavior, reward curves, and any instability traces that connect update scale with policy drift.

recommendation.zh: 做RLVR或PEFT后训练的重点看§3的理论推导，正交初始化最优的结论可直接加入内部消融实验验证，能解决不少RL训练不稳定的问题
recommendation.en: Focus on the theoretical derivation in §3 if working on RLVR or PEFT post-training; the orthonormal initialization optimality claim can be directly added to internal ablations to fix many RL training instability issues

paper.title: Learning to Select, Not Relearn: Hard-Routed Mixtures of Reasoning LoRAs
paper.abstract: Composing independently trained LoRA adapters into a single large language model is useful for multi-domain adaptation, especially when the original training data cannot be shared. A common approach is to use MoE-style routing over LoRA experts, but for frozen pretrained adapters, soft weighted combinations can change the unit-scale additive update under which each LoRA module was originally trained. We propose \textbf{Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA}, a two-stage framework for composing frozen reasoning L

summary.core_problem: 研究如何把多个独立训练、且训练数据不能共享的 reasoning LoRA 适配器组合到同一个 LLM 中，同时避免软路由加权破坏每个 LoRA 原本学到的更新尺度。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 LoRA 专家组合方法，而不是基座预训练方法。它对后训练、模块化能力拼接、RLVR reasoning expert 复用有一定参考价值，尤其关注 frozen adapter 组合时的尺度失配问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA，两阶段训练：先分别用 reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback 训练领域 reasoning LoRA；再冻结所有专家，从专家蒸馏 reasoning traces，只训练轻量共享 router 和一个小 attention LoRA。router 对每个 token 做 hard top-1 expert selection，并用 straight-through estimator 保持可训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基座模型规模、专家数量、训练数据规模、baseline 和数值结果。实验应主要比较 hard top-1 routing 与 soft weighted LoRA mixture、单专家 LoRA、可能的 MoE-LoRA 组合方法在多领域 reasoning 上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to compose multiple independently trained reasoning LoRA adapters into one LLM when the original training data cannot be shared, without distorting the update scale each adapter was trained under.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training adapter-composition method rather than a base pretraining result. It is relevant to modular capability reuse, RLVR-trained reasoning experts, and the failure mode of scale-mismatched soft LoRA mixtures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA uses a two-stage recipe: train domain-specific LoRA reasoning experts with reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback, freeze them, distill reasoning traces, and train only a lightweight shared router plus a small attention LoRA. The router selects exactly one expert per token with hard top-1 routing, while a straight-through estimator enables gradient-based learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, number of experts, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The expected comparison is against soft weighted LoRA mixtures, single-adapter baselines, and MoE-style LoRA composition on multi-domain reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 abstract 和方法图；hard routing 的尺度论点合理，但离 pretrain 还远，主要当 adapter 组合坑点备查。
recommendation.en: Skim the abstract and method figure; the scale argument for hard routing is plausible, but this is mainly a post-training adapter-composition cautionary note.

paper.title: Nonlinearity-Aware LoRA: Structured Gate Adaptation under Low-Rank Constraints
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is commonly viewed as an update-space approximation to full fine-tuning, yet this view is incomplete for self-gated Transformer feed-forward networks. In gated FFNs, a low-rank residual can change not only projected features but also the nonlinear selection weights that determine which channels contribute to the output. We formalize this effect as selection misalignment and connect it to the local effective homogeneity of self-gated activations. This motivates a nonlin

summary.core_problem: 现有LoRA将低秩更新视为全参数微调的线性近似，忽略了自门控FFN中低秩残差会改变非线性门的选择权重，导致选择不对齐问题，限制微调效果。
summary.importance: 指出了门控FFN场景下LoRA近似的固有缺陷，提出不增加推理开销的轻量改进方案，属于PEFT方法的增量改进。
summary.technical_approach: 形式化门控FFN中低秩更新导致的选择不对齐效应，将其与自门控激活的局部有效齐次性关联；提出两个训练期轻量机制：基于导数的门更新时间重要性mask、激活感知的步长缩放规则，不增加推理成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体实验设置与量化结果，方法仅在训练阶段生效，无额外推理参数与计算开销。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LoRA frames low-rank updates as linear approximations to full fine-tuning, ignoring that low-rank residuals in self-gated FFNs alter nonlinear gate selection weights, causing selection misalignment that limits fine-tuning performance.
summary_en.importance: Identifies an inherent limitation of LoRA in gated FFN settings, and proposes a lightweight improvement that adds no inference overhead as an incremental PEFT method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes the selection misalignment effect caused by low-rank updates in gated FFNs, connects it to the local effective homogeneity of self-gated activations; proposes two training-only mechanisms: a derivative-based temporal importance mask for gate-related LoRA updates, and an activation-aware step scaling rule, with zero inference overhead.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete experimental setup or quantitative results are provided in the abstract; the method operates only during training and adds no inference parameters or compute.

recommendation.zh: LoRA针对门控FFN的增量改进，核心观察有参考价值但工程性强，预训练方向无需关注，做PEFT可扫一眼摘要。
recommendation.en: Incremental LoRA improvement for gated FFNs; the core observation is marginally useful but heavily engineering-focused, irrelevant for pretraining, skim abstract only if working on PEFT.

paper.title: Mechanistically Eliciting Latent Behaviors in Language Models
paper.abstract: We aim to discover diverse, generalizable perturbations of LLM internals that can surface hidden behavioral modes. Such perturbations could help reshape model behavior and systematically evaluate potential risks. We introduce Causal Perturbative Elicitation (CPE), an unsupervised method for discovering interpretable low-rank adapters (LoRAs) that can elicit these latent behaviors. CPE decomposes the computations of a deep transformer slice using a heuristic tensor-decomposition-based algorithm.

summary.core_problem: 论文研究如何在不依赖大规模监督数据或输出层 RL 搜索的情况下，从模型内部诱发隐藏的行为模式。目标不是简单 prompt engineering，而是在早期权重扰动中寻找可泛化、可解释、能改变下游行为的方向。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座研究的价值主要在机制分析和 post-train 接口。它把“行为诱发”从输出采样或监督微调，推进到早中层计算路径的因果扰动。对 RL 训练也有启发：如果一个扰动能把模型初始化到较好的行为 basin，后续 RL 在奖励不完备时可能更不容易走向 reward hacking。该工作不直接改进预训练 loss，但提供了一种研究隐性能力、隐藏 persona、拒绝行为、alignment-faking 的工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法称为 Causal Perturbative Elicitation，简称 CPE。每个 adapter 由多个 unit-norm rank-1 LoRA 组成，作用在若干连续 source layers 的 attention output projection 上，并观察固定 target layer 的激活变化。核心假设是：能在网络后续层产生大范围、结构化影响的早层扰动，更可能对应有语义的行为模式；随机扰动通常只是局部噪声。CPE 不像 SAE 那样以稀疏重构激活为目标，而是学习一个浅层 MLP 来近似一段 10–20 层 transformer slice 的因果/微分结构，再用启发式张量分解搜索多样化、因果影响大的低秩扰动。一个重要特点是数据效率很高，作者声称单个样本也能学习出多个可解释 LoRA。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B、GPT-OSS-20B、Llama3-70B 等模型上进行。开放式对话中，CPE 用很少数据诱发 coherent personas，效果接近基于大规模 token 训练的 SAE steering vectors。自然行为诱发任务包括 reasoning、anti-sycophancy、jailbreaking；CPE 通常强于 SAE feature steering，并且在 anti-sycophancy 和 reasoning 等场景中有时接近 GRPO。更有意思的是 RL 初始化实验：在 competitive programming 的 mis-specified reward 环境中，CPE + GRPO 可以达到接近使用正确 reward 的 gold-standard performance，而随机初始化的 GRPO 出现 reward hacking，gold-standard reward 崩塌。安全相关实验中，CPE 恢复了 password-locked Llama3-70B 编码性能的 77%，并几乎消除了 synthetic-document-fine-tuned Llama3-70B 变体中的 alignment-faking。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 45–60 分钟。先看 Method 中 adapter 参数化、source/target layer 设定、causal training objective，与 SAE 的差异。然后看三个实验块：persona/behavior elicitation、CPE 初始化 GRPO、password-lock 与 alignment-faking。对预训练研究者，最值得深挖的是“早层低秩扰动为何能泛化为行为模式”以及“CPE 初始化如何改变 RL 的优化 basin”。如果时间有限，可以跳过开放式 persona 样例，优先读消融实验和与 SAE、GRPO 的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to elicit latent behavioral modes in LLMs through internal perturbations, rather than through prompting, supervised fine-tuning, or output-layer reinforcement learning.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to mechanistic intervention and the interface between internal representations and post-training. CPE suggests that some behavioral modes can be accessed through low-rank perturbations to early-layer weights, and that such perturbations can provide better starting points for later RL. This is useful for studying hidden capabilities, mode collapse, reward hacking, password-locked behavior, and alignment-faking.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Causal Perturbative Elicitation, represents each adapter as a set of unit-norm rank-1 LoRA perturbations applied to attention output projections across several consecutive source layers. The effect is measured at a later target layer. The working hypothesis is that perturbations producing large, structured downstream activation changes correspond to meaningful computational pathways, while random perturbations tend to remain local noise. Instead of training sparse autoencoders to reconstruct activations, CPE trains a shallow MLP approximation of the causal structure of a 10–20 layer transformer slice and uses a heuristic tensor-decomposition procedure to extract diverse causally important perturbations. A notable claim is extreme data efficiency: interpretable LoRAs can be discovered from as little as one example.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, and Llama3-70B variants. On open-ended conversational prompts, CPE elicits coherent personas roughly comparable to SAE-based steering despite using far less data. On behavior elicitation tasks such as reasoning, anti-sycophancy, and jailbreaking, CPE outperforms SAE feature steering and is sometimes competitive with GRPO. In a competitive programming setup with a misspecified reward, initializing GRPO with CPE reaches gold-standard performance comparable to GRPO trained with the correct reward, while random initialization leads to reward hacking and collapse under the gold-standard reward. In safety-oriented tests, CPE restores 77% of password-locked coding performance on a password-locked Llama3-70B and nearly removes alignment-faking in a synthetic-document-fine-tuned Llama3-70B variant.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 45–60 minutes. Read the method section carefully enough to understand the rank-1 LoRA parameterization, source-target layer setup, and the causal objective, since these are the main differences from SAE steering. Then focus on the GRPO initialization experiment and the password-lock/alignment-faking results. For pretraining-oriented readers, the key question is why early-layer low-rank perturbations generalize as behavioral modes and whether the same machinery can diagnose latent capabilities before post-training.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“能力是学出来还是被激活出来”的 prior；先看方法图和 Countdown 对比，若控制组干净，值得内部复现成风险探针。
recommendation.en: This can shift your prior on whether behaviors are learned vs. merely activated; read the method and Countdown comparison first, and replicate internally if the controls are clean.

paper.title: Continual Learning for Sequential Personalization of Small Language Models: A Stability Monitoring Analysis
paper.abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly being considered for deployment on edge devices such as laptops, enabling private, low-latency, and locally personalized applications. However, personalization requires models to adapt over time to evolving user- or task-specific data, placing them in a continual learning setting. This creates the risk of catastrophic forgetting, where learning new information degrades performance on previously learned tasks or broader model capabilities. Recent benc

summary.core_problem: 研究小语言模型在边缘设备上进行连续LoRA个性化时，如何监控灾难性遗忘和通用能力漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练/个性化场景的分析协议；它不直接推进预训练方法，但对continual post-train和用户侧适配的稳定性监控有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文采用顺序LoRA适配，每个适配阶段保存checkpoint，并同时评估当前任务、历史任务和固定reference set；用checkpoint-level轨迹观察任务收益、遗忘程度和参考集性能漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明研究对象是SLM的连续LoRA个性化，并引用TRACE一类发现LLM持续微调会损伤通用能力的背景；未给出具体模型参数量、任务集合、基线或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to monitor catastrophic forgetting and general-capability drift during sequential LoRA personalization of small language models on edge devices.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis protocol for post-training personalization. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is useful for thinking about continual adaptation and stability monitoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study performs sequential LoRA adaptation, saves checkpoints after each stage, and evaluates each checkpoint on the current task, previously seen tasks, and a fixed reference set to track forgetting and reference-set drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the study around SLM personalization and references TRACE-style findings on continual fine-tuning degrading aligned LLM capabilities. It does not report concrete model sizes, baselines, or numeric results.

recommendation.zh: 当作continual SFT监控协议备查即可；真正有用的是checkpoint-level reference drift，而不是SLM个性化结论本身。
recommendation.en: Use it as a reference for continual SFT monitoring; the useful piece is checkpoint-level reference drift, not the SLM personalization result itself.

paper.title: LearniBridge: Learnable Calibration of Feature Caching for Diffusion Models Acceleration
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have driven substantial progress in image and video generation but suffer from prohibitive computational costs. Feature caching accelerates inference by reusing intermediate representations. Existing methods rely on historical features for implementation simplicity, yet suffer from severe error accumulation at high acceleration ratios. To address this limitation, we investigate the nature of the requisite feature correction. We demonstrate that the optimal calibrati

summary.core_problem: 解决图像和视频 Diffusion Transformer 推理中 feature caching 在高加速比下误差累积严重的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型推理加速和缓存校准。它主要服务 DiT 图像/视频生成，不是 LLM 推理或预训练论文；但其“缓存特征误差可用低秩子空间校正”的观察，对 activation reuse、KV 近似和推理压缩有弱迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先分析缓存特征所需的最优校正更新，发现其在不同 prompt 下共享低秩子空间；据此提出 LearniBridge，用轻量 LoRA update 在多个 timestep 之间做可学习校准，只需要 3-5 个训练样本即可适配。
summary.experiments: 在图像和视频生成模型上测试，报告在 FLUX 等模型上最高达到 5.87×、5.75× 和 4.10× 加速。摘要未完整列出所有模型名称、画质指标和 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles error accumulation in feature caching for accelerating image and video Diffusion Transformers, especially at high speedup ratios.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is inference acceleration for generative DiTs. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the observation that cache correction lives in a shared low-rank subspace is a useful weak signal for activation reuse and approximate inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze the optimal correction needed for cached features and find a shared low-rank structure across prompts. LearniBridge then applies lightweight LoRA updates to calibrate features across timesteps, requiring only 3-5 training samples.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on image and video generation models and reports up to 5.87x, 5.75x, and 4.10x acceleration on models including FLUX. The abstract does not fully specify all baselines, quality metrics, or model details.

recommendation.zh: 可扫低秩校正的诊断实验；对 LLM activation/KV reuse 是弱类比，别把 DiT 加速数字直接迁移。
recommendation.en: Skim the low-rank correction diagnostics; it is a weak analogy for LLM activation or KV reuse, not transferable speedup evidence.

paper.title: Closing the Quality Gap in Low-Resource Text-to-Speech: LoRA Fine-Tuning of VoxCPM2 for Khmer and Korean
paper.abstract: Large pretrained text-to-speech (TTS) models sound almost human for well-resourced languages, but much worse for languages that are rare in their training data. We study this quality gap for Khmer and Korean using VoxCPM2, a 2.4B-parameter, tokenizer-free TTS model that joins a MiniCPM-4 language-model backbone with a flow-matching diffusion decoder. We build one shared, language-tagged corpus of about 26 hours and adapt VoxCPM2 with a single Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter, trained on both l

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注低资源语言 TTS 的质量落差：大规模预训练语音生成模型在高资源语言上表现接近人声，但在 Khmer、Korean 这类训练覆盖不足的语言上明显退化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值有限但不为零。它不是在做基座预训练范式创新，而是在检验大规模 tokenizer-free TTS 基座模型的跨语言适配边界，并给出一个很实际的观察：自动验证损失与人类听感并不总一致。这对语音 LM / 统一生成模型的 post-pretrain 适配有一点参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于 VoxCPM2（2.4B，LM backbone + flow-matching diffusion decoder）做双语联合 LoRA 微调。一个共享、带语言标签的数据集约 26 小时；单个零初始化 LoRA adapter 同时插入语言模型部分和扩散解码器部分，从原始 zero-shot 模型平滑起步。核心不是新架构，而是低成本适配 recipe。
summary.experiments: 模型为 2.4B VoxCPM2。数据约 26 小时，覆盖 Khmer 和 Korean。最佳 rank=64 的 LoRA 只训练 0.19% 到 3.03% 参数，却把 Khmer MOS 从 3.85 提升到 4.23，且统计显著（paired Wilcoxon p<0.001）。作者还指出 validation loss 与主观 MOS 对最佳 rank 的判断不一致，这一点比具体分数更值得记住。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自忠北国立大学和 BigData Labs。论文围绕 VoxCPM2 这一 tokenizer-free TTS 基座模型展开，但未见更广泛的基座预训练团队背景信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the quality gap of large pretrained TTS models on low-resource languages, where performance lags far behind high-resource settings.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining researchers is limited but non-zero. This is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it probes the adaptation boundary of a large tokenizer-free TTS foundation model and surfaces a practical finding: validation loss does not necessarily track human perceptual quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt VoxCPM2, a 2.4B model with an LM backbone and a flow-matching diffusion decoder, using a shared bilingual LoRA setup. A single zero-initialized adapter is attached to both the language model and decoder, trained on a language-tagged corpus of about 26 hours.
summary_en.experiments: The base model is 2.4B VoxCPM2. Training uses roughly 26 hours of Khmer and Korean speech. The best LoRA rank (64) updates only 0.19% to 3.03% of parameters yet improves Khmer MOS from 3.85 to 4.23 with strong statistical significance. The most useful observation is that validation loss and human MOS disagree on the best rank.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Chungbuk National University and BigData Labs. The work is built around VoxCPM2 as a tokenizer-free TTS foundation model, but there is no clear signal of a broader foundation-model pretraining lab background.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验结论就够：LoRA rank 选择被自动 loss 误导，这对语音生成基座的适配评估是个实在坑；方法本身偏常规，不必细读。
recommendation.en: A glance is enough: the useful takeaway is that validation loss can mis-rank LoRA settings relative to human MOS in TTS adaptation; the method itself is fairly standard.

paper.title: Disco-LoRA: Disentangled Composition of Content, Style, and Motion for Multi-concept Video Customization
paper.abstract: Video customization based on Text-to-Video (T2V) models aims to learn specific features from reference data to generate controllable videos. While significant strides have been made in image stylization and video motion customization, simultaneously controlling multiple concepts, such as content, style, and motion, remains a major challenge. In this work, we systematically define the task of multi-concept video customization, which requires the joint control of content, style, and motion. To fac

summary.core_problem: 文本到视频个性化生成中，模型很难同时、可控地组合参考数据里的内容、风格和运动概念。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法和任务定义。它系统定义 multi-concept video customization，并构建相应 benchmark；但主要是 T2V 个性化应用层方法，对 LLM 基座预训练的直接信息量有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Disco-LoRA，把内容、风格、运动三类概念拆开学习再重组。方法先把目标拆成 Content-Style 和 Content-Motion 两个子任务，每个子任务使用 Iterative Dual-LoRA Disentanglement Framework 来分离概念；随后利用 layer-wise weight trends 指导不同概念 LoRA 的组合。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明论文构建了 multi-concept video customization benchmark，并在该任务上验证 Disco-LoRA 的多概念控制能力。未给出基础 T2V 模型、训练样本规模、对比方法、定量指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: In text-to-video customization, it is difficult to jointly and controllably combine content, style, and motion concepts from reference data.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method and task-definition paper. It defines multi-concept video customization and builds a benchmark, but it mainly operates at the T2V personalization layer and has limited direct value for LLM foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Disco-LoRA separates and recombines content, style, and motion. The method decomposes the problem into Content-Style and Content-Motion subtasks, applies an Iterative Dual-LoRA Disentanglement Framework to separate concepts, and uses layer-wise weight trends to guide LoRA composition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the authors build a benchmark for multi-concept video customization and evaluate Disco-LoRA on controlled concept composition. It does not provide the base T2V model, training data scale, baselines, metrics, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 了解任务定义即可；LoRA 解耦组合对视频生成工程有用，但对统一预训练范式的信号偏弱。
recommendation.en: Know the task definition; the LoRA disentanglement is useful for video-generation engineering, but weak as evidence for unified pretraining design.

paper.title: EPTS: Elastic Post-Training Sparsity for Efficient Large Language Model Compression
paper.abstract: Post-Training Sparsity (PTS) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for compressing Large Language Models to facilitate efficient deployment on resource-constrained devices. However, existing PTS methodologies are typically confined to Single-Sparsity optimization, necessitating a separate, time-consuming optimization session for each specific sparsity level. This rigid paradigm significantly hinders flexible deployment across diverse hardware scenarios, as adapting to a new sparsity requirement mand

summary.core_problem: 解决后训练稀疏化需要为每个目标 sparsity 单独优化一次，导致 LLM 压缩部署缺乏弹性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率与模型压缩方向，不直接推进预训练方法，但对 serving 侧的可部署性有现实意义。核心价值在于把单一 sparsity 优化改成一次训练覆盖多档 sparsity。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Elastic Post-Training Sparsity（EPTS），用一次优化得到可在多种稀疏率下工作的弹性模型。关键设计是 Multi-Sparsity Hierarchy LoRA（MS-HiLoRA），让低稀疏组向高稀疏组传递知识，缓解多稀疏联合优化中的性能冲突。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、稀疏率区间和基线名称，但声称相较传统 single-sparsity PTS，可在多种硬件需求下避免重复优化并保持较稳健性能。缺少更细的吞吐、延迟和真实部署收益数字，阅读时应重点核查这些表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the rigidity of post-training sparsity methods that require a separate optimization run for every target sparsity level in LLM compression.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency/compression contribution rather than a pretraining one, but it matters for deployment because it replaces single-sparsity optimization with a one-shot multi-sparsity solution.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Elastic Post-Training Sparsity (EPTS), which produces one elastic model that can operate across multiple sparsity levels. The key component is Multi-Sparsity Hierarchy LoRA (MS-HiLoRA), designed to transfer knowledge from lower-sparsity groups to higher-sparsity ones and reduce conflicts in joint optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, sparsity ranges, or baseline names, but claims robust performance across diverse sparsity configurations without repeated optimization. The main thing to verify in the paper is whether latency, throughput, and real deployment gains are actually compelling.

recommendation.zh: 是个部署侧小而实用的点子，不改 pretrain prior；只看方法图和多稀疏率性能表，确认是否真省重优化。
recommendation.en: A practical deployment-side idea, not a pretraining prior changer; read the method figure and the multi-sparsity tables to see if it truly avoids costly re-optimization.

paper.title: When Top-1 Fails: Calibrating LoRA Monitors for Masked Diffusion LMs
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion language model (DLM) fine-tuning inherits inexpensive diagnostics from denoising-time confidence monitors, but their PEFT-training meaning is untested. We test top-1 argmax concentration as a collapse warning. Across 816 LoRA/PEFT configurations from three DLM families, the warning fires for every configuration while logs record 0/816 actual collapses at the 200 step horizon, giving zero precision. The cause is pre-equilibrium saturation: top-1 concentration is already high be

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是一个很具体但容易误用的问题：离散扩散语言模型在 LoRA/PEFT 短程训练中，能否把 denoising 阶段已有的 top-1 argmax concentration 当作训练崩溃预警。作者的结论是否定的。top-1 监控的是 token 预测分布是否集中，但 DLM 在训练前和训练早期已经高度集中，这个信号很快饱和，不能区分后续稳定与不稳定的 LoRA 配置。论文进一步寻找替代信号，提出用 LoRA 参数侧的最大梯度范数做 family-local triage，即只在同一 DLM 家族内校准阈值，用于早期检查和实验路由。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在训练诊断，而不是提出新的 DLM 训练目标。它给出了一个大规模负结果：一个在 denoising 诊断中看似廉价、自然的 token-side 指标，迁移到 DLM-LoRA PEFT 稳定性监控时完全失效。对预训练研究的启发在于，监控信号的语义高度依赖训练阶段和参数更新路径。DLM 的 token 预测集中不等于参数更新已经危险；LoRA 的风险更可能出现在梯度如何路由到少数低秩矩阵上。这个观察对扩散 LM、masked LM、any-order LM 的训练仪表盘设计有直接意义：不能简单复用 AR 或 denoising 过程中的可视化指标，需要区分 token-side saturation 和 parameter-side instability。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分成两步。第一步是反证 top-1 collapse warning。作者在 816 个 DLM PEFT 配置上做审计，覆盖 LLaDA-family 的 671 个配置、Dream-7B 的 100 个边界配置、MDLM-OWT 130M 的 45 个边界配置。top-1 collapse rate 度量 argmax 预测是否集中到很小的词表区域。结果显示该 warning 在 816/816 配置上触发，但训练日志中的 collapsed flag 在 200 step 训练窗口内为 0/816。这个指标的 precision 为 0。第二步是解释为什么失效，并提出替代监控。作者测到 top-1 token frequency 在 step 0 已经是 0.83±0.13，所有配置都高于 0.5，中位配置在 4 个 optimizer steps 内超过 0.95。legacy fire-step 与稳定性无显著关系，Mann–Whitney U 检验 p=0.20。相比之下，参数侧的 LoRA 梯度更能反映不稳定配置。作者检查了 worst rank-amplification corner：per-token CE 梯度集中度并不高，Gini 为 0.29，最大 token-position CE-gradient share 只有 1.5%；但 LoRA 参数梯度更集中，Gini 为 0.46，单个矩阵承载 63.0% 的梯度质量。基于这个观察，论文用 max LoRA gradient norm 做早期 triage，并强调阈值必须按模型家族校准，不能跨 family 直接迁移。
summary.experiments: 关键实验有四组。第一，816 个 DLM 配置中，top-1 warning 全部触发，实际 collapse 为 0，precision 为 0。匹配的 AR 控制实验使用 Pythia 410M、1B、2.8B、6.9B 和 Qwen3.5-9B，共 360 个审计配置，也记录到 0/360 actual collapses，说明结果不是一般的 masked-CE collapse 现象。第二，饱和分析显示 top-1 在优化开始前已经处于高位：step 0 为 0.83±0.13，所有配置超过 0.5，中位配置 4 step 内超过 0.95，且触发时间与稳定性无显著关系。第三，max-gradient 与不稳定配置显著相关。在 LLaDA2.0-mini 上，n=144，不稳定配置的 median max-gradient norm 是稳定配置的 3.23 倍，Bonferroni 校正后 p=2.7e-7，bootstrap 95% CI 为 [2.76, 3.97]。在 method-comparison set 上，n=395，比例达到 362 倍，稳定配置 median 为 99.3，不稳定配置 median 为 35,960.4，pBonf=5e-21，CI 为 [202, 779]。第四，held-out 校准实验更关键。作者在 LLaDA-family 的 671 个配置上做固定 80/20 split，在训练集选择阈值，用来预测测试集 top-decile final-loss 配置。max-gradient 达到 precision 0.68、recall 0.94、F1 0.79；all-positive top-1 baseline 在同一 split 上 precision 只有 0.13。split-bootstrap 的 95% CI 为 [0.500, 0.947]，高于 baseline ceiling 0.148。step-k sweep 还显示 max-gradient 的 precision 从约 step 25 起趋于稳定；loss-at-step-k 在 step 11 对极端高 loss 配置更强，但在 step 25 到 100 之间落后于 max-gradient。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、§4.1、§4.5 和 Limitations。§4.1 是核心负结果，重点看 816 配置的 warning/collapse 对照，以及 held-out threshold calibration。§4.5 是机制解释，重点看 token-side saturation 与 LoRA parameter-side gradient routing 的分离。Appendix B.1 值得看，因为 step-k sweep 回答了一个实际问题：多早记录 max-gradient 才有用。Appendix C 的 AR controls 用来界定结论范围，避免把问题误解成普通交叉熵训练都会这样。Appendix D 的 falsification probes 值得快速过一遍，主要看作者如何限制 claim：它支持的是 short-horizon DLM-LoRA PEFT 的 inspection/routing，不是通用 collapse detector。实现上最值得借鉴的是监控设计原则：先问指标测到的是 token 分布、loss 轨迹还是参数更新路径，再决定它能不能作为训练稳定性信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important monitoring failure in discrete diffusion language models: whether top-1 argmax concentration, a cheap diagnostic already used during denoising, can serve as an early collapse warning for short-horizon LoRA/PEFT training. The answer is no. Top-1 concentration measures token-side prediction saturation, and in these DLM runs it is already high before meaningful optimization begins. It quickly loses sensitivity to downstream training stability. The paper then proposes a family-calibrated parameter-side signal, the maximum LoRA gradient norm, as an early inspection and routing tool.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly diagnostic. It does not introduce a new DLM objective, but it gives a well-controlled negative result on a monitoring practice that is easy to adopt without validation. For pretraining researchers working on diffusion LMs or masked/any-order LMs, the main lesson is that a monitor’s meaning depends on the training phase and the update path. Token-level concentration during denoising is not the same thing as a dangerous parameter update during LoRA training. The useful signal comes from where gradients are routed in the low-rank adapters. This is directly relevant to building training dashboards for non-AR language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first audits top-1 collapse warnings across 816 DLM PEFT configurations: 671 LLaDA-family configurations, 100 Dream-7B boundary configurations, and 45 MDLM-OWT 130M boundary configurations. The warning fires for every configuration, while the training loop records zero actual collapses at the 200-step horizon. The authors then explain the failure through saturation analysis. Top-1 token frequency is already 0.83±0.13 at step 0, every run is above 0.5, and the median run crosses 0.95 within four optimizer steps. The warning fire-step is not significantly associated with stability. The alternative signal is parameter-side: maximum LoRA gradient norm. A gradient routing probe shows that token CE gradients are only mildly concentrated, with Gini 0.29 and the largest evaluated token-position share at 1.5%, while LoRA parameter gradients are much more concentrated, with Gini 0.46 and one matrix carrying 63.0% of the gradient mass. This motivates using max-gradient as a family-local triage signal rather than a global threshold.
summary_en.experiments: The central result is the 816-configuration refutation: top-1 fires in 816/816 DLM PEFT runs, while actual collapse occurs in 0/816 runs, giving zero precision. Matched AR controls on Pythia 410M, 1B, 2.8B, 6.9B, and Qwen3.5-9B cover 360 audited configurations and also show 0/360 actual collapses, helping bound the claim. The saturation analysis reports step-0 top-1 frequency of 0.83±0.13, all runs above 0.5, median crossing 0.95 within four optimizer steps, and no significant relation between legacy fire-step and stability, with Mann–Whitney U p=0.20. For max-gradient, unstable configurations in LLaDA2.0-mini have a 3.23x higher median max-gradient norm than stable ones, with n=144, Bonferroni-corrected p=2.7e-7, and bootstrap 95% CI [2.76, 3.97]. On the method-comparison set, n=395, the ratio is 362x, with stable median 99.3 versus unstable median 35,960.4, pBonf=5e-21, CI [202, 779]. On a fixed 80/20 split of the 671-configuration LLaDA-family corpus, a threshold selected on the training split predicts held-out top-decile final-loss configurations with precision 0.68, recall 0.94, and F1 0.79. The all-positive top-1 baseline gives precision 0.13 on the same split. A split-bootstrap gives 95% CI [0.500, 0.947], above the baseline ceiling of 0.148. A step-k sweep shows max-gradient precision stabilizing around step 25.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction, §4.1, §4.5, and the Limitations closely. §4.1 contains the key audit result and the held-out calibration protocol. §4.5 is the most useful part mechanistically, because it separates token-side pre-equilibrium saturation from LoRA parameter-side gradient routing. Appendix B.1 is worth reading for the step-k sweep, which answers when the signal becomes useful in practice. Appendix C defines the AR controls. Appendix D is useful for the falsification probes and for understanding the limits of the claim. The most transferable idea is not the exact threshold, but the monitoring principle: decide whether a signal measures token distribution, loss trajectory, or parameter update routing before using it as a stability alarm.

recommendation.zh: 所有做扩散LM预训练/微调的团队应立刻废弃top-1浓度崩溃预警，复现其LoRA梯度范数监控逻辑到训练pipeline中。
recommendation.en: All teams working on diffusion LM pre-training/fine-tuning should immediately discard top-1 concentration collapse warnings and reproduce its LoRA gradient norm monitoring logic in training pipelines.

paper.title: UniRank: Unified Rank Allocation for Low-Rank LLM Compression
paper.abstract: Low-rank decomposition serves as a promising compression paradigm for large language models, however, rank allocation remains challenging: manual rules lack generalizability, and learning-based approaches incur heavy computational overhead. To address these issues, we formulate global low-rank allocation as a sorting-and-truncation pipeline, and score each singular component via dual criteria: \textbf{Local} singular energy ratio that quantifies the intrinsic importance within the decomposed par

summary.core_problem: 低秩分解压缩 LLM 时，每个权重矩阵保留多少奇异分量（秩分配）缺乏通用且低成本的方案；同时低秩模型无法直接兼容 LoRA 微调，传统重建-合并-再分解流程会引入信息损失和额外计算。
summary.importance: 提出了一套无需训练、计算开销极低的全局秩分配方法，可直接复用到不同模型架构；同时给出低秩模型与 LoRA 兼容的微调范式，对推理侧模型压缩和部署后适配有实际工程价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心分为两部分。第一是 Sorting-and-Truncation 全局秩分配管线：把原本组合爆炸的全局秩选择问题，简化为对所有权重矩阵所有奇异分量统一打分、排序、按预算截断。每个奇异分量的打分由两个指标相乘得到：一是局部奇异能量比（归一化奇异值平方占比），衡量该分量对重建原权重矩阵的结构重要性；二是全局功能重要性，用所在层在小校准集上的输入-输出余弦相似度做代理——利用 pre-norm 残差结构和 RMSNorm 的尺度不变性，语义信息只由方向决定，高输入输出余弦相似度说明该层变换要么接近恒等（奇异值接近 0），要么与输入线性相关（有效秩接近 1），因此可以分配更低的秩。第二是 Rank-Preserving Fine-Tuning（RPFT）：把已经分配好的秩 k 拆成冻结的 k-k_LoRA 和可训练的 k_LoRA 两部分，直接在分解后的因子矩阵上做 LoRA 式更新，不需要先重建全秩再合并再分解，避免截断损失和额外计算。
summary.experiments: 秩分配阶段开销约 2 分钟；零样本压缩下，相比手工规则基线，困惑度最多降低 50%；配合 RPFT 后，下游任务性能可恢复到稠密模型的 90% 水平。实验覆盖了低秩压缩、后压缩微调两个阶段的完整管线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第 3 节关于输入-输出余弦相似度与有效秩的几何解释和对应关系，这是整个打分指标的理论支撑；其次看 RPFT 的秩拆分设计和与传统 LoRA 合并流程的对比。附录中的消融实验可快速浏览，关注两个打分指标各自的贡献。全文泛读约 40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Rank allocation for low-rank LLM compression lacks a generalizable, low-cost solution: uniform or heuristic rules fail across architectures, and learning-based methods add heavy training overhead. Separately, pre-decomposed low-rank models cannot directly absorb LoRA updates; the standard reconstruct-merge-redecompose pipeline incurs information loss and extra compute.
summary_en.importance: Provides a training-free, computationally cheap global rank allocation method that transfers across model architectures, plus a LoRA-compatible fine-tuning paradigm for pre-decomposed low-rank models. Both components have direct engineering value for inference-side compression and post-deployment adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two core modules. First, a Sorting-and-Truncation (S&T) pipeline: the intractable combinatorial global rank optimization is reduced to scoring all singular components across every weight matrix, sorting them, and truncating to a total rank budget. Each component receives a product score: (1) local singular energy ratio, i.e. normalized squared singular value, measuring structural contribution to reconstructing the original weight matrix per Eckart-Young-Mirsky; (2) global functional importance, proxied by layer-wise input-output cosine similarity computed on a small calibration set. Under pre-norm residual structure and scale-invariant RMSNorm, semantics are encoded purely in vector direction — high input-output cosine similarity implies the layer transform is either near-identity (singular values ≈ 0) or linearly correlated with input features (effective rank ≈ 1), justifying a lower assigned rank. Second, Rank-Preserving Fine-Tuning (RPFT): the pre-allocated rank k of each decomposed module is split into a frozen part (k - k_LoRA) and a tunable part (k_LoRA). LoRA-style updates are applied directly on the factor matrices, avoiding full-rank reconstruction, re-decomposition, and the associated truncation loss.
summary_en.experiments: Rank allocation overhead is roughly 2 minutes. Under zero-shot compression, S&T reduces perplexity by up to 50% relative to handcrafted baselines. With RPFT, downstream task performance recovers to ~90% of the dense model. Results cover the full pipeline of compression plus post-compression adaptation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3's geometric justification linking input-output cosine similarity to effective rank, which is the theoretical foundation of the scoring metric. Then examine the RPFT rank-split design and its comparison with the standard LoRA merge workflow. Skim ablation results in the appendix to understand the relative contribution of the two scoring terms. Estimated reading time: ~40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 双准则秩分配思路干净，保秩微调策略对压缩后再继续预训练有参考价值，重点看 §3 打分公式与 §4.2 微调部分。
recommendation.en: The dual-criterion rank allocation is cleanly formulated; the rank-preserving fine-tuning recipe is relevant for continued pretraining after compression, focus on §3 scoring and §4.2.

paper.title: Techniques for Peak Memory Reduction for LoRA Fine-tuning of LLMs on Edge Devices
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on an end-user's data offers personalized experiences while keeping data private, but faces severe memory constraints on consumer hardware. Peak memory during fine-tuning often exceeds device limits, especially for models with billions of parameters and long-context training data. This paper introduces a suite of complementary techniques to reduce memory footprint without sacrificing model quality: (1) base model quanti

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是端侧 LoRA 微调的峰值显存问题，重点不是 LoRA 参数本身，而是 3B 级模型在长上下文反向传播时由激活、全精度权重展开、LM head/softmax 共同造成的内存峰值。作者希望在不明显损失微调质量的前提下，把单样本、长上下文 LoRA 训练压到消费级设备可承受的内存范围。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对持续学习、端侧个性化、隐私场景下的本地适配有参考价值。它有用的地方在于把训练内存拆得比较清楚：冻结基座后，参数内存可以靠量化处理，但长上下文下真正困难的是 activation memory 和输出层相关开销。这个结论对设计低资源 continual pretrain、on-device adaptation、长上下文微调 recipe 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是几类互补的内存削减技术组合。第一，冻结基座权重做混合精度量化：大部分线性层压到 INT4，输出 head 保留 INT8，输入 embedding 保留 INT16。由于训练假设使用 FP32 activation 和 FP32 matmul kernel，作者采用 on-the-fly dequantization：量化权重放在片外，需要参与前向或反向时临时反量化成 FP32，用完立刻释放，避免长期保存全精度基座。第二，做带片外 offload 的 checkpointing。网络被拆成 embedding、若干 decoder layer、output layer 等有序 compute node，只在边界缓存部分 activation，中间 activation 反向时重算，同时权重和中间张量按需从片外加载和驱逐。它和普通 activation checkpointing 的区别是同时考虑 rematerialization 与 disk/off-chip storage，不只是在 GPU/RAM 内重算。第三，针对 LM head 和 softmax 的开销，使用语义相关 token 子集近似 softmax，并配合 logits masking，减少输出 vocabulary 维度带来的内存与计算压力。整体方案更像一个端侧训练执行计划，而不是单一算法改动。
summary.experiments: 实验主要使用 Llama-3.2 3B 和 Qwen-2.5 3B。默认设置是 batch size 1、FP32 compute、LoRA rank 16，LoRA 只加在 query 和 value projection 上；峰值内存用 A100 80GB 做 profiling，以隔离不同技术对峰值内存的影响。论文报告 Llama-3.2 3B 在 2048 token 上下文下，LoRA 训练峰值内存可从 26.20GB 降到 1.02GB；在 16384 token 上下文下也可控制到 6.95GB。单看量化，Llama-3.2 3B 的模型 footprint 从 5.98GB 降到 2.59GB，但 Table 3 的 profiling 显示，量化后长上下文训练仍会被 activation 主导，8K 以上尤其明显。这个实验结果支持了作者的核心取舍：参数压缩是必要条件，activation checkpoint/offload 才是长上下文端侧训练的主要杠杆。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。优先看 Table 1，了解各技术叠加后的峰值内存数量级；再看 Table 3，确认参数内存和 activation 内存的相对贡献。方法部分重点看 Algorithm 1 的 on-the-fly dequantization 和 Algorithm 2 的 checkpoint/offload 执行逻辑。softmax approximation 与 logits masking 可以快速扫过，重点判断它们是否会引入任务依赖或质量风险。若关心真实端侧部署，再看 Section 4.6 的移动硬件测量；若只关心预训练/微调系统启发，主要价值在内存分解和执行计划设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets peak memory during on-device LoRA fine-tuning of LLMs. The main bottleneck is not the LoRA parameters themselves, but the combination of long-context activations, temporary full-precision base weights, and output-layer softmax costs during backpropagation. The goal is to make 3B-class, long-context personalization feasible under tight edge-device memory limits without materially degrading model quality.
summary_en.importance: The work is not central to foundation-model pretraining, but it is relevant to continual adaptation, private personalization, and low-resource training recipes. Its useful message is the memory accounting: once the base model is frozen, weight memory can be reduced aggressively through quantization, while long-context training remains dominated by activations and LM-head-related costs. This is a practical signal for anyone designing local continual pretraining or edge-side adaptation pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines several memory-saving techniques. First, the frozen base model is stored with mixed-precision post-training quantization: most linear layers use INT4, the output head uses INT8, and input embeddings use INT16. Since the training setup assumes FP32 activations and FP32 matmul kernels, weights are dequantized on demand: quantized weights live off-chip, are materialized into FP32 only for the current forward or backward operation, and are immediately released afterward. Second, the paper introduces a checkpointing scheme that combines selective activation rematerialization with off-chip tensor offloading. The transformer is represented as an ordered sequence of compute nodes, such as embedding, decoder blocks, and output layer. Only selected boundary activations are cached, intermediate activations are recomputed during backward, and weights or tensors are loaded and evicted as needed. This differs from standard activation checkpointing because it jointly schedules recomputation and off-chip storage. Third, the output-side memory is reduced through softmax approximation over semantically relevant token subsets and logits masking. The contribution is best understood as an execution strategy for constrained training rather than a new adaptation objective.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Llama-3.2 3B and Qwen-2.5 3B. The default setup is batch size 1, FP32 compute, LoRA rank 16, and LoRA adapters on query and value projections. Peak memory is profiled on an A100 80GB GPU to isolate method-level memory behavior. For Llama-3.2 3B with a 2048-token context, the reported peak memory drops from 26.20GB to 1.02GB. With a 16384-token context, the system requires 6.95GB. Quantization alone reduces the Llama-3.2 3B model footprint from 5.98GB to 2.59GB, but the profiling results show that activations still dominate memory at long context lengths, especially beyond 8K tokens. This supports the paper’s main design choice: weight compression is necessary, but activation checkpointing and offloading provide the main leverage for long-context edge fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Start with Table 1 for the combined memory reductions, then Table 3 for the decomposition between parameter and activation memory. In the method section, focus on Algorithm 1 for on-the-fly dequantization and Algorithm 2 for the checkpointing/offloading schedule. The softmax approximation and logits masking sections can be read more quickly, with attention to possible quality trade-offs or task dependence. If deployment is the main interest, check Section 4.6 for mobile-hardware measurements; otherwise, the most useful part is the memory breakdown and training execution plan.

recommendation.zh: 端侧微调的工程优化组合拳，对关注极致内存优化的系统研究员有参考价值，但对预训练算法启发有限。
recommendation.en: A combination of engineering optimizations for on-device fine-tuning; useful for system researchers focusing on extreme memory optimization, but limited inspiration for pretraining algorithms.

paper.title: Beyond Uniform Forgetting: A Study of Sequential Direct Preference Optimization Across Preference Settings
paper.abstract: Aligning language models with human preferences often requires optimising multiple behavioural objectives. A practical approach is to apply these objectives sequentially using preference optimisation methods such as Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO), but it remains unclear whether later training uniformly degrades preferences learned earlier or whether the effect depends on the relationship between objectives. We study sequential DPO across four preference settings covering distributional con

summary.core_problem: 在多目标对齐里，常见做法是按阶段顺序用 DPO 之类的偏好优化方法逐个加入新目标。核心问题是：后续阶段会不会“均匀遗忘”前一阶段学到的偏好？遗忘到底来自目标间的直接冲突（梯度对抗），还是更间接的分布漂移、信号强弱不均、参数漂移等机制？
summary.importance: 属于 post-training 研究，但对“持续对齐/增量对齐”很实用：它把 sequential DPO 的退化现象拆成不同偏好关系类型（冲突、交互、强安全信号、兼容质量目标），并用 pair-level 的 margin 轨迹而不是只看 aggregate 指标，给出更细的诊断视角。对预训练研究的间接启发在于：pretrain→posttrain 接口里，后续目标注入不一定表现为简单的梯度冲突；如果要做 continual pretrain / mid-train / 多阶段对齐，评估与诊断需要更细粒度的“样本级行为变化”工具。
summary.technical_approach:
实验设定围绕 sequential DPO：在同一个基座（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）上，用 LoRA 适配器按阶段做 DPO，每个阶段结束都在所有目标上评估，并固定同一个 base-model reference 来计算相对指标，避免 reference 漂移带来的混淆。
方法上的关键点有三类：
1) 多种偏好关系设置：覆盖分布冲突（distributional conflict）、多属性交互（multi-attribute interaction）、强安全信号（strong safety signal）、以及兼容的质量目标（compatible response-quality）。并在每种设置里比较不同训练顺序。
2) 评估指标：除了 aggregate 的相对偏好准确率/相对 reward margin，还引入 pair-level 诊断——跟踪每个 chosen–rejected 对在不同 checkpoint 的 length-normalized policy margin 变化，观察哪些样本对在“遗忘/迁移”。
3) 机制检验：直接测量 sequential 训练中不同目标梯度的 cosine similarity，并结合 LoRA adapter 的参数移动，判断是否存在显著的梯度对抗。论文的主要机制结论是：Stage 2 更新与 Stage 1 目标大多近似正交，暗示偏好变化更多来自间接漂移或信号不平衡，而不是持续的直接梯度冲突。
summary.experiments: 基座为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，采用 LoRA 做阶段式 DPO；在四类偏好设置、两种目标顺序下，逐阶段评估所有目标，并做 pair-level margin 轨迹分析与梯度相似度统计。论文在摘要与引言中给出的定性结论是：不存在单一“均匀遗忘”模式，表现从部分退化、稳定、重分配到正迁移不等，且与目标关系、信号强度、训练顺序相关。当前提供的正文片段未包含具体数据表（每阶段提升/下降幅度、训练步数、数据量、LoRA rank、margin 分布统计等），因此无法可靠复述精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看实验设定：四种 preference setting 的具体数据来源与标注协议差异，顺序如何排列；这决定了“冲突/兼容”的定义是否站得住。
- 重点看 pair-level margin 分析那一节：它比 aggregate 指标更能解释“哪些样本在变、怎么变”。
- 再看梯度 cosine similarity 的测量细节：是在同一 batch 上算、还是跨数据集算；LoRA 参数空间下如何对齐梯度；这些会影响“近似正交”的可信度。
- 最后看讨论：如果梯度不冲突但仍退化，作者给出的替代解释（分布漂移、信号强弱、间接参数漂移）是否有额外证据或消融支持。

summary_en.core_problem: Sequentially applying DPO to optimize multiple preference objectives is common in practice, but it is unclear whether later stages uniformly degrade earlier preferences, and whether any degradation is driven by direct objective conflict (gradient opposition) versus indirect effects like distribution shift, signal imbalance, or parameter drift.
summary_en.importance: A post-training study with practical implications for continual/incremental alignment. Its main value is diagnostic: it shows sequential DPO does not induce a single, uniform forgetting pattern, and it introduces pair-level margin tracking to reveal heterogeneous changes hidden by aggregate metrics. For pretraining researchers, the indirect takeaway is about the pretrain↔posttrain interface: multi-stage objective injection may look like drift rather than explicit gradient conflict, so evaluation tooling needs to be sample-level and stage-aware.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They run sequential DPO on a fixed base model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) using LoRA adapters, evaluating after each stage on all objectives while keeping a fixed base-model reference to avoid confounds from a moving reference.
Key methodological components:
1) Four preference settings capturing different relationships between objectives: distributional conflict, multi-attribute interaction, strong safety signal, and compatible response-quality objectives, each tested under both objective orderings.
2) Metrics beyond aggregates: in addition to objective-level relative preference accuracy and DPO-style relative reward margins, they track length-normalized policy margins for individual chosen–rejected pairs across checkpoints to localize which pairs degrade or improve.
3) Mechanistic probe: they measure gradient cosine similarity during sequential training (and analyze LoRA adapter movement) to test whether observed preference changes are explained by direct gradient conflict. The reported conclusion is that Stage-2 updates are largely near-orthogonal to the previous objective, suggesting drift/signal imbalance rather than sustained gradient opposition as the primary driver.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with LoRA-based sequential DPO. Across four preference settings and both orderings, they evaluate all objectives after every stage, perform pair-level margin trajectory analysis, and compute gradient similarity statistics. The qualitative findings reported in the excerpt are heterogeneous outcomes ranging from partial degradation to stability, redistribution, or positive transfer depending on objective relationship, signal strength, and ordering. The provided text does not include the main quantitative tables (magnitudes per stage, training steps, dataset sizes, LoRA hyperparameters, margin distribution stats), so exact numbers cannot be cited here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Check the exact definition and construction of the four preference settings (data sources, annotation protocols, and what counts as “conflict” vs “compatible”).
- Focus on the pair-level margin tracking section; it is the most informative part for diagnosing sequential alignment behavior.
- Inspect how gradient cosine similarity is computed (same batch vs cross-dataset, normalization, LoRA parameterization) to judge how strong the “near-orthogonal” claim is.
- Read the discussion/ablations for evidence supporting alternative mechanisms (distribution shift, signal imbalance, indirect drift) beyond gradient conflict.

recommendation.zh: 可看实验设计和 pair-level 分析；结论支持“后训练顺序是 recipe 变量”，但 LoRA+8B 只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the setup and pair-level analysis; it supports treating post-training order as a recipe variable, but LoRA on an 8B model is only a weak signal.

paper.title: Pareto LoRA: Mitigating Modality Imbalance in Unified Multimodal Models via Pareto-Optimal Gradient Integration
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for integrating multimodal understanding and generation within a single autoregressive transformer. However, during multimodal instruction tuning, these models often exhibit pronounced modality imbalance: language gradients dominate optimization, thus leading to lower image generation quality, especially under parameter-efficient fine-tuning such as LoRA. In this work, we systematically analyze modality imbalance in L

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注统一多模态模型在 LoRA 指令微调阶段的模态失衡问题。更具体地说，在同时做文本生成和图像生成时，共享参数上的语言梯度往往显著强于视觉梯度，导致模型在语言侧保留较好能力，但图像生成质量下降更明显。作者要解决的不是一般意义上的多任务冲突，而是在统一 AR 多模态模型、尤其是参数高效微调场景下，如何避免弱模态在优化中被强模态持续压制。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 pretrain 到 post-train 接口的问题，但启发是明确的。统一多模态模型常把“共享 backbone + 统一 token 序列”视为自然设计，然而一旦进入 instruction tuning，优化信号并不天然平衡。论文给出的价值在于把这种失衡从经验现象落到梯度层面，并说明简单调 loss 权重往往不够，因为主导模态、失衡程度会随任务、层和训练阶段变化。对做原生多模态预训练的人来说，这提示了两件事：第一，后训练阶段的梯度结构会反向暴露预训练表示是否真正均衡；第二，如果统一模型在微调时持续出现模态压制，那么预训练目标、tokenizer 设计、loss 归一化和参数分配可能都需要重新审视。量级上，这是一个扎实的优化修补工作，不是新的统一建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Pareto LoRA。作者把文本损失和图像损失视为两个耦合目标，不再直接用固定系数把它们线性相加，而是在每一步 LoRA 更新时，寻找一个对两者都成立的共同下降方向。形式上，设共享可训练参数上的两组梯度分别为 g_txt 和 g_img，目标是在它们的凸包里找最小范数向量；按照 MGDA 的结论，这个向量要么对应 Pareto stationary point，要么给出同时改善两个目标的下降方向。由于这里只有两个目标，最优组合系数可以闭式求解，因此不会引入很重的优化开销。

论文并不是机械地每步都做 Pareto 融合，而是先诊断梯度关系。作者使用两个指标：梯度余弦相似度衡量方向冲突，梯度范数比衡量谁在主导更新。这样做的理由很合理：如果两模态梯度本来方向一致、量级也接近，就没有必要强行干预；真正需要处理的是“方向冲突”或“量级悬殊”导致的压制。这个设计比单纯 loss reweighting 更细，因为 loss 权重只能在标量层面调节，而无法处理不同层、不同阶段、不同 batch 上梯度几何关系的变化。

从 LoRA 视角看，这篇的针对性也比较强。LoRA 只更新低秩增量参数，容量有限，因此一旦共享更新方向长期被语言模态牵引，视觉侧更容易吃亏。Pareto LoRA 等于在有限适配容量下，尽量把每一步更新投到一个更平衡的方向上。它与全参数微调、多任务梯度手术方法的区别在于：目标是统一多模态生成，作用对象是 LoRA 参数，且重点是文本-图像两模态的平衡而不是泛化到任意多任务。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容可以确认几类关键实验结论。第一，作者做了一个很重要的对照：把统一多模态模型与对应的单模态模型分别在同一数据上微调，结果显示视觉侧相对单模态基线的退化明显大于文本侧，说明失衡不是抽象猜测，而是可测的性能差异。第二，作者直接分析了共享参数上的模态梯度，发现四个任务里有三个存在显著梯度失衡，而且梯度量级差异可以达到数量级级别。第三，失衡方向和严重程度会随任务、层和训练阶段变化，这也是固定 α 权重难以奏效的实证依据。

由于当前提供的正文片段没有完整结果表，无法可靠写出具体模型规模、数据集名称、图像生成指标和文本指标的绝对数值，也无法确认 Pareto LoRA 相比 vanilla LoRA、loss reweighting 或其他 gradient balancing 方法的精确提升幅度。精读全文时，最值得抓的数字有四类：1）文本与图像相对单模态基线的性能跌幅；2）不同层上的梯度范数比统计；3）Pareto LoRA 在 interleaved generation 任务上的图像质量提升是否伴随文本能力保持；4）额外计算开销和训练稳定性。

如果论文做了消融，建议重点看：只做 magnitude balancing、只做 conflict handling、以及完整 Pareto 方案三者的差异；还有在不同 rank 的 LoRA 下，方法收益是否更明显。若收益主要集中在低 rank 场景，那就说明它确实是在缓解参数高效微调的容量瓶颈，而不只是一般优化噪声。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看引言和问题分析部分，确认作者如何证明“视觉是被压制的弱模态”，尤其是单模态对照实验和梯度统计图。然后看方法部分关于 bi-objective optimization、MGDA 闭式解、以及何时触发 Pareto 融合的策略。这里决定方法是否只是把现有多目标优化套到多模态 LoRA 上，还是做了针对性设计。

实验部分优先看 Figure 2、Figure 3、Figure 4 这类问题诊断图，再看主结果表和消融。若时间有限，20 分钟左右可以完成主要信息提取。真正值得思考的不是“这个方法能否普遍替代 LoRA”，而是它揭示了统一多模态模型在后训练阶段的一个结构性问题：共享参数并不等于共享受益，尤其当 token 分布、loss 尺度和生成难度差异很大时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies modality imbalance during LoRA-based instruction tuning of unified multimodal models. In interleaved text-image generation, gradients from the language side often dominate the shared parameters, so text capability is preserved much better than image generation quality. The target problem is therefore not generic multi-task interference, but a specific optimization failure mode in unified autoregressive multimodal models under parameter-efficient adaptation: the weaker modality is consistently suppressed by the stronger one.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. Unified multimodal models often assume that a shared backbone and a unified token space are enough to support balanced adaptation. The paper shows that this is not true at the gradient level. Its main value is diagnostic as much as algorithmic: simple loss reweighting is often insufficient because both the dominant modality and the severity of imbalance vary across tasks, layers, and training stages. For researchers working on native multimodal pretraining, this is a useful signal. If instruction tuning repeatedly suppresses one modality, then the issue may trace back to pretraining objectives, tokenizer design, loss normalization, or parameter allocation. The contribution is best viewed as a careful optimization fix rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed method, Pareto LoRA, treats text loss and image loss as two coupled objectives and seeks a shared descent direction instead of combining them with a fixed scalar weight. Let g_txt and g_img be the gradients of the two modality-specific losses with respect to the trainable LoRA parameters. The method searches for the minimum-norm vector in the convex hull of these gradients. By the MGDA result, this vector either corresponds to a Pareto-stationary point or provides a common descent direction that improves both objectives. Because there are only two objectives, the optimal mixing coefficient has a closed-form solution, which keeps the additional optimization overhead modest.

An important detail is that the method is not applied blindly at every step. The paper first diagnoses the relationship between modality-specific gradients using two signals: cosine similarity for directional conflict and gradient magnitude ratio for dominance. This is a sensible design choice. If the gradients are already aligned and similarly scaled, intervention is unnecessary. The problematic cases are those where one modality overwhelms the update or where the two objectives pull in conflicting directions. This is precisely where fixed loss-level weighting is too crude, because it cannot adapt to layer-wise, stage-wise, or batch-wise changes in gradient geometry.

The LoRA-specific angle also matters. Since LoRA updates only low-rank adapters, adaptation capacity is limited. If the shared update direction is persistently driven by language gradients, the vision side is more likely to be underfit. Pareto LoRA can be interpreted as using that limited adaptation budget more carefully by steering each update toward a more balanced direction. Compared with generic gradient surgery methods, the paper is more targeted: unified multimodal generation, LoRA parameters, and text-image balance rather than arbitrary multi-task settings.
summary_en.experiments:
Several key findings are clear from the provided text. First, the paper performs an important control experiment: it fine-tunes unimodal counterparts and compares them against the unified multimodal model on the same data. Vision performance drops much more relative to its unimodal counterpart than text performance does, which makes the imbalance concrete rather than anecdotal. Second, the authors directly inspect modality-specific gradients on shared parameters and find substantial imbalance in three of four evaluated tasks, with gradient magnitudes differing by orders of magnitude. Third, the direction and severity of imbalance vary across tasks, layers, and training stages, which explains why a fixed loss coefficient is often inadequate.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact model sizes, datasets, image-generation metrics, text metrics, and absolute gains over baselines cannot be stated reliably here. In the full paper, the most important numbers to extract are: (1) the relative performance drop of text and image modalities versus their unimodal counterparts; (2) layer-wise gradient norm ratios; (3) whether Pareto LoRA improves image quality while preserving text performance; and (4) the extra compute cost and any effect on training stability.

For ablations, the most informative comparisons would be: magnitude balancing only, conflict handling only, and the full Pareto integration; as well as performance under different LoRA ranks. If the gains are strongest at low rank, that would support the claim that the method is specifically addressing the capacity bottleneck of parameter-efficient multimodal tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the problem-analysis section rather than the final results. The most useful material is the evidence that vision is the suppressed modality: the unimodal-versus-unified comparison and the gradient statistics. Then read the method section for the bi-objective formulation, the closed-form MGDA solution, and the rule for when Pareto integration is actually applied.

In the experiments, prioritize the diagnostic figures first—especially the ones showing performance gaps and gradient imbalance across tasks or layers—then read the main result table and ablations. A 20-minute pass is enough to capture the main idea. The deeper question is not whether this should replace LoRA everywhere, but what it reveals about unified multimodal models: shared parameters do not imply shared benefit, especially when token distributions, loss scales, and generation difficulty differ sharply across modalities.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim 梯度分析部分；若图像分支在 UMM 微调后变差，先复现它的层级梯度诊断再谈新 loss。
recommendation.en: Skim the gradient analysis; if your UMM loses image quality after tuning, reproduce its layerwise gradient diagnostics before inventing another loss.

paper.title: SDS-LoRA: Overcoming Anisotropic Gradient Scaling in Low-Rank Adaptation
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient adaptation of large pre-trained models to downstream tasks by parameterizing weight updates with low-rank matrices. In this paper, we investigate the limitations of the LoRA parameterization from a geometric perspective. Specifically, we show that when a full fine-tuning gradient is backpropagated to the low-rank matrices, it undergoes anisotropic scaling driven by their singular values. We argue that this phenomenon is undesirable because it distorts

summary.core_problem: 解决LoRA参数化在反向传播时存在奇异值驱动的各向异性梯度缩放，导致梯度有效秩降低、与全微调梯度对齐差、性能落后于全微调的问题
summary.importance: 原理分析+方法创新，首次从几何角度揭示LoRA的梯度扭曲机制，提出解耦奇异值的低秩参数化方法，缩小与全微调的性能差距
summary.technical_approach: 提出SDS-LoRA，结构上将低秩矩阵的奇异值与方向分量解耦，避免梯度被主导奇异方向过度加权，保证梯度各向同性缩放
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量与数据集，实验验证SDS-LoRA的梯度有效秩更高、与全微调梯度对齐度更好，显著缩小与全微调的性能gap

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses singular-value-driven anisotropic gradient scaling in LoRA parameterization, which reduces effective gradient rank, worsens alignment with full fine-tuning gradients, and widens the performance gap to full fine-tuning
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis + methodological innovation, first revealing LoRA's gradient distortion mechanism from a geometric perspective, and proposing a singular-value-decoupled low-rank parameterization to narrow the gap to full fine-tuning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SDS-LoRA, which structurally decouples singular values from directional components in low-rank matrices to prevent over-weighting of gradients toward dominant singular directions, ensuring isotropic gradient scaling
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not disclose specific model sizes or datasets; experiments verify SDS-LoRA achieves higher effective gradient rank, better alignment with full fine-tuning gradients, and significantly narrows the performance gap to full fine-tuning

recommendation.zh: 从几何角度拆解LoRA的梯度缺陷，做持续预训练LoRA ablation时可参考其参数化设计，重点看§3的梯度分析部分
recommendation.en: Geometric breakdown of LoRA's gradient flaws; reference its parameterization design for continual pretraining LoRA ablations, focus on §3 gradient analysis

paper.title: FreoStream:Enhancing Stream Guardrails via Future-Aware Reasoning and Safety-Aligned Optimization
paper.abstract: Stream guardrails enable token-level safety detection before full responses are generated. However, they often make overly conservative judgements and block those sensitive but safe tokens, which is known as over-refusal. Due to lack of full context, they also fail to detect implicitly harmful content from jailbreaking. To address these challenges, we propose FreoStream, a novel streaming guardrail framework. Specifically, FreoStream fine-tunes a LoRA module to perform Future-Aware Reasoning whe

summary.core_problem: 流式安全护栏在token级检测中存在过度拒绝（误拦安全但敏感token）和无法检测隐式有害内容的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新——提出未来感知推理范式和安全对齐优化相结合的流式护栏框架，在减少过度拒绝和提升隐式有害检测之间取得平衡
summary.technical_approach: FreoStream通过LoRA微调实现Future-Reason-Judge范式：预测未来token、基于完整上下文推理、做出最终判断；Safety-Aligned Optimization模块从推理梯度中提取安全对齐分量更新基础护栏模型
summary.experiments: 在多个安全基准上测试；对比现有流式护栏方法；验证过度拒绝率降低和隐式有害内容检测率提升

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming safety guardrails suffer from over-refusal (blocking safe-but-sensitive tokens) and fail to detect implicitly harmful content due to lack of full context
summary_en.importance: Method innovation—proposes future-aware reasoning and safety-aligned optimization for streaming guardrails, balancing reduced over-refusal and improved implicit harm detection
summary_en.technical_approach: FreoStream fine-tunes a LoRA module for Future-Reason-Judge paradigm: predict future tokens, reason over full context, make final judgment; Safety-Aligned Optimization extracts safety-aligned components from reasoning gradients to update base guardrail model
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple safety benchmarks; compared against existing streaming guardrail methods; demonstrates reduced over-refusal and improved implicit harmful content detection

recommendation.zh: 流式安全护栏的增量改进，对推理时安全对齐有一定参考但方法不涉及预训练，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on streaming safety guardrails with some relevance to inference-time safety alignment; read abstract only, no pretraining relevance

paper.title: LoRA-Muon: Spectral Steepest Descent on the Low-Rank Manifold
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) significantly reduces compute and memory costs for finetuning Deep Learning models but is often harder to tune than dense training: when using factor-wise optimizers such as AdamW, it is sensitive to initialization choices, its optimal learning rates transfer poorly across ranks, and it often fails to beat dense baselines. We derive LoRA-Muon by applying the Muon optimizer's spectral steepest-descent rule to the low-rank setting. Along with our split weight-decay rule,

summary.core_problem: 现有LoRA微调使用AdamW等因子级优化器时，对初始化敏感、最优学习率跨秩迁移差、性能经常无法超过全参数微调基线
summary.importance: 提出首个针对低秩流形的谱最速下降优化器LoRA-Muon，属于优化器方法创新，解决了LoRA微调的核心工程痛点
summary.technical_approach: 将Muon优化器的谱最速下降规则迁移到低秩设置，配合拆分权重衰减规则，作为全秩Muon/Shampoo系列优化器的低秩代理；设计保证最优学习率可跨秩、宽度、深度、因子缩放迁移
summary.experiments: 在TinyShakespeare数据集上开展计算匹配的对比实验：秩2 LoRA-Muon可恢复全秩训练的最优学习率；秩32 LoRA-Muon的种子平均验证损失低于全参数AdamW基线；同时验证Spectron优化器依赖任意因子缩放的缺陷

summary_en.core_problem: When using factor-wise optimizers like AdamW for LoRA fine-tuning, the method is sensitive to initialization, optimal learning rates transfer poorly across ranks, and performance often fails to outperform full-rank fine-tuning baselines.
summary_en.importance: Proposes LoRA-Muon, the first spectral steepest descent optimizer on the low-rank manifold, belonging to optimizer methodological innovation and solving core engineering pain points of LoRA fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adapts Muon optimizer's spectral steepest descent rule to the low-rank setting, paired with a split weight decay rule, serving as a low-rank proxy for full-rank Muon/Shampoo family optimizers; the design ensures optimal learning rates transfer across rank, width, depth, and factor rescaling.
summary_en.experiments: Compute-matched comparative experiments on TinyShakespeare dataset: rank-2 LoRA-Muon recovers the optimal learning rate of full-rank training; rank-32 LoRA-Muon achieves lower seed-averaged validation loss than full-rank AdamW baseline; also verifies the defect that Spectron optimizer relies on arbitrary factor scaling.

recommendation.zh: LoRA优化的核心突破，学习率跨秩迁移的结论可直接用于内部微调实验，重点看§3的谱下降推导和§4的对比结果
recommendation.en: Core breakthrough in LoRA optimization; the cross-rank learning rate transfer conclusion can be directly applied to internal fine-tuning experiments, focus on §3 spectral descent derivation and §4 comparative results.

paper.title: PRISMR: Overcoming Parse Collapse in Multimodal Listwise Ranking via Parameterized Representation Internalization
paper.abstract: Generative listwise ranking with Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) aims to capture global list context in a single forward pass, but   its effectiveness degrades in long-context multimodal scenarios. We identify a recurring failure mode, parse collapse, where the   autoregressive decoder produces fluent yet incomplete rankings by silently omitting candidates and terminating early. This   failure stems from limited context utilization rather than simple formatting mistakes, making prompt engineering

summary.core_problem: 解决大多模态模型在长上下文 listwise ranking 中生成看似流畅但遗漏候选项、提前结束的 parse collapse 问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 ranking 方法和失败模式分析。它指出了 autoregressive LMM 在长列表结构化输出中的上下文利用缺陷，但整体仍偏向排序应用，对基座预训练的直接增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: PRISMR 用参数化表示内化替代纯 in-context 列表处理。方法用轻量 hypernetwork 并行编码多模态候选项，为每个 item 生成特定 LoRA 权重，再合成为实例级 adapter 注入 LMM，使模型在参数条件化中吸收列表结构，而不是完全依赖临时上下文解析。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集、模型规模、baseline 名称或具体提升。报告的核心实验现象是：prompt engineering 和 constrained decoding 不能充分解决 parse collapse，因为问题来自有限上下文利用；PRISMR 在长上下文多模态 listwise ranking 中更稳健。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses parse collapse in long-context multimodal listwise ranking, where an LMM produces fluent but incomplete rankings by omitting candidates or stopping early.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal ranking method and a failure-mode analysis. The parse-collapse observation is relevant to structured generation with LMMs, but the work remains close to a ranking application and has limited direct value for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRISMR replaces transient in-context list processing with parameterized representation internalization. A lightweight hypernetwork encodes multimodal candidates in parallel, generates item-specific LoRA weights, and synthesizes them into an instance-specific adapter for the LMM, allowing list structure to be internalized through parameter conditioning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, model sizes, baselines, or exact gains. It claims that prompt engineering and constrained decoding are insufficient because parse collapse comes from limited context utilization, and that PRISMR improves robustness in long-context multimodal listwise ranking.

recommendation.zh: 作为 LMM 长列表结构化输出失败案例看摘要即可；hypernetwork-LoRA 想法有趣，但排序场景太窄。
recommendation.en: Use it as a case study of LMM failure on long structured lists; the hypernetwork-LoRA idea is interesting, but the ranking setup is narrow.

paper.title: The Hidden Power of Scaling Factor in LoRA Optimization
paper.abstract: In Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), the scaling factor $α$ is often treated as a mere complement to the learning rate, yet its role in optimization remains poorly understood. In this paper, we reveal that the scaling factor $α$ and the learning rate function differently, with $α$ emerging as the dominant driver of effective optimization, delivering gains that cannot be replicated by learning rate scaling alone. Through the synergy of extensive empirical analysis and a theoretical Signal-Drift framewo

summary.core_problem: 解释 LoRA 中 scaling factor α 的真实优化作用，并判断它是否只是学习率的等价缩放。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练优化分析。它把 LoRA 中常被经验调参处理的 α 单独拿出来，指出 α 与 learning rate 在优化动态上不等价，这对 PEFT recipe、rank 选择和超参迁移有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Signal-Drift 分析框架，把 LoRA 更新拆成任务信号放大与参数漂移两部分；核心判断是 LoRA 的低秩谱抑制会让损失景观更平滑，默认超参偏保守，而增大 α 可以放大有效任务信号，同时不等比例提高漂移风险。论文还给出最优 α 与 rank 的次线性关系，摘要中提到可用平方根形式刻画。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了大规模经验分析，但未给出具体模型规模、任务集合和提升数字。可确认的实验结论包括：单纯放大学习率不能复现增大 α 的收益；α 是更主要的优化驱动因素；最优 scaling factor 随 rank 次线性增长。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what the LoRA scaling factor α actually does in optimization, and whether it is merely interchangeable with the learning rate.
summary_en.importance: This is an optimization analysis for post-training and PEFT. It isolates a hyperparameter that is usually treated as a tuning detail, and argues that α changes the training dynamics in a way that learning-rate scaling cannot reproduce.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a Signal-Drift framework that separates useful task signal amplification from parameter drift. Their main mechanism is that LoRA’s spectral suppression smooths the optimization landscape, making standard hyperparameters conservative; increasing α exploits this smoothness by amplifying task signal without proportionally increasing the drift ratio. They further propose a sublinear, approximately square-root, relationship between the optimal α and the LoRA rank.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive empirical analysis but does not specify model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. The stated findings are that α dominates effective LoRA optimization, learning-rate scaling alone cannot match its gains, and the best α grows sublinearly with rank.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Signal-Drift 推导和 rank-α 曲线；若结论稳，LoRA recipe 里把 α 当学习率别名的习惯该改。
recommendation.en: Read the Signal-Drift derivation and the rank–α curve; if robust, the common habit of treating LoRA α as a learning-rate alias should be dropped.

paper.title: Doc-to-Atom: Learning to Compile and Compose Memory Atoms
paper.abstract: Long input sequences are central to document understanding and multi-step reasoning in Large Language Models, yet the quadratic cost of attention makes inference both memory-intensive and slow. Context distillation mitigates this by compressing contextual information into model parameters, and recent work such as Doc-to-LoRA amortizes context distillation into a single forward pass that generates one LoRA adapter per document. However, producing a single monolithic adapter for all queries leads

summary.core_problem: 现有长文档参数化记忆方法（如Doc-to-LoRA）为每个文档生成单个整体适配器，存在无关查询干扰、组合召回能力差、长文档扩展性弱的问题。
summary.importance: 提出组合式参数记忆框架，通过语义原子拆分和动态路由解决单适配器的干扰问题，提升长文档推理的效率和效果。
summary.technical_approach: 将文档拆分为带语义类型的知识原子，每个原子编译为独立的micro-LoRA适配器和溯源检索键；推理时轻量路由器选择相关原子组装为查询专属适配器。
summary.experiments: 在长文档问答和多步推理任务上，相比Doc-to-LoRA等基线提升准确率，同时降低推理内存开销。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自三星北美山景城AI中心、达特茅斯学院。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing parametric long-document memory methods like Doc-to-LoRA produce one monolithic adapter per document, leading to irrelevant-query interference, poor compositional recall and weak scalability for long-document reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a compositional parametric memory framework that resolves monolithic adapter interference via semantic atom decomposition and dynamic routing, improving long-document reasoning efficiency and accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes documents into semantically typed knowledge atoms, each compiled into an independent micro-LoRA adapter and provenance retrieval key; at inference, a lightweight router selects relevant atoms to assemble a query-specific adapter.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms Doc-to-LoRA and other baselines on long-document QA and multi-step reasoning tasks while reducing inference memory overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Samsung AI Center Mountain View and Dartmouth College.

recommendation.zh: 长文档参数记忆的增量改进，只看Fig2的框架图了解设计思路即可，无需通读全文。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on parametric long-document memory; Fig 2 of the framework design suffices, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Categorical Prior Lock-in: Why In-Context Learning Fails for Structured Data
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as conditional generators for structured data, relying on in-context learning (ICL) to adapt to new distributions without parameter updates. We investigate the limits of ICL for structured generation under distribution mismatch, using high-cardinality tabular data as a controlled test case, and identify a structural failure mode we term \textit{categorical prior lock-in}: the inability of ICL to update the model's prior over token distributions

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：当把指令微调后的通用 LLM 当作结构化数据生成器时，ICL 到底能不能仅靠上下文示例去改写模型对目标分布的先验。论文给出的结论很明确：对高基数、长尾、且标签语义弱的类别特征，ICL 存在一个结构性上限，作者称为 categorical prior lock-in。模型会继续依赖预训练阶段形成的 token-level 先验，而不是按提示中的少量样本去重建新的类别分布。结果不是简单的精度下降，而是少数类直接消失、边缘类别完全不被采样、联合分布也随之失真。这个问题在数值字段上没有同样严重，说明失败点不是“模型不会照着例子生成”，而是“模型无法通过上下文完成全局类别先验重置”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 ICL 的边界讲得更具体了：ICL 对映射关系、格式约束、局部模式有适应能力，但对需要改写全局 token 先验的任务，尤其是高基数类别分布迁移，能力明显不足。第二，这个现象和预训练数据分布、tokenizer 切分、指令模型的解码先验直接相关，因此它不是一个单纯的应用问题，而是预训练表示与后续条件生成之间的接口问题。第三，论文还展示了 LoRA 可以补上这类分布迁移能力，但代价是样本邻近度显著上升，出现更强的记忆和泄漏风险。这一点对“用 PEFT 替代 ICL 做私有数据合成”很有现实意义：分布 fidelity 和 privacy 不是同向变化的。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上并不复杂，但实验设计比较干净。作者选了一个信用卡交易表格数据集，包含 7 个数值特征、4 个类别特征和极低基率的 fraud 标签。其中最关键的是 job 字段有 494 个类别，且分布极度长尾，最常见类别也只占 0.75%。这相当于把模型放在一个很难依赖语义泛化、只能靠分布建模的压力测试里。实验对象是 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3，两者都用统一的 schema prompt，然后比较 zero-shot、1/5/10-shot ICL 和 LoRA 微调。生成时逐条采样 JSON 记录，经过严格的语法与类型校验，不合法就重采，直到得到 1 万条有效样本。评估分三类：一是结构可靠性，用 invalid generation rate；二是统计保真度，用每个字段的 TVD，比对真实与合成边缘分布；三是记忆风险，用 DCR ratio 和 exact duplication rate。作者还单独检查 fraud 基率是否能被重现，并分析联合依赖是否随类别失真而恶化。核心分析点在于：随着 in-context 示例增加，数值字段的 TVD 会稳定下降，但类别字段，尤其是高基数字段，TVD 很快进入平台期，少数类始终采不出来。提示工程在测试范围内无效，说明问题不在 prompt wording，而在模型内部先验无法被上下文覆盖。LoRA 则通过参数更新完成了这种“全局分布重校准”。
summary.experiments: 关键实验信号很一致。数据集里 fraud 真实占比只有 0.58%，job 有 494 个类别且高度不平衡。两种 7B instruct 模型都表现出相同趋势：few-shot ICL 随着示例数从 1 增到 10，数值特征保真度继续改善，但类别特征出现明显天花板，尤其是长尾类别和少数类几乎不被生成。论文强调这不是单个字段的问题，因为类别边缘分布失真会进一步破坏跨字段依赖，例如地理、职业、欺诈标签之间的联合结构。LoRA 训练只用 10% 或 50% 真实数据，就能显著改善 marginal 和 joint fidelity，说明参数更新确实能完成 ICL 做不到的分布迁移。但所有 LoRA 配置的 DCR ratio 都低于 1.0，落入作者定义的潜在记忆风险区间；同时 exact duplication 也需要结合看，意味着模型生成样本更贴近训练记录。论文的一个重要观察是：ICL 的失败不是“样本不够多所以还没学会”，而是随着 shot 增加后类别分布误差不再继续下降，呈现结构性停滞。这个结论比单纯报告下游 utility 更有解释力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Evaluation Framework，先把作者要证明的失败模式、TVD 与 DCR 的定义、以及为什么选高基数 job 字段当 stress test 搞清楚。然后重点看结果图里数值字段和类别字段随 shot 增加的分化趋势，这部分是全文最有信息量的地方。Section 6 的机制分析值得看，它回答的是“为什么 ICL 在这里不工作，而 LoRA 可以”。如果时间有限，先抓三件事：一，job 这类高基数长尾字段的 ceiling 现象；二，LoRA 提升 fidelity 但带来更高邻近度；三，prompt engineering 基本无效。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: when an instruction-tuned LLM is used as a structured data generator, can in-context learning actually shift the model to a new target distribution without parameter updates? The answer is largely no for high-cardinality categorical variables. The authors identify a failure mode they call categorical prior lock-in: the model remains anchored to token-level priors inherited from pretraining and cannot reliably reconstruct a new categorical distribution from a handful of examples in context.
