summary_en.importance: This is a representation-transfer analysis. It decomposes VLA initialization into embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy, and robot-data pretraining. The findings are relevant to how pretrained VLM features transfer into action models, though the connection to LLM foundation pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem. They compare the original pretrained VLM representation, embodied VQA adaptation, LoRA versus full finetuning, and robot-data pretraining. The central message is that preserving the pretrained representation matters, LoRA is more reliable than full finetuning, and staged LoRA-based robot-data pretraining works best among the studied variants.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, exact VLM/VLA backbones, robot-data scale, or quantitative gains. It reports qualitative findings: embodied VQA adaptation is bottleneck-dependent and non-additive across capability domains; LoRA is a more reliable initialization than full finetuning; robot-data pretraining further improves VLA initialization.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验分解和 LoRA-vs-full finetune 结果；它提醒预训练表示被过度重塑会伤迁移，但证据还偏机器人场景。
recommendation.en: Read only the factorized experiments and LoRA-vs-full-finetune result; the useful signal is that over-reshaping pretrained representations can hurt transfer, though the evidence is robotics-bound.

paper.title: Dynamic Model Merging Made Slim
paper.abstract: Model merging enables the reuse of fine-tuned models without joint training or access to original data. Dynamic merging further improves flexibility by selectively activating task-relevant parameters and efficiently composing experts across multiple tasks. However, existing dynamic methods either maintain a full shared model with tiny experts or allocate excessive capacity to experts, leading to suboptimal accuracy--efficiency trade-offs. To address this, we propose DiDi-Merging, a slim dynamic

summary.core_problem: 论文要降低动态模型合并的存储和参数开销，同时保持多任务 fine-tuned model 组合后的效果。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型合并和参数效率方法。它关注在无法访问原始训练数据、也不做联合训练时，如何复用多个 fine-tuned models，并改善动态合并的准确率—存储折中。
summary.technical_approach: DiDi-Merging 把参数预算建模为低秩模块中的可微 rank allocation，在 shared parameters 与 expert parameters 之间自动分配容量；同时加入 data-free refinement 来恢复任务 fidelity。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 DiDi-Merging 在单个 fine-tuned model 的 1.24 倍参数量下可匹配已有动态合并 baseline，在 1.4 倍参数量下超过这些 baseline；相比一些需要超过 2 倍存储的方法更紧凑。实验覆盖视觉和语言任务，但具体模型、数据集和指标未在给定信息中展开。
summary.authors_note: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the storage and parameter overhead of dynamic model merging while preserving performance when composing multiple fine-tuned models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a model-merging and parameter-efficiency method. It studies how to reuse fine-tuned models without joint training or access to original data, improving the accuracy-storage trade-off of dynamic merging.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiDi-Merging formulates parameter budgeting as differentiable rank allocation in low-rank modules, automatically balancing shared and expert parameters. It also adds a data-free refinement step to recover task fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that DiDi-Merging matches prior dynamic baselines at 1.24x the parameters of a single fine-tuned model and surpasses them at 1.4x, while some alternatives require more than 2x storage. Experiments span vision and language tasks, but the provided information does not list specific models, datasets, or metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 工程上可备查，不是预训练问题；只看参数预算和 rank allocation，别把多任务合并结果外推到基座训练。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering reference, not a pretraining paper; read the parameter-budget and rank-allocation parts, but do not extrapolate task merging results to base training.

paper.title: HELLoRA: Hot Experts Layer-Level Low-Rank Adaptation for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) dominates parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, yet most variants target dense architectures. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale parameters at near-constant per-token compute, and their sparse activation patterns create untapped opportunities for more efficient adaptation. We propose Hot-Experts Layer-level Low-Rank Adaptation (HELLoRA), which attaches LoRA modules only to the most frequently activated experts at each layer. This simple mechanism

summary.core_problem: 现有LoRA等参数高效微调方法直接应用于MoE模型时，会给所有专家都添加适配器，造成参数和计算浪费，还可能破坏预训练阶段学习到的专家专业化特性，引入噪声梯度。
summary.importance: 利用MoE模型的稀疏激活特性设计适配的高效微调方案，同时实现参数效率、计算效率和下游性能提升，为大参数量MoE模型的低成本下游适配提供了实用方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HELLoRA层级热专家低秩适配方法，首先用10%左右的目标任务数据做轻量warm-up，统计每个MoE层中各专家的激活频率，仅选择激活频率最高的top-k热专家添加LoRA适配器，冷专家保持冻结；还可结合LoRI方法进一步冻结LoRA的A矩阵，仅更新热专家适配器B矩阵的10%参数，进一步压缩参数预算。
summary.experiments: 在OlMoE-1B-7B、Mixtral-8×7B、DeepSeekMoE三个MoE backbone，数学推理、代码生成、安全对齐三类任务上测试，HELLoRA在参数数量、适配器FLOPs、训练吞吐量均优于标准LoRA、DoRA、LoRI、LoRAMoE等基线，同时下游任务表现更优，即使随机选择专家适配也略优于全专家LoRA。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的MoE专家激活偏斜现象观察、方法部分的HELLoRA两阶段流程、表4的消融实验结果；预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA are directly applied to MoE models, adapters are added to all experts, resulting in parameter and computation waste, and may also damage the expert specialization learned in the pre-training stage, introducing noisy gradients.
summary_en.importance: It designs an adapted efficient fine-tuning scheme leveraging the sparse activation property of MoE models, achieving simultaneous improvement in parameter efficiency, computation efficiency and downstream performance, and provides a practical solution for low-cost downstream adaptation of large-parameter MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: HELLoRA (Hot Experts Layer-level Low-Rank Adaptation) is proposed. First, a lightweight warm-up is performed with about 10% of the target task data to count the activation frequency of each expert in each MoE layer. LoRA adapters are only added to the top-k hot experts with the highest activation frequency, and cold experts remain frozen. It can also be combined with the LoRI method to further freeze the A matrix of LoRA and only update 10% of the parameters of the B matrix in hot expert adapters to further reduce the parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three MoE backbones (OlMoE-1B-7B, Mixtral-8×7B, DeepSeekMoE) and three task families (math reasoning, code generation, safety alignment), HELLoRA outperforms baselines including standard LoRA, DoRA, LoRI, LoRAMoE in parameter count, adapter FLOPs and training throughput, while achieving better downstream task performance. Even random expert selection slightly outperforms full-expert LoRA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the observation of skewed expert activation in MoE models in the introduction, the two-stage pipeline of HELLoRA in the method section, and the ablation results in Table 4; estimated reading time 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 利用 MoE 路由倾斜特性的 PEFT 方法，'只微调热点专家' 的思路很直觉，可作为 MoE post-training 的 baseline 参考。
recommendation.en: A PEFT method exploiting MoE routing skewness; the idea of 'only fine-tuning hot experts' is intuitive and serves as a good baseline reference for MoE post-training.

paper.title: Learning When to Adapt
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, yet its learned correction is static: the same low-rank update is applied to every input. This input-agnostic approach creates an inevitable compromise between adapting to the fine-tuning distribution and preserving pre-trained behavior on inputs outside that distribution, contributing to catastrophic forgetting. We introduce DISeL (Dynamic Input-Sensitive LoRA), which augments LoRA modules with lightweight input

summary.core_problem: LoRA等参数高效微调方法的核心缺陷是其学习到的修正为输入无关（input-agnostic）：相同的低秩更新被应用于所有输入，导致在微调域适配和预训练行为保留之间存在不可避免的折衷，是灾难性遗忘的重要成因。
summary.importance: 提出了一种减轻微调灾难性遗忘的实用方案，通过输入依赖的门控机制实现选择性激活，在不显著增加参数和计算开销的前提下改善了适配与保留的权衡。该方法还能通过门控激活模式揭示任务特定知识在网络中的层间定位，对理解LLM微调动态有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: DISeL（Dynamic Input-Sensitive LoRA）在LoRA的每个秩一分量上增加了一个轻量级的输入依赖门控，输出范围在[0,1]之间。门控初始化为接近零，意味着训练从预训练模型行为开始，仅在能降低微调损失时才被激活。每个秩一分量独立门控，相比Mixture-of-LoRA方法（路由整个LoRA模块）更精细。与Gated LoRA（针对多任务间干扰）不同，DISeL的设计目标明确指向保留预训练域行为，通过使适配器在微调分布外输入上处于非活跃状态来减少遗忘。
summary.experiments: 在Llama和Mistral系列模型上针对数学推理和代码生成任务进行了评测。DISeL相比LoRA及其变体（如DoRA、AdaLoRA）持续降低了灾难性遗忘程度，同时保持了与之相当的域内精度。门控激活模式分析显示了不同层在微调过程中的参与程度差异，提供了任务特定知识定位的直接洞察。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第2章的线性回归最小模型分析（清晰展示了输入无关更新为何必然导致适配-保留折衷）、第3章的门控机制设计（初始化策略和前向传播方式）、以及第5章的门控激活可视化（层间定位分析）。预计阅读时间30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: A core limitation of LoRA and other parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods is that their learned corrections are input-agnostic: the same low-rank update is applied to every input, creating an inherent trade-off between adaptation to the fine-tuning distribution and preservation of pre-trained behavior on out-of-distribution inputs—a major contributor to catastrophic forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Presents a practical approach to mitigating catastrophic forgetting in fine-tuning. The input-dependent gating mechanism enables selective activation, improving the adaptation-retention trade-off without significant parameter or compute overhead. The gate activation patterns also provide a window into the layer-wise localization of task-specific knowledge, offering insights into LLM fine-tuning dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: DISeL (Dynamic Input-Sensitive LoRA) augments each rank-one component of LoRA with a lightweight input-dependent gate whose output lies in [0,1]. Gates are initialized close to zero, so training begins with the pre-trained model's behavior intact, and gates activate only when doing so reduces the fine-tuning loss. Each rank-one component is independently gated, offering finer granularity than mixture-of-LoRA approaches that route entire modules. Unlike Gated LoRA which targets inter-task interference in multi-task fine-tuning, DISeL explicitly aims to preserve pre-training-domain behavior by rendering the adapter inactive on inputs outside the fine-tuning distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Llama and Mistral models fine-tuned for mathematical reasoning and code generation. DISeL consistently reduces catastrophic forgetting compared to LoRA variants (DoRA, AdaLoRA) while maintaining competitive in-domain accuracy. Gate activation analysis reveals differential layer participation during fine-tuning, providing direct insight into task-specific knowledge localization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim guidance: Focus on Section 2's minimal linear regression model analysis (cleanly demonstrates why input-agnostic updates force an adaptation-retention trade-off), Section 3's gating mechanism design (initialization strategy and forward propagation), and Section 5's gate activation visualization (layer localization analysis). Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看门控设计和遗忘评测；若 OOD 保留集设置干净，这个动态 LoRA 是 continual post-train 的可复现 baseline。
recommendation.en: Read the gating design and forgetting evaluation; if the OOD retention sets are clean, DISeL is a useful baseline for continual post-training.

institutions: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security

paper.title: Always Learning, Always Mixing: Efficient and Simple Data Mixing All The Time
paper.abstract: Data mixing decides how to combine different sources or types of data and is a consequential problem throughout language model training. In pretraining, data composition is a key determinant of model quality; in continual learning and adaptation, it governs what is retained and acquired. Yet existing data mixing methods address only one phase of this lifecycle at a time: some require smaller proxy models tied to a single training phase, others assume a fixed domain set, and continual learning la

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：数据混合不应只被当作预训练前的一次性配方搜索，而应被当作贯穿预训练、持续中训练、指令微调的在线决策问题。已有方法通常需要训练大量小模型代理，在候选 mixture 上拟合 scaling law；这在 domain 数量增加时计算量迅速上升，而且默认 domain 集合固定。实际训练流程中，新语料、新任务、新能力需求会不断出现，数据混合同时承担“学新数据”和“保留旧能力”的职责。OP-Mix 要解决的就是在数据集合持续变化时，如何低成本、在线地估计当前模型最合适的数据配比。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要在两个层面。第一，它把 data mixing 从离线超参搜索推进到在线训练策略：配比不再只依赖训练前的小模型外推，而是根据当前模型状态重新估计。第二，它把预训练、持续中训练、指令微调放到同一个混合框架里处理，说明 data mixture 可以作为跨阶段的控制变量。贡献量级属于实用算法层面的改进，不是新的语言建模目标，但很贴近大规模训练中的真实瓶颈。对基座训练团队来说，价值在于减少 proxy 训练开销，并为新 domain 接入、能力维持、持续训练提供一套统一接口。
summary.technical_approach: OP-Mix 的关键设计是“on-policy proxy + LoRA interpolation”。给定当前模型和 m 个数据 domain，算法不再为每个候选 mixture 训练单独的小模型，而是对每个 domain 从当前模型出发训练一个 LoRA adapter。这个 adapter 表示当前模型如果朝该 domain 继续训练，会产生怎样的参数更新。随后，OP-Mix 对这些 domain-level LoRA 进行线性插值，用插值后的 adapter 近似不同数据配比下的训练效果，再在用户指定的目标函数上搜索 mixture。目标函数可以是多个评测指标的加权和；需要最大化的指标会被取负，从而统一成最小化问题。与传统 proxy scaling-law 方法相比，区别在于：传统方法在 simplex 上采样多个 mixture，再训练较小参数量、较少 token 的代理模型来拟合性能曲面；OP-Mix 只需每个 domain 一个 LoRA，并且这些 LoRA 都从当前模型出发，因此代理信号更贴近当前训练状态。新 domain 到来时，只需额外训练一个 LoRA 并重新拟合 mixture，不需要重做固定 domain 假设下的大量 proxy 实验。这个设计也解释了为什么它能用于持续学习：旧 domain 和新 domain 都以 adapter 形式进入同一个 mixture 搜索过程，算法可以显式权衡保留与适应。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个阶段。预训练阶段，OP-Mix 相比不做数据混合的设置，平均 perplexity 改善 6.3%；同时达到最强数据混合基线的性能，并节省 14% 计算量。持续中训练阶段，OP-Mix 在明显低于完整重训的成本下，达到接近完整重训的效果，说明它能用较少额外训练处理新数据接入。持续指令微调阶段，OP-Mix 可以叠加在标准 SFT 上，也可以与 on-policy self-distillation / SDFT 组合。单独使用 OP-Mix 时，它以 95% 更少计算恢复了 SDFT 的收益；与 SDFT 组合后还能继续提升，说明数据配比和训练目标是相对独立的改进轴。文中给出的关键消融信号是：单个 domain LoRA 加线性插值足以替代大量 candidate mixture proxy run；on-policy 训练使代理更贴近当前模型，而不是依赖预先训练的小模型外推。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 和 Background 中对 data mixing 问题的形式化定义，尤其是 domain 集合、mixture 向量、用户目标函数 F 的设定。这部分决定了 OP-Mix 为什么能跨预训练、中训练、SFT 使用。方法部分重点看每个 domain LoRA 的训练方式、LoRA 线性插值如何近似 mixture loss surface、以及 mixture 搜索的具体流程。实验部分优先看三类训练阶段的主结果表，以及计算成本对比；这些结果回答了 OP-Mix 是否只是省计算，还是能在保持性能的同时处理新增 domain。消融实验里最值得深挖的是 on-policy proxy 与传统小模型 proxy 的差异、LoRA rank 和 domain 粒度对 mixture 估计的影响、以及目标函数权重变化时的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The central problem is data mixing under a changing training lifecycle. Existing methods usually treat mixture selection as an offline pretraining-time search problem: sample candidate mixtures, train small proxy models, fit a predictive law, and extrapolate. That setup becomes expensive as the number of domains grows, and it assumes that the domain set is fixed. Real training pipelines are not fixed. New corpora, tasks, and capability targets arrive during midtraining and instruction tuning. OP-Mix addresses the question of how to estimate a good mixture online, from the current model state, while allowing the set of domains to expand.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is practical but important for foundation-model training. It reframes data mixture selection as an online control problem rather than a one-off pretraining recipe. The same algorithm is used for pretraining, continual midtraining, and continual instruction tuning, so data mixture becomes a shared interface across stages. For pretraining researchers, the main value is reduced proxy-model cost and a cleaner mechanism for introducing new domains without restarting a large mixture-search pipeline. It does not introduce a new language-modeling objective, but it targets a real scaling bottleneck in data curation and continual training.
summary_en.technical_approach: OP-Mix combines on-policy domain adapters with linear adapter interpolation. For each data domain, the method trains one LoRA adapter starting from the current model. This adapter approximates the update direction induced by training on that domain at the model’s current state. Candidate mixtures are then simulated by linearly interpolating these domain LoRAs, using the interpolated adapter as a proxy for the loss surface under full mixture training. A user-defined objective aggregates evaluation metrics, with maximization metrics negated so that mixture search can be posed as minimization. Compared with proxy scaling-law approaches that train many smaller models on sampled mixtures, OP-Mix needs only one adapter per domain and stays on-policy with the model being trained. When a new domain is introduced, the algorithm trains another domain adapter and refits the mixture, instead of rebuilding the whole proxy-model grid. This is also why the method naturally applies to continual learning: old and new domains are represented in the same mixture optimization problem.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans pretraining, continual midtraining, and continual instruction tuning. In pretraining, OP-Mix improves average perplexity by 6.3% over a no-mixing baseline, while matching the strongest reported data-mixing baseline with 14% less compute. In continual midtraining, it reaches the performance of full retraining at a much lower cost. In continual instruction tuning, OP-Mix can be applied on top of standard SFT and can also be combined with on-policy self-distillation. Used alone, it recovers the gains of self-distillation fine-tuning with 95% less compute; combined with SDFT, it gives additional gains. The main experimental signal is that one LoRA per domain plus interpolation is a sufficiently accurate proxy to avoid many candidate-mixture training runs, and that the on-policy nature of the proxy matters for stages beyond initial pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the problem formulation in the introduction and background carefully, especially the definition of domains, mixture vectors, and the weighted objective over evaluation metrics. That formulation explains why the method can be reused across pretraining, midtraining, and SFT. In the method section, focus on how domain LoRAs are trained, how linear interpolation is used to approximate mixture training, and how the mixture is optimized. In the experiments, prioritize the main result tables for the three lifecycle stages and the compute comparisons. The most useful ablations are likely those separating on-policy adapters from conventional proxy models, testing LoRA rank and domain granularity, and measuring robustness to different objective weights.

recommendation.zh: 应优先看方法和 ablation：若 adapter 插值能稳定预测 mixture，数据配比搜索成本会少一层 proxy 噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations first: if adapter interpolation reliably predicts mixture quality, data-recipe search loses one noisy proxy-training layer.

paper.title: DealMaTe: Multi-Dimensional Material Transfer via Diffusion Transformer
paper.abstract: Recently, diffusion-based material transfer methods rely on image fine-tuning or complex architectures with auxiliary networks but face challenges such as text dependency, additional computational costs, and feature misalignment. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{DealMaTe}, using \underline{\textbf{de}}pth, norm\underline{\textbf{a}}l, and \underline{\textbf{l}}ighting images for \underline{\textbf{ma}}terial \underline{\textbf{t}}ransf\underline{\textbf{e}}r. DealMaTe is a simpli

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion material transfer 对文本提示、参考网络和复杂辅助结构依赖较强，导致条件不稳、特征错位和推理开销偏高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像/材质生成方法改进：用几何和光照条件替代文本引导，并通过轻量 LoRA 和注意力改造降低多条件控制成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DealMaTe，使用 depth、normal、lighting 图作为材料迁移条件；设计 Multi-Dim 3D Shader LoRA，在不改 base model 权重的情况下接入兼容控制信号；再用 Shader Causal Mutual Attention 和 KV caching 减少多条件推理延迟。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练数据规模、backbone、baseline 和定量指标；声称相比依赖图像微调、文本或参考网络的方法，结果更协调稳定，并改善多条件推理效率。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsinghua University、Pengcheng Laboratory、National Cheng-Kung University、Great Bay University 等；这是图形与视觉生成方向工作，不是通用多模态基座预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses diffusion-based material transfer methods that depend on text prompts, reference networks, or complex auxiliary modules, causing unstable control, feature misalignment, and higher inference cost.
summary_en.importance: It is an image/material-generation method contribution: geometry and lighting conditions replace text guidance, while lightweight LoRA and attention modifications reduce the cost of multi-condition control.
summary_en.technical_approach: DealMaTe conditions on depth, normal, and lighting images. Multi-Dim 3D Shader LoRA injects compatible 3D control signals without modifying the base model weights, while Shader Causal Mutual Attention and KV caching reduce latency under multiple conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide training scale, backbone details, baselines, or numerical metrics. It claims more harmonious and stable material transfer than methods relying on image fine-tuning, text guidance, or reference networks, with improved inference efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University, Pengcheng Laboratory, National Cheng-Kung University, Great Bay University, and related labs. The work sits in graphics and visual generation rather than foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看条件注入和注意力缓存设计即可；它是图像生成工程改进，不会改变语言建模判断。
recommendation.en: Skim only the condition-injection and attention-caching design; this is an image-generation engineering paper, not a language-modeling signal.

institutions: Dongguan Key Laboratory for Intelligence and Information Technology

paper.title: PreFT: Prefill-only finetuning for efficient inference
paper.abstract: Large language models can now be personalised efficiently at scale using parameter efficient finetuning methods (PEFTs), but serving user-specific PEFTs harms throughput, even with specialised kernels and memory management techniques. This is because, theoretically and empirically, a mismatch exists between prefill (processing a large number of tokens at once) and decode (generating a single token autoregressively): the latter has far lower throughput when serving multiple adapters. Rather than

summary.core_problem: 多用户个性化场景下，批量服务多个PEFT适配器时，解码阶段的内存开销会大幅降低推理吞吐量，现有定制内核、内存调度等优化方式无法彻底解决该问题。
summary.importance: 从PEFT设计的源头适配推理效率需求，而非在现有架构上做增量优化，为多租户LLM服务的PEFT设计提供了新的优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Prefill-only Finetuning（PreFT），仅在预填充阶段激活PEFT适配器，解码阶段完全丢弃适配器。分别实现了基于LoRA和ReFT的PreFT变体，适配vLLM推理引擎和trl训练库。该方法利用预填充阶段为计算绑定、适配器加载不会降低利用率的特性，避开了解码阶段内存绑定、多适配器开销大的痛点。
summary.experiments: 在4张H100上部署Llama 3.1 70B、服务最多512个适配器时，无需定制内核，预填充-only ReFT的吞吐量是多LoRA服务的1.9倍，预填充-only LoRA达到1.87倍；在更小参数量模型上增益更高，Llama 3.1 8B上分别达到2.21倍和1.83倍。下游任务上，PreFT在SFT场景的精度和全位置PEFT无统计显著差异，RL场景的数学推理、代码生成性能接近全位置PEFT，长文本生成的长度控制能力和传统LoRA相当。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章的动机分析、第3章的PreFT方法定义、第4~5章的核心实验结果即可，预计阅读时间15分钟，不需要深入看内核实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-user personalization scenarios, serving multiple PEFT adapters in batch incurs high memory overhead during the decode phase, which significantly reduces inference throughput. Existing optimizations including custom kernels and memory scheduling cannot fully resolve this issue.
summary_en.importance: PreFT adapts PEFT design to inference efficiency requirements from the source, instead of making incremental optimizations on existing architectures, providing a new optimization direction for PEFT design in multi-tenant LLM serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: PreFT (Prefill-only Finetuning) only activates PEFT adapters during the prefill phase, and discards adapters completely during the decode phase. PreFT variants based on LoRA and ReFT are implemented, compatible with the vLLM inference engine and trl training library. It leverages the characteristic that the prefill phase is compute-bound and adapter loading does not reduce utilization, avoiding the pain point that the decode phase is memory-bound and suffers from high multi-adapter overhead.
summary_en.experiments: When serving up to 512 adapters on Llama 3.1 70B with 4 H100s, without custom kernels, prefill-only ReFT achieves 1.9x throughput of multi-LoRA serving, and prefill-only LoRA reaches 1.87x. Gains are higher on smaller models: 2.21x and 1.83x respectively on Llama 3.1 8B. On downstream tasks, PreFT has no statistically significant accuracy difference from full-position PEFT in SFT scenarios, performs close to full-position PEFT on mathematical reasoning and code generation in RL scenarios, and has equivalent length control ability as traditional LoRA for long-form generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the motivation analysis in Chapter 1, PreFT method definition in Chapter 3, and core experimental results in Chapters 4-5. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes. No need to dive into kernel implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统分析和消融即可；它不会改变预训练方法，但会改变你评估 PEFT 个性化是否可部署的标准。
recommendation.en: Skim the systems analysis and ablations; it does not change pretraining, but it changes how deployable PEFT personalization should be judged.

paper.title: Think When Needed: Adaptive Reasoning-Driven Multimodal Embeddings with a Dual-LoRA Architecture
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as a powerful backbone for multimodal embeddings. Recent methods introduce chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning into the embedding pipeline to improve retrieval quality, but remain costly in both model size and inference cost. They typically employ separate reasoner and embedder with substantial parameter overhead, and generate CoT indiscriminately for every input. However, we observe that for simple inputs, discriminative embeddings already perf

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 embedding 检索中 CoT 推理成本高、且对简单样本可能产生负迁移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态检索/embedding 系统的效率和训练设计改进，不是基座预训练方法。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察到“推理并非总是改善表示”，这对把 reasoning trace 接入表示学习有一定提醒。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Think When Needed：在一个冻结的多模态骨干上挂载 reasoning LoRA 和 embedding LoRA 两个适配器，用 dual-LoRA 共享主体参数；在 reasoning 与 embedding 接口处做梯度截断，降低联合优化的梯度冲突；同时根据输入难度自适应决定是否生成推理过程，而不是对所有样本无差别引入 CoT。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练数据和具体 benchmark 数字。已知实验目标是多模态检索质量与推理成本，比较对象应包括无推理 embedding、固定 CoT 推理 embedding、以及分离 reasoner/embedder 的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost and potential negative transfer of using chain-of-thought reasoning for every input in multimodal embedding and retrieval.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an efficiency and training-design improvement for multimodal retrieval embeddings, not a foundation-model pretraining result. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is the claim that explicit reasoning can harm representation quality on easy inputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Think When Needed uses a frozen multimodal backbone with two LoRA adapters, one for reasoning and one for embedding. It detaches gradients at the interface to reduce conflicts under joint optimization, and it adaptively decides whether an input needs reasoning instead of always generating CoT.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model size, training data, benchmarks, or exact gains. The intended comparisons are against non-reasoning embeddings, always-on CoT embedding pipelines, and separate reasoner-embedder systems.

recommendation.zh: 作为“reasoning trace 可能污染表示”的弱证据即可，不必读正文；若做多模态 embedding，可看方法图。
recommendation.en: Treat it as weak evidence that reasoning traces can pollute embeddings; no need to read beyond the method figure unless working on multimodal retrieval.

paper.title: GPart: End-to-End Isometric Fine-Tuning via Global Parameter Partitioning
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of large language models (LLMs). However, its bilinear structure introduces a critical limitation: the mapping from trainable parameters to weight updates is not distance-preserving, distorting the optimization landscape. Methods that project a low-dimensional vector into LoRA's parameter space, such as Uni-LoRA, improve parameter efficiency, but the subsequent bilinear LoRA map breaks end-to-e

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个比常见 PEFT 论文更底层的问题：LoRA 之所以高效，不只是因为参数少，也因为它把优化限制在低秩子空间里；但这个低秩双线性参数化会扭曲训练坐标与真实权重更新之间的几何关系。换句话说，优化器看到的是 A、B 因子空间里的欧氏距离，而真正作用在模型上的更新是 BA，这个映射不是等距的。GPart 要解决的就是这个 end-to-end geometry mismatch：在同样极低参数预算下，能否直接在全权重空间中定义一个随机低维子空间，并保持从可训练向量到权重更新的整体等距映射，从而去掉 LoRA 的低秩瓶颈和几何失真。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员来说，这篇论文的价值不在于它会替代全量训练，而在于它把一个常被忽略的问题讲清楚了：参数高效微调不仅是“更新多少参数”，也是“用什么坐标系更新”。LoRA 的成功让很多人默认低秩结构本身就是合理归纳偏置，但 GPart 提醒我们，低秩并不只是压缩，还会改变优化几何。这个视角和 intrinsic dimension、随机子空间训练、continual adaptation 都有直接关系。若一个简单的全局随机分组映射，在极低预算下能稳定接近甚至超过 LoRA/Uni-LoRA，说明下游适配所需的关键未必是低秩结构，而可能只是一个足够合适、几何更干净的低维子空间。对基座训练的启发有两层。第一，后训练接口设计不应只看参数量和吞吐，也要看更新参数化是否与预训练权重空间的局部几何匹配。第二，若随机全局子空间已经足够强，说明预训练模型的可适配性可能高度冗余，这对研究 layerwise plasticity、模块化更新、甚至 mid-training 冷却阶段的可塑性都有参考意义。贡献量级上，它是一个思路清楚、理论动机比经验技巧更扎实的 PEFT 方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: GPart 的核心设计很简单，但背后的取舍很明确。LoRA 对每个权重矩阵 W 用低秩分解 BA 表示更新，因此训练变量在因子空间里，真正更新在权重空间里，中间经过双线性映射。Uni-LoRA 虽然进一步把 trainable state 压成一个 d 维向量，再通过随机 partition matrix 投到 LoRA 参数空间，但最后仍然要经过 BA 这一步，所以 end-to-end 仍不等距。GPart 直接绕开这层结构。作者先把所有需要适配的权重矩阵展平并拼接成一个全局向量，长度为 N。然后定义一个 N×d 的稀疏 partition matrix P，但实现上不显式存矩阵，而是用随机种子生成一个全局置换，再把置换后的 N 个参数位置切成 d 个互不重叠的 group。每个原始参数只属于一个 group，每个 group 共享同一个低维坐标分量，并按 group size 做归一化。这样构造后，P 的列互相正交且单位范数，因此 P^T P = I，d 维训练向量到 N 维权重更新的映射是等距嵌入。直观上看，GPart 相当于在全模型范围内做一次随机 tied update：同组参数接收同一个标量更新，但这种 tying 是全局的，而不是局限在单层或某个低秩因子里。它的几个关键点值得注意。第一，global partition 而不是 per-layer partition，这意味着子空间自由度会自动在全模型范围内分配，而不是人为给每层固定 rank。第二，它没有 LoRA 的 rank 超参数，只有 d 控制子空间维度，模型选择更简单。第三，前向和反向都可以通过 assignment map 高效实现，不需要显式构造大矩阵。和 VeRA 相比，GPart 不是冻结随机基再学缩放，而是直接在全权重空间定义随机子空间；和 intrinsic-dimension 训练相比，它强调存储友好和可复现实现；和 Uni-LoRA 相比，它去掉了最关键的几何扭曲源头，即 LoRA 的双线性回映射。
summary.experiments: 从全文片段可确认的实验结论是：在低参数预算下，GPart 在 encoder 和 decoder 两类模型上都与现有 PEFT 方法竞争，并且在自然语言理解和计算机视觉基准上优于 Uni-LoRA 等方法，在 decoder-only 模型和数学推理任务上保持竞争力。作者显然不是只在单一设置上做验证，而是覆盖了 encoder、decoder、NLP、CV 多个场景，目的是说明“几何更干净的随机子空间”不是某个任务偶然有效。实验上最值得关注的不是绝对分数，而是预算曲线。因为这类方法的核心 claim 是在极低 d 下仍然有效，所以应重点看不同 trainable budget 下，GPart 与 LoRA、VeRA、Uni-LoRA 的性能差距如何变化。若优势主要集中在很低预算区间，说明它确实更适合参数极端受限场景；若预算升高后差距缩小，则符合预期，因为高维时参数化失真影响会减弱。理论部分作者证明了 GPart 的等距性，而实验部分应当配合展示优化更稳定、超参数更少、对 rank 选择不敏感等现象。还应注意两个潜在问题。第一，随机分组是否带来较大 seed variance；如果不同 seed 波动很大，方法的可用性会打折。第二，全局 tied update 是否会伤害需要局部精细适配的任务，尤其是生成式 decoder 上的复杂行为控制。当前片段没有给出具体参数量、模型规模和提升幅度，阅读时需要重点查主表、budget sweep 图和 seed ablation。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合认真看方法和实验，不需要在证明细节上停太久。先看 Introduction，作者把 LoRA、Uni-LoRA、GPart 三种参数化的差别讲得很清楚，尤其是“局部等距”和“端到端等距”的区别。然后看 Method 里全局展平、随机置换、partition matrix 构造这几页，理解为什么 P^T P = I，以及为什么 global partition 比 per-layer partition 更自然。理论部分只要抓住一个结论：GPart 在训练子空间内保持欧氏几何，而 LoRA 的 BA 映射不保持。实验部分优先看不同参数预算下的主结果、与 Uni-LoRA/VeRA/LoRA 的对比、以及 seed 或 group 数 d 的消融。预计 35 到 50 分钟可以读完主要内容。若你关心 pretrain-posttrain 接口，这篇最值得深挖的点是：下游适配到底需要结构化低秩先验，还是只需要一个与权重空间几何更一致的低维入口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a deeper issue than standard PEFT efficiency: LoRA is parameter-efficient not only because it trains few parameters, but because it constrains updates to a low-rank bilinear form. That bilinear parameterization distorts geometry. The optimizer moves in factor coordinates A and B, while the actual model update is BA in weight space, and this map is not distance-preserving. GPart asks whether we can keep the trainable budget extremely small while defining the trainable subspace directly in full weight space, so that the mapping from trainable coordinates to weight updates is end-to-end isometric and no longer bottlenecked by low rank.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining researchers, the main value is conceptual. The paper makes explicit that PEFT is not only about how many parameters are updated, but also about which coordinate system the optimizer sees. LoRA’s empirical success has encouraged the view that low rank is a natural adaptation prior, but GPart shows that low rank also imposes geometric distortion. That connects directly to intrinsic dimension, random subspace training, and continual adaptation. If a simple globally randomized subspace can match or beat LoRA-style methods at very low budgets, then the essential ingredient for adaptation may not be low-rank structure itself, but access to a sufficiently expressive low-dimensional subspace with cleaner geometry. Two implications matter. First, post-training interfaces should be evaluated not only by memory and throughput, but by how well their parameterization aligns with local geometry in pretrained weight space. Second, if random global subspaces already work well, pretrained models may have substantial adaptation redundancy, which is relevant to plasticity analysis, selective updates, and even mid-training or cooldown-stage interventions. In contribution scale, this is a well-motivated PEFT paper with stronger geometric reasoning than most purely empirical tweaks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The design is simple and deliberate. In LoRA, each weight update is parameterized as BA, so optimization happens in factor space while the actual update lives in weight space. Uni-LoRA compresses the trainable state further into a d-dimensional vector and maps it into LoRA parameter space with a random partition matrix, but it still ends with the same bilinear BA map, so end-to-end isometry is still broken. GPart removes that intermediate factorization entirely. All adapted weight matrices are flattened and concatenated into a single global vector of length N. The method then defines a sparse N by d partition matrix P, implemented implicitly rather than materialized. A seed-dependent random permutation is applied to the N coordinates, and the permuted coordinates are split into d disjoint groups. Each original parameter belongs to exactly one group, and all parameters in the same group share one trainable scalar, normalized by group size. By construction, the columns of P are orthonormal, so P transpose times P equals the identity. This makes the mapping from the d-dimensional trainable vector to the N-dimensional weight update an isometric embedding. Intuitively, GPart performs a global random tied update across the model: parameters in the same group receive the same scalar update, but the tying is global rather than layer-local or low-rank-factor-specific. Several design choices matter. First, the partition is global rather than per-layer, so the subspace budget is allocated across the whole model instead of forcing a fixed rank per layer. Second, there is no LoRA rank hyperparameter; d alone controls subspace size. Third, both forward and backward passes can be implemented efficiently through the assignment map. Compared with VeRA, GPart does not freeze random bases and learn only scaling vectors; it directly defines a random subspace in full weight space. Compared with intrinsic-dimension training, it is designed to be storage-efficient and practical. Compared with Uni-LoRA, it removes the main source of geometric distortion, namely the bilinear map back to weight space.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided text, the main empirical claim is that GPart is competitive across both encoder and decoder settings, outperforming Uni-LoRA and related PEFT baselines on natural language understanding and computer vision benchmarks at low parameter budgets, while remaining competitive on decoder-only models and mathematical reasoning tasks. The breadth of evaluation matters because the paper is arguing for a parameterization principle, not a task-specific trick. The most important thing to inspect is the budget-performance curve. Since the central claim is about extreme compression, the key question is how GPart compares with LoRA, VeRA, and Uni-LoRA as the trainable dimension d changes. If the gains are concentrated in the very low-budget regime, that would support the geometric argument; if the gap narrows at larger budgets, that would also make sense because parameterization distortion matters less in higher dimensions. The theory section proves isometry, and the experiments should ideally show corresponding practical effects such as more stable optimization, simpler model selection, and reduced sensitivity to rank choices. Two possible weaknesses should be checked carefully. First, random grouping may introduce seed variance; if performance depends heavily on the seed, the method is less attractive in practice. Second, global tied updates may hurt tasks that require fine local adaptation, especially in decoder-only generative settings. The excerpt does not include concrete model sizes, trainable parameter counts, or exact gains, so the main tables, budget sweeps, and seed ablations are the places to verify the strength of the claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: This paper is worth reading more carefully than a typical PEFT tweak, but you do not need to dwell on every proof detail. Start with the introduction, where the distinction between LoRA, Uni-LoRA, and GPart is explained clearly, especially the difference between local isometry and end-to-end isometry. Then read the method section on global flattening, random permutation, and partition-matrix construction. The key point is why P transpose P equals identity and why a global partition is more natural than a per-layer one. In the theory, the main takeaway is enough: GPart preserves Euclidean geometry inside the trainable subspace, while LoRA’s BA map does not. In experiments, prioritize the main results under different trainable budgets, the comparisons against Uni-LoRA, VeRA, and LoRA, and the ablations on seed sensitivity and the choice of d. Around 35 to 50 minutes should be enough to extract the core ideas. From a pretrain-to-posttrain interface perspective, the most interesting question is whether downstream adaptation really needs a structured low-rank prior, or simply a low-dimensional entry point that is geometrically cleaner in weight space.

recommendation.zh: PEFT领域的新范式思路，可关注其等距性设计对微调稳定性的增益，仅阅读方法部分即可
recommendation.en: A new PEFT paradigm with isometric design, check the method section only for insights on fine-tuning stability

paper.title: MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs
paper.abstract: We present MindLab Toolkit (MinT), a managed infrastructure system for Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) post-training and online serving. MinT targets a setting where many trained policies are produced over a small number of expensive base-model deployments. Instead of materializing each policy as a merged full checkpoint, MinT keeps the base model resident and moves exported LoRA adapter revisions through rollout, update, export, evaluation, serving, and rollback, hiding distributed training, serving

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是大规模后训练和在线服务中的模型变体管理问题：当一个基座模型上存在大量 LoRA 策略、RL 实验分支、租户定制版本和回滚点时，传统复制完整 checkpoint 或合并 LoRA 后再服务的流程会在存储、带宽、调度和复现上变得很重。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练算法论文，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有实际启发。随着 RL、在线数据回流和持续训练变成常态，基座模型不再只是一次性训练产物，而是多个策略版本共享的 resident base。MinT 的核心价值在于把 LoRA adapter 作为可训练、可导出、可服务、可回滚的策略单元，减少训练到服务之间移动的对象大小，并让多策略 RL 可以共享同一基座部署。这类基础设施会影响后训练实验速度、reward 迭代频率和策略版本可追踪性。
summary.technical_approach: MinT 采用 adapter-centered workflow。基座模型常驻训练或推理引擎，行为差异由 LoRA adapter 表示。训练完成后，系统不导出完整模型，也不强制合并 LoRA，而是生成 serving-compatible adapter revision。这个 revision 包含固定训练步的 LoRA 权重、服务端张量布局、与 resident base 的兼容性信息、rollout 记录、评测和服务归因信息。系统层面包含队列、准入、放置、故障恢复、adapter 生命周期管理、冷加载调度和回滚。训练侧支持单 worker PEFT 和分布式 Megatron 路径，可在共享基座上 time-slice 多个 LoRA RL 会话。服务侧基于 shared-base vLLM，多 adapter 通过 CPU/GPU hot working set 管理，持久策略命名空间与实际引擎驻留集合分离。对 MoE LoRA，工作使用 packed tensor 表示减少大量小对象加载带来的开销。
summary.experiments: 报告给出三条扩展轴上的系统结果。Scale Up：支持 frontier-scale dense 和 MoE 架构，验证到超过 1T total parameters；还报告了 235B-A22B 规模训练和 1T-class MoE countdown-task 路径。Scale Down：adapter-only handoff 避免完整 checkpoint materialization；在 4B dense 模型上 handoff 步骤减少 18.3×，在 30B MoE 上减少 2.85×；在相同 resident-base allocation 下，并发 multi-policy GRPO 将 wall time 分别缩短 1.77× 和 1.45×，且不增加 peak memory。Scale Out：支持 10^6 级可寻址 policy catalog，单引擎扫过 100K entries，集群级支持 thousand-adapter active waves；packed MoE LoRA tensors 将 live engine loading 提升 8.5–8.7×。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 35–45 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 MinT 与 full fine-tuning、merge-based LoRA 的边界差异。然后看 adapter revision 的定义和生命周期，这部分决定了复现、回滚和在线服务如何接在一起。系统实现部分可重点看 scheduler、serving residency、cold loading 和 packed MoE LoRA 表示。实验部分重点记住 18.3×/2.85× handoff、1.77×/1.45× multi-policy GRPO、8.5–8.7× MoE adapter loading 这几组数字。若只关心预训练，可把它作为持续训练和 RL 实验平台设计的参考，而不是建模方法。
summary.authors_note: 机构显示为 Mind Lab；给定内容未包含作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses infrastructure for managing very large numbers of post-trained LLM variants. When many LoRA policies, RL branches, tenant-specific behaviors, and rollback points share the same base model, moving full checkpoints or serving merged LoRA checkpoints creates heavy storage, bandwidth, scheduling, and reproducibility costs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the interface between base models and continuous post-training. Modern RL and online training pipelines need fast iteration over policy populations that share a resident base model. MinT treats LoRA adapters as first-class policy units that can be trained, exported, served, evaluated, attributed, and rolled back. That changes the operational cost of RL loops and makes policy versioning more explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: MinT uses an adapter-centered workflow. The base model stays resident in training or inference deployments, while behavior changes are represented by LoRA adapters. After training, MinT exports a serving-compatible adapter revision instead of a full checkpoint or a merged model. A revision contains the frozen LoRA payload at a specific step, serving tensor layout, compatibility checks against the resident base, rollout records, evaluation and serving attribution, and rollback state. The system includes queueing, admission control, placement, fault tolerance, adapter lifecycle management, cold-load scheduling, and revision visibility. Training supports both single-worker PEFT and distributed Megatron paths, with time-sliced LoRA RL sessions over shared resident bases. Serving uses shared-base vLLM engines, separates durable policy addressability from CPU/GPU hot working sets, and schedules first-touch adapter loading. For MoE LoRA, packed tensors reduce small-object fanout during live loading.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are system-scale measurements. On the Scale Up axis, MinT is validated on dense and MoE deployments beyond 1T total parameters, including a 235B-A22B-scale training path and a 1T-class MoE countdown-task path. On Scale Down, adapter-only handoff avoids full-checkpoint materialization; the measured handoff step is reduced by 18.3× on a 4B dense model and 2.85× on a 30B MoE model. With the same resident-base allocation, concurrent multi-policy GRPO reduces wall time by 1.77× and 1.45× respectively without increasing peak memory. On Scale Out, the system supports 10^6-scale addressable policy catalogs, single-engine sweeps through 100K entries, and thousand-adapter active waves at cluster scale. Packed MoE LoRA tensors improve live engine loading by 8.5–8.7×.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 35–45 minutes. Start with Figures 1 and 2 to understand how MinT differs from full fine-tuning and merge-based LoRA deployment. Then read the adapter revision lifecycle, because that is where training, serving, evaluation, rollback, and reproducibility meet. In the system sections, focus on scheduling, serving residency, cold loading, and the packed MoE LoRA representation. The key numbers to retain are 18.3× and 2.85× handoff reduction, 1.77× and 1.45× multi-policy GRPO speedup, and 8.5–8.7× faster MoE adapter loading.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution shown in the provided content: Mind Lab. The author list is not included.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 ablation 数字即可；它提醒预训练团队别把 LoRA-RL 的瓶颈误判成训练算子问题。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and ablation numbers; it is a useful reminder that LoRA-RL bottlenecks can be lifecycle and data-movement issues, not just kernels.

paper.title: Continual Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models via Program Memory
paper.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), particularly Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), has become a standard approach for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) under limited compute. However, in continual settings where models are updated sequentially with small datasets, conventional LoRA updates struggle to balance rapid adaptation and knowledge retention. Existing methods typically treat the low-rank space as a homogeneous update region, lacking mechanisms to regulate how short-term updates are con

summary.core_problem: 在持续微调（Continual Fine-Tuning）场景下，传统的 LoRA 更新会将不同任务的知识写入同一个低秩子空间，导致严重的灾难性遗忘和任务间干扰。
summary.importance: 提出了一种结构化的 LoRA 记忆机制，在不增加推理开销的前提下，显著缓解了 LLM 在持续学习中的遗忘问题，为 PEFT 在动态数据流中的应用提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProCL 框架，将 LoRA 适配器划分为多个“程序记忆槽”（Program Memory Slots）。训练时，通过输入条件注意力机制动态检索并组合这些槽，将不同输入的更新路由到不同的参数区域，从而减少干扰。同时，保留原始 LoRA 权重作为稳定的分布式表示。定期将动态组合的权重“巩固”到持久化适配器中。推理时，直接使用合并后的持久化适配器，无需动态路由。
summary.experiments: 在文本分类和问答的持续学习基准上，ProCL 相比现有持续 LoRA 策略（如正交正则化或小波核方法），在知识保留和跨任务泛化上表现更好，且在问答等复杂生成任务中优势更明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对现有 LoRA 持续学习方法局限性的分析，以及 Background 中关于 ProCL 动态路由和巩固机制的数学表达。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In continual fine-tuning scenarios, standard LoRA updates write knowledge from different tasks into the same low-rank subspace, leading to severe catastrophic forgetting and inter-task interference.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a structured memory mechanism for LoRA that significantly mitigates forgetting in LLM continual learning without adding inference overhead, offering a new perspective for PEFT in dynamic data streams.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the ProCL framework, which partitions LoRA adapters into multiple 'program memory slots'. During training, an input-conditioned attention mechanism dynamically retrieves and composes these slots, routing updates for different inputs to distinct parameter regions to minimize interference. The original LoRA weights are maintained as a stable distributed representation. Periodically, the dynamically composed weights are 'consolidated' into a persistent adapter. During inference, this merged persistent adapter is used directly, eliminating the need for dynamic routing.
summary_en.experiments: On continual learning benchmarks for text classification and question answering, ProCL outperforms existing continual LoRA strategies (e.g., orthogonal regularization or wavelet kernel methods) in knowledge retention and cross-task generalization, with particularly pronounced advantages in complex generative tasks like QA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the analysis of limitations in existing continual LoRA methods, and the Background section for the mathematical formulation of ProCL's dynamic routing and consolidation mechanisms. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 结构化LoRA插槽的调度思路可迁移到持续预训练的参数复用场景，重点看内存槽的注意力检索机制即可。
recommendation.en: The scheduling logic of structured LoRA slots can be migrated to parameter reuse in continual pretraining, focus on the attention-based slot retrieval mechanism.

institutions: Deakin Applied AI Initiative, Deakin University

paper.title: Good Agentic Friends Do Not Just Give Verbal Advice: They Can Update Your Weights
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems usually collaborate by exchanging natural-language messages. This interface is simple and interpretable, but it forces each sender's intermediate computation to be serialized into tokens and then reprocessed by the receiver, thereby increasing the generated-token cost, prefill overhead, and KV-cache memory. We study an alternative communication interface: instead of appending a sender's message to the receiver's context, compile the sender's hidden states into a transient

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多智能体 LLM 协作里的一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：agent 之间如果只靠自然语言传递中间结果，发送方已经算出来的内部表征必须先被“翻译”成 token，再由接收方重新编码一遍，导致额外生成开销、prefill 开销和 KV-cache 膨胀。已有 latent communication 虽然绕开了文本，但通常要求发送方和接收方在表示空间上兼容，或者至少要有较强的对齐假设。TFlow 想解决的是：在接收方架构已知且固定的前提下，能不能把发送方的隐藏状态直接编译成接收方的一次性权重扰动，让信息通过“改写本次前向计算”而不是“追加上下文”来传递。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于它提升了某个 benchmark 分数，而在于它提出了一种不同于 text channel 和 latent-state injection 的 agent 通信接口：weight-space communication。这个接口把通信对象从 token/activation 变成 query-specific parameter update，形式上更接近条件化适配器或动态 LoRA。它对预训练研究的启发主要有三点。第一，它提醒人们：模型间协作未必一定要走语言通道，参数空间也可以成为可执行的通信介质。第二，它把“推理时动态参数化”与“多 agent 协作”连在了一起，这对后续研究 inference-time adaptation、test-time routing、甚至 pretrain 阶段的条件化模块设计都有参考价值。第三，它展示了在冻结 backbone 的条件下，仅训练一个 receiver-specific generator 就能获得较明显的效率收益，这对研究低成本协作式系统有现实意义。不过它仍更偏 inference/interface 设计，而不是预训练范式本身，因此放在 skim 是合适的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心很清楚：多个 sender 和一个 receiver 共享同一个冻结 backbone，但通过不同 role prompt 扮演不同角色。给定 query 后，每个 sender 先独立处理输入，作者从 sender 的隐藏状态中提取条件信号，再交给一个可训练的参数生成器。这个生成器不是输出完整权重，而是为 receiver 的目标线性层生成低秩 LoRA 因子，因此通信对象是按层、按模块组织的 transient low-rank perturbation。多个 sender 的贡献会先做融合，再在 receiver 前向时临时 patch 到指定模块中，生成结束后移除，底座参数保持不变。

和文本式 MAS 相比，区别不只是“少生成一些 token”，而是 receiver 完全不需要把 sender 的内容读进上下文，因此省掉了辅助消息的 decode + prefill + cache 成本。和 latent-state transfer 相比，TFlow 不要求 receiver 直接解释 sender 的隐藏状态，也不要求双方共享表示几何；sender state 只作为条件输入，经由 generator 映射到 receiver 自己的参数张量形状中，因此兼容性问题被转移到 generator 学习上。

从实现上看，这个设计有几个关键取舍。第一，作者限定为 fixed receiver setting，也就是接收方架构和注入模块预先已知，这换来了工程可行性，但牺牲了通用性。第二，采用 LoRA 而不是全量动态权重，控制了生成器输出维度和推理时 patch 成本。第三，通信是 query-specific 且 transient 的，不做持久更新，因此不会引入在线遗忘或状态污染。第四，多 sender 的信息融合发生在参数生成阶段，而不是 token 级交互阶段，这意味着它更像一次并行条件化，而不是多轮 deliberation。
summary.experiments:
实验设置是三 agent：两个 sender、一个 receiver，backbone 用冻结的 Qwen3-4B。评测覆盖五个 benchmark，包含 reasoning、knowledge 和 coding 场景。论文给出的主结果有三类。

第一，相对 standalone receiver，TFlow 在五个基准上都有增益，最高可提升 8.5 个 accuracy point。这说明 sender 的内部状态确实被有效转译成了对 receiver 有用的计算偏置，而不是只起到噪声作用。

第二，相对文本式三 agent baseline，效率收益很明显。总 processed tokens 最多减少 83.27%，wall-clock inference time 最多加速 4.6 倍。这个结果和方法设计是对齐的，因为文本通信的主要成本正是额外消息生成和接收方重编码。

第三，如果和 standalone receiver 比，processed tokens 也最多可减少 32.69%。这点比较有意思，说明某些文本式协作为了提升效果需要更长推理链，而 TFlow 用参数扰动替代部分显式语言交换后，可能在更短生成路径上达到接近或更好的结果。

作者还指出 HumanEval+ 是主要例外：TFlow 相比文本式多 agent 存在更明显差距，原因不是通信失败，而是代码生成任务对 generation budget 更敏感。文本 agent 往往能通过更长的显式草稿、反思和修正获益，而 TFlow 压缩了通信 token，却没有等价地补回这部分外显搜索过程。这一点很重要，它说明 weight-space communication 更适合“把已有判断注入接收方”，未必适合需要长程外显探索的任务。

从消融角度，全文重点考察了不同通信接口的比较，以及效率—性能取舍。最值得注意的结论不是绝对分数，而是：在大多数非代码任务上，文本消息里相当一部分信息可以被更紧凑地编译进 receiver 的动态低秩更新中。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，把问题设定和三种通信接口的差异看清：text、latent state、weight perturbation。然后重点看方法部分里参数生成器如何把 sender hidden states 变成 layer/module-specific LoRA 因子，以及这些因子如何在 receiver 前向中临时注入。这里决定了方法是否只是“换个名字的 adapter”，还是确实形成了新的通信接口。

实验部分优先看三类表：一类是和 standalone receiver 的效果对比，一类是和 text-based MAS 的效率对比，一类是 HumanEval+ 这类失败案例。后者尤其值得看，因为它揭示了方法边界：压缩通信不等于保留了所有显式推理过程。

如果阅读时间有限，30 分钟左右足够抓住主线。若要深挖，建议追问三个问题：一，generator 的容量和 receiver 注入层数如何影响性能；二，多 sender 融合是否会出现相互抵消；三，这种 receiver-specific 设计能否扩展到异构 backbone 或预训练阶段的条件化模块。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in multi-agent LLM systems: when agents communicate through natural language, the sender’s intermediate computation must be serialized into tokens and then re-encoded by the receiver. This adds generation cost, prefill latency, and KV-cache growth. Prior latent-space communication avoids text, but usually assumes some representational compatibility between sender and receiver. TFlow asks a different question: if the receiver architecture is fixed and known, can the sender’s hidden states be compiled into a temporary weight perturbation of the receiver, so communication happens by changing computation rather than extending context?
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not a new pretraining objective, but a new communication interface: weight-space communication. The communicated object is neither text nor activations consumed directly by the receiver; it is a query-specific parameter update. That is interesting for foundation-model researchers for three reasons. First, it broadens the design space of model-to-model interaction beyond the language channel. Second, it connects multi-agent collaboration with inference-time dynamic parameterization, which may matter for future work on conditional adaptation, test-time routing, and modular pretraining. Third, it shows that with frozen backbones, training only a receiver-specific generator can deliver substantial efficiency gains. Still, this is more an inference/interface paper than a pretraining paper, so skim is the right level.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup uses multiple senders and one receiver, all instantiated from the same frozen backbone but differentiated by role prompts. For a given query, each sender processes the input once and exposes hidden states. A learned parameter generator consumes these states and emits low-rank LoRA factors for selected linear layers in the receiver. Contributions from multiple senders are fused, and the resulting perturbations are transiently patched into the receiver during generation. After the response is produced, the perturbation is removed and the base weights remain unchanged.

Compared with text-based multi-agent systems, the key difference is not merely fewer tokens. The receiver never needs to read sender messages in-context, so the system avoids auxiliary decoding, prefill, and cache expansion. Compared with latent-state transfer, TFlow does not require the receiver to interpret the sender’s hidden geometry directly. Sender states only serve as conditioning signals for a generator that outputs tensors already aligned with the receiver’s parameter shapes.

Several design choices matter. The method assumes a fixed receiver architecture and known target modules, which improves practicality but limits generality. It uses LoRA-style low-rank updates rather than full dynamic weights, keeping the generator output manageable. The perturbation is query-specific and transient, so there is no persistent online update. Finally, multi-sender interaction happens through parameter fusion rather than token-level deliberation, making the system closer to parallel conditional adaptation than iterative discussion.
summary_en.experiments:
The main setup is a three-agent system with a frozen Qwen3-4B backbone: two senders and one receiver. Evaluation spans five benchmarks covering reasoning, knowledge, and coding.

Against the standalone receiver, TFlow improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, with gains up to 8.5 points. This suggests that sender hidden states are being translated into useful computational bias rather than noise.

Against a text-based three-agent baseline, the efficiency gains are large: up to 83.27% fewer processed tokens and up to 4.6x lower wall-clock inference time. This is exactly where the method should win, since text communication pays both message generation and receiver-side reprocessing costs.

The paper also reports up to 32.69% fewer processed tokens relative to the standalone receiver. That is notable because it implies that some benefits of collaboration can be retained without paying for long explicit communication chains.

HumanEval+ is the main exception. TFlow is less competitive there, and the paper’s interpretation is sensible: code synthesis benefits more from extra generation budget and explicit externalized search than from compressed communication alone. This is an important boundary condition. Weight-space communication seems better suited to injecting distilled judgments into the receiver than to replacing long-form exploratory reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and Figures 1–2. They make the interface distinction clear: text communication, latent-state transfer, and weight-space perturbation. Then read the method section carefully, especially how sender hidden states are aggregated, how the parameter generator emits layer- and module-specific LoRA factors, and how those factors are injected into the receiver at inference time. That is the real technical core.

In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: TFlow vs standalone receiver, TFlow vs text-based multi-agent systems on efficiency, and the HumanEval+ failure case. The last one is especially useful because it shows where compressed communication stops being a good substitute for explicit reasoning traces.

If time is limited, about 30 minutes is enough to capture the main idea and results. If reading more deeply, focus on three questions: how generator capacity and injection depth affect performance, whether multi-sender fusion causes interference, and how receiver-specific this approach really is when moving to heterogeneous backbones or pretraining-time modular designs.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 ablation 就够；把 Agent 通信编译成临时 LoRA 很有想法，但固定 receiver 假设会限制外推。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and ablations; compiling agent communication into transient LoRA is interesting, but the fixed-receiver assumption limits generality.

paper.title: SOMA: Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving via Small Language Model
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-turn dialogue settings where preserving conversational context across turns is essential. A standard serving practice concatenates the full dialogue history at every turn, which reliably maintains coherence but incurs substantial cost in latency, memory, and API expenditure, especially when queries are routed to large proprietary models. Existing approaches often struggle to balance the trade-off between response quality and efficie

summary.core_problem: 多轮对话线上服务通常每一轮都要把全量历史拼回去给大模型，导致重复计算、延迟和成本随轮次线性上升；但直接把后续轮次交给小模型又会因早期上下文“定锚”而逐步漂移。论文要解决的是：在不每轮调用大模型、且不牺牲多轮一致性的前提下，让小模型在单个会话的“局部行为流形”上逼近大模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏系统/Serving 与会话内自适应蒸馏。价值点在于两件事：1）把“会话内分布是局部的”明确成可操作的建模假设（local manifold approximation），提供了一种 session-level 的轻量对齐思路；2）给出一个经验观察：多轮对话 token 分布呈长尾，早期轮次更长且信息密度更高，后期轮次更短但强依赖早期锚点——这对做长上下文训练数据配比、对话压缩/记忆模块的评估设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
SOMA（Soft-prompts for lOcal Manifold Approximation）是一个三阶段会话内适配框架，目标是用少量大模型调用，把小模型“拉到”当前会话诱导的局部区域。
1）Soft prompt tuning：在会话早期轮次上，为小模型学习软提示，刻意寻找能放大“小模型 vs 大模型”语义行为差异的方向（文中表述为最大化语义发散/behavioral divergence）。直觉是：先找到最容易出错、最能暴露差距的局部切向方向，后续对齐更高效。
2）Localized fine-tuning：用少量输入-输出对（由大模型在早期轮次产生/标注）对小模型做局部微调（文中提到 localized LoRA），让小模型在该会话的局部流形上模仿大模型。这里的关键取舍是“会话内局部拟合”而不是“全局蒸馏”：牺牲跨会话泛化，换取单会话的快速贴合与成本下降。
3）Efficient inference：推理阶段尽量做到 prompt-free（软提示/LoRA 已内化），并结合 extractive summary 来降低输入长度；同时用一个基于余弦相似度的 gate 做模型切换，并配 rollback 机制监测潜在 topic shift，一旦偏离局部区域就回退到大模型以保质量。
整体上它不是在压缩 KV-cache 或做 attention 复用，而是把“后续轮次的生成”转化为“会话内小模型对大模型的局部模仿问题”。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段未包含实验设置与具体数字（模型规模、数据集、成本节省比例、质量指标、消融等），因此无法基于全文复述关键结果。可从论文的实验部分重点核对：
- 质量：与全程大模型相比的胜率/偏好评测、以及多轮一致性指标（是否随轮次漂移）。
- 成本：大模型调用次数减少比例、端到端延迟、token 计费节省。
- 消融：仅路由到小模型 vs SOMA；无 soft-prompt 探索/无 localized LoRA/无 summary/无 rollback 的影响；gate 阈值敏感性。
- 长尾现象：不同域对话的 turn-level token 分布统计是否稳定，以及与性能/切换点的关系。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- Introduction：把“长尾 turn 分布 + 早期定锚”这个经验事实读清楚，这是方法成立的前提。
- 方法部分三阶段：重点看 soft prompt 如何定义“语义发散/最大差异方向”，以及 localized LoRA 的数据来源与预算（每会话需要多少大模型样本）。
- 推理策略：cosine gate 与 rollback 的触发条件，决定线上可控性。
- 实验：优先看成本-质量曲线与消融，判断它到底是“少量大模型调用换大幅节省”，还是把质量风险转移到回退机制上。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn chat serving commonly resends the full dialogue history to a large model at every turn, causing redundant compute, latency, and cost growth with conversation length. Simply handing later turns to a small model degrades coherence because early turns anchor the session and later turns depend heavily on that context. The paper targets session-level efficiency: adapt a small model to approximate a large model’s behavior within the local region induced by the early turns, so later turns can be served cheaply without losing consistency.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a serving/system paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is indirect: (1) it operationalizes a “session-local distribution/manifold” assumption and turns it into a lightweight, per-session alignment recipe; (2) it highlights an empirical long-tail pattern in turn-level token counts—early turns are long and information-dense, later turns are shorter yet more context-dependent—which can inform how we design dialogue pretraining mixes and how we evaluate memory/compression mechanisms beyond naive truncation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SOMA (Soft-prompts for lOcal Manifold Approximation) is a three-stage per-session adaptation pipeline.
1) Soft-prompt tuning: using early turns, learn soft prompts for the small model that intentionally expose directions where the small and large models diverge most in semantic behavior (maximizing behavioral/semantic divergence). The idea is to find the most diagnostic local directions before aligning.
2) Localized fine-tuning: collect a small set of input–output pairs from the large model in the early session and perform localized adaptation of the small model (via LoRA) to match the large model within this session-specific region. The key design choice is local, session-scoped fitting instead of global distillation.
3) Efficient inference: run the adapted small model in a prompt-free manner, feed it an extractive summary to reduce input length, and use a cosine-similarity gate to decide when to switch/rollback to the large model upon topic shift.
Overall, the method reframes multi-turn serving as session-level local imitation rather than cache reuse or generic routing.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section or any concrete numbers (model sizes, datasets, cost/latency reductions, win rates, ablations). As a result, no faithful quantitative summary can be produced from the given content. When reading the paper, verify: (i) quality vs full large-model baseline across turns (drift/coherence), (ii) reduction in large-model calls and token-billing savings, (iii) ablations for soft-prompt search / localized LoRA / summarization / rollback, and (iv) robustness of the reported long-tail turn-length statistics across domains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
- Intro: understand the empirical premise (turn-length long tail + early-turn anchoring).
- Method: focus on how “max semantic divergence” is defined/optimized for soft prompts, and the per-session budget (how many large-model samples are needed for LoRA).
- Inference control: cosine gate and rollback conditions—this determines operational risk.
- Experiments: prioritize cost–quality trade-off curves and ablations to see whether savings come from true small-model takeover or frequent fallbacks.

recommendation.zh: 思路比结果更值得看：把多轮会话当局部分布做在线小模型接管，这个 prior 值得记；先看 cost-quality 曲线和 topic drift 失败案例。
recommendation.en: The idea matters more than the numbers: treating a conversation as a local distribution for on-the-fly small-model takeover is a useful prior; inspect the cost-quality curves and topic-drift failures first.

paper.title: Unlocking UML Class Diagram Understanding in Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Although Vision Language Models (VLMs) have seen tremendous progress across all kinds of use cases, they still fall behind in answering questions regard-ing diagrams compared to photos. Although progress has been made in the area of bar charts, line charts and other diagrams like that there is still few research concerned with other types of diagrams, e.g. in the computer science domain. Our work presents a benchmark for visual question answering based on UML class diagrams which is both challen

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 在照片类任务上进展明显，但对 UML class diagram 这类结构化工程图的视觉问答能力仍不足，缺少可控且规模适中的评测与训练数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是窄域 VLM benchmark 和训练集。它对多模态基座研究的价值在于提示：图表/符号/关系结构理解与自然图像理解差异很大，通用 VLM 的能力不能直接外推到软件工程图。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 UML class diagram 视觉问答 benchmark，并生成 16,000 个 image-question-answer triples 作为训练数据；随后用 LoRA 对 VLM 做轻量微调，验证专门数据对结构化图理解的提升。
summary.experiments: 实验规模包括 16,000 条图像-问题-答案三元组。摘要称 LoRA 微调模型可以超过近期表现较好的 Qwen 3.5 27B VLM，但未给出具体指标、测试集划分或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hof University of Applied Sciences, Hof。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLMs perform much better on natural images than on structured diagrams, and UML class diagrams lack a compact but challenging VQA benchmark and training set.
summary_en.importance: This is a narrow VLM benchmark and dataset contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the reminder that diagram, symbol, and relation understanding do not transfer cleanly from natural-image competence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work builds a VQA benchmark for UML class diagrams and a dataset of 16,000 image-question-answer triples. It then applies LoRA-based fine-tuning to test whether targeted data improves structured diagram understanding.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 16,000 image-QA triples. The abstract reports that a LoRA-finetuned model outperforms Qwen 3.5 27B on this benchmark, but does not provide exact metrics, splits, or margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Hof University of Applied Sciences, Hof.

recommendation.zh: 窄域 benchmark，但能提醒 VLM 预训练别只看自然图像；扫数据构造和错误类型即可。
recommendation.en: A narrow benchmark, but it usefully warns against overreading natural-image VLM scores; skim the data construction and error cases.
