paper.title: PRISM: A Geometric Risk Bound that Decomposes Drift into Scale, Shape, and Head
paper.abstract: Comparing post-training LLM variants, such as quantized, LoRA-adapted, and distilled models, requires a diagnostic that identifies how a variant has drifted, not only whether it has degraded. Existing similarity scores such as CKA and SVCCA can flag degradation, but they do not directly link representation drift to risk or mechanism. We propose PRISM, Proxy Risk Inference via Structural Mapping, which exploits the linear output head of LLMs and the empirically near-isometric structure of their b

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想解决一个部署侧但对基座研究也有参考价值的问题：同一个 LLM 经过量化、LoRA 微调、蒸馏或头部修改后，如何不只判断性能是否下降，还能定位下降来自 backbone 表示的尺度漂移、几何形状扭曲，还是 lm_head 的偏移。
summary.importance: PRISM 的价值不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于把表示相似性和交叉熵风险差联系起来。对预训练研究员而言，它提供了一个可解释的模型漂移诊断框架，可用于分析 checkpoint 退火、continual pretrain、低比特训练/量化、LoRA 后遗忘，以及 head/backbone 是否协同漂移。贡献量级偏方法诊断工具，不是基座训练范式变化；但它把 CKA、SVCCA 这类单分数相似性指标推进到更接近风险和机制的位置。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是利用两个结构事实：LLM 通常由非线性 Transformer backbone 加一个线性 lm_head 构成；相关模型的隐藏表示在经验上常可近似通过正交变换对齐。PRISM 先在同一批输入上收集 target model 和 proxy model 的隐藏状态矩阵，再用正交 Procrustes 对齐两者表示。对齐后的误差被拆成两个 backbone 轴：RMS feature scale 的差异，即尺度项 Δρ；以及归一化表示几何的差异，即 shape mismatch 1-Ω。head 侧则用 proxy 表示协方差加权的 head discrepancy γ 衡量输出投影差异。理论上，它构造了 target 风险、proxy 风险和 hybrid 风险之间的三角分解，并用线性 head 推导交叉熵风险差上界。相比直接用 head 谱范数给 Lipschitz 常数，论文改用 token embedding pairwise distance 相关的常数，使词表很大时上界不至于完全失去信息。一个实用点是 frozen-head LoRA 场景下 head divergence 为零，shape 项可写成可微的 trace 形式，因此可作为微调正则，直接抑制 backbone 表示几何漂移。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Llama、Qwen，并在附录扩展到 Ministral、DeepSeek 变体，任务包括五个 benchmark。对 post-training quantization，PRISM bound 与真实性能退化的平均 Spearman 相关为 0.820；对 LoRA forgetting，平均 Spearman 相关为 0.831。轴级诊断也符合不同失效模式：低比特 PTQ，特别是 Q2/Q3，主要表现为 shape distortion；跨任务 LoRA 漂移会在 scale 轴上形成较强区分；部分 Qwen3 的 Q6_K/Q8_0 设置中，head divergence 明显增大。论文还把 shape mismatch 用作 LoRA 微调正则，在不依赖 replay 的情况下缓解遗忘，并在 aggregate 结果上优于 replay-based baseline。需要注意的是，这类 bound 更适合排序和定位，不应理解为逐样本风险的紧上界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 Theorem 1、hybrid risk 分解、Lipschitz 常数处理，以及 Procrustes residual 如何拆成 scale 和 shape。实验部分优先看 PTQ 与 LoRA 的 rank correlation 表、三轴诊断图，以及 Section 5.4 的 shape regularizer。若关注 continual pretrain 或模型合并后的漂移分析，可以深挖 Ω 的 trace 形式和 head discrepancy γ 的协方差加权设计；若只关心部署量化，读轴级 failure mode 分析即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a diagnostic problem for LLM variants: after quantization, LoRA adaptation, distillation, or head modification, how can one tell not only that the model degraded, but whether the drift came from activation scale, representation geometry, or the language modeling head.
summary_en.importance: PRISM is not a new pretraining method, but it is useful for studying model drift around the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It turns representation comparison into a proxy bound on cross-entropy risk, which makes it more actionable than scalar similarity metrics such as CKA or SVCCA. For pretraining researchers, the same decomposition can help inspect checkpoint annealing, continual pretraining, low-bit training or quantization, LoRA-induced forgetting, and head-backbone mismatch.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method relies on two structural assumptions that are often reasonable for related LLM checkpoints: a nonlinear Transformer backbone followed by a linear lm_head, and near-isometric hidden representations that can be aligned with an orthogonal map. PRISM collects hidden-state matrices from a target model and a proxy variant on shared inputs, aligns them through an orthogonal Procrustes map, and decomposes the feature residual into a scale term Δρ and a shape term 1-Ω. It adds a third term, γ, which measures head divergence weighted by the proxy feature covariance. The risk bound is derived through a hybrid-risk construction and a sharper cross-entropy Lipschitz argument for the linear head. Instead of using the full spectral norm of the head, which becomes loose at vocabulary scale, the paper ties the constant to pairwise token-embedding distances. In frozen-head LoRA, the head term vanishes, and the differentiable trace form of the shape term can be used directly as a regularizer against backbone drift.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover Llama and Qwen variants, with additional Ministral and DeepSeek results in the appendix, over five benchmarks. For post-training quantization, the PRISM bound reaches a mean Spearman correlation of 0.820 with observed degradation. For LoRA forgetting, the mean Spearman correlation is 0.831. The axes separate different failure modes: Q2/Q3 quantization mainly distorts representation shape; cross-task LoRA drift is strongly reflected in scale separability; some Qwen3 Q6_K/Q8_0 cases show increased head divergence. The shape-based regularizer also reduces forgetting under LoRA fine-tuning without replay and outperforms replay-based baselines in aggregate. The bound is best read as a ranking and localization tool rather than a tight absolute-risk estimator.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Focus on Section 3, especially Theorem 1, the hybrid-risk decomposition, the Lipschitz treatment of the lm_head, and the Procrustes residual split into scale and shape. In the experiments, prioritize the rank-correlation tables, the axis-level diagnostic plots, and Section 5.4 on the shape regularizer. Readers interested in continual pretraining or checkpoint drift should inspect the trace form of Ω and the covariance-weighted head term γ; readers focused on deployment quantization can mainly read the failure-mode analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式级工作，但如果你在做量化/蒸馏/LoRA 后的退化归因，读公式和误差分解就够了；它把“像不像”往“为什么坏”推进了一步。
recommendation.en: Not paradigm-shifting, but if you care about attribution after quantization, distillation, or LoRA, read the bound and the three-way decomposition; it moves beyond similarity scores toward mechanism.

paper.title: Beyond LoRA vs. Full Fine-Tuning: Gradient-Guided Optimizer Routing for LLM Adaptation
paper.abstract: Recent literature on fine-tuning Large Language Models highlights a fundamental debate. While Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) provides the representational plasticity required for high-entropy knowledge injection, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can match or surpass FFT performance because many tasks only require updates in a low-rank space and benefit from LoRA's additional regularization. Through empirical evaluation across diverse tasks (SQL, Medical QA, and Counterfactual Knowledge) and varying language m

summary.core_problem: 在不同任务与数据规模下，LoRA 与全参微调（FFT）各自有明显优势与失败模式，但现有方法通常只能“二选一”或用静态/逐层的 rank 调度去折中，导致要么容量不够（知识注入类任务），要么过拟合/遗忘（小数据或需要保守更新的任务）。论文要解决的是：能否在一次训练里，让同一个模型在“需要高容量时像 FFT、需要强正则时像 LoRA”之间连续切换，同时避免自适应 rank 带来的优化器冷启动与训练不稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不在“新预训练目标”，而在 pretrain→posttrain 接口：它把“更新子空间/更新容量”当作可路由的资源，用优化器统计量驱动更新稀疏化，给出了一个比固定 LoRA/FFT 更工程化的折中框架。对持续预训练/中期训练（mid-train）也有启发：当数据分布在阶段间变化时，可以用同一套路由机制在不同阶段自动选择更保守或更激进的更新方式，减少手工调参（尤其是 rank、lr、weight decay 的耦合）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MoLF（Mixture of LoRA and Full fine-tuning）：同时维护两个“专家”——一个是 FFT 专家（全参可更新），一个是 LoRA 专家（低秩增量）。关键点不是像 MoE 那样路由前向，而是“路由参数更新”：每一步前向/反向都让两个专家参与，从而两套参数/梯度统计量始终存在；随后用一个基于动量（momentum）与容量感知（capacity-aware）的专家打分函数，决定本步对哪些专家施加优化器更新（稀疏更新在 expert 级别）。这样做的动机是避免自适应 rank/动态插拔模块带来的 AdamW 状态冷启动（新参数没有二阶矩估计，容易抖动/尖峰），同时让两个专家都持续积累“全 batch”的梯度统计，训练更平滑。
MoLF-E 是内存受限版本：去掉 FFT 专家，改为在两个 LoRA 专家之间路由更新；仍保持“参数与优化器状态固定、只稀疏更新”的训练一致性，但牺牲了全参表达能力，换取显存占用更低。
论文在机制层面把 LoRA vs FFT 的争论拆成三个 regime，并用 SVD/截断误差（Eckart–Young–Mirsky）解释“知识注入类任务”为什么天然更吃高秩更新：当最优更新 ΔW* 的奇异值谱重尾时，rank-r 近似的尾部能量下界大，LoRA 会出现结构性容量瓶颈；但在有限数据下，提高 rank 又会削弱隐式谱正则，未必单调变好。这也解释了为什么“只追求更高 rank”并不可靠，路由式折中更合理。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 3 个底座（Gemma-3-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-3B）× 3 个任务族：CounterFact（事实/反事实知识注入）、MedMCQA（医学选择题）、Text-to-SQL（Gretel 合成）。对 FFT 与 LoRA 做了较完整的超参 sweep（学习率、scheduler、LoRA rank r∈{8,16,32,64,128}），并报告每个 setting 的最优结果，用来证明“不同任务/模型下最优方法与最优 rank 都会变”。结论层面：CounterFact 上 FFT 在所有模型上稳定优于 LoRA（容量瓶颈最明显）；而在另外两类任务上 LoRA 可能追平或超过 FFT（正则收益更大）。
MoLF 的总体表现是：在 9 个 setting 上，结果要么最好，要么落后于该 setting 的最强基线（FFT 或 LoRA）不超过约 1.5%（论文表述为 within 1.5%）。MoLF-E 在相近参数预算下优于已有自适应 rank 方法；文中给出在 Fact 任务上相对最弱基线超过 20% 的提升（这里更像是“相对提升”口径，具体绝对分数需要对照表格）。
从预训练研究者视角，更值得看的不是单点分数，而是：不同任务的谱形态/内在维度差异如何对应 LoRA/FFT 的胜负，以及 MoLF 的路由分数随训练推进如何在两个专家间迁移（是否出现早期偏 LoRA、后期偏 FFT 之类的阶段性）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 先看“Understanding Fine-Tuning Dynamics”这一节的三种 regime 划分与 SVD/截断误差的论证，重点是它如何把“LoRA 学得少/忘得少”与“LoRA 是低秩最优”统一到同一套谱视角下。
2) 再看 MoLF 的路由机制：专家打分函数用到了哪些优化器统计量（动量/二阶矩/梯度范数等）、如何做 capacity-aware 的归一化、更新稀疏化的粒度与频率。
3) 最后看表 1/主结果表与 MoLF-E 对比自适应 rank 方法的消融：关注在相同显存/可训练参数预算下，MoLF-E 是否只是“更稳”，还是确实在某些任务上改变了最优更新子空间。
如果只关心工程落地：优先看 MoLF 相比动态 rank 的“无冷启动”设计与训练稳定性描述（是否有 loss spike/梯度异常的统计）。

summary_en.core_problem: LoRA and full fine-tuning (FFT) win in different regimes: FFT is needed for high-entropy knowledge injection, while LoRA often generalizes better under limited data due to its implicit regularization. Existing approaches typically commit to one parameterization (or do static/dynamic rank tweaks), which cannot smoothly adapt update capacity to the task and can introduce optimizer-state cold starts. The paper targets a single training framework that can continuously trade off “capacity” vs “regularization” by routing *updates* (not forward computation) between LoRA-style and full-parameter experts, while keeping optimizer states stable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining objective, but it is relevant to the pretrain→post-train interface: it treats the update subspace as a controllable resource and uses optimizer statistics to decide where to spend update capacity. For mid-training / continual adaptation where data distributions shift across phases, the same idea suggests a way to reduce manual coupling between rank, LR schedules, and regularization by letting routing shift between conservative (LoRA-like) and expressive (FFT-like) updates.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MoLF (Mixture of LoRA and Full) maintains two experts during fine-tuning: an FFT expert (all weights trainable) and a LoRA expert (low-rank adapters). Unlike classic MoE, both experts participate in every forward/backward pass so their parameters and optimizer states remain present and continuously accumulate gradient statistics. After backprop, MoLF applies *sparse optimizer updates at the expert level* based on a momentum-based, capacity-aware scoring function—effectively routing the update budget between experts without changing parameter shapes.
A key design choice is avoiding adaptive-rank methods that “promote” ranks mid-training, which creates AdamW cold-start moments for newly introduced parameters (missing moment estimates), often destabilizing training. By keeping parameter space fixed and only sparsifying updates, MoLF aims for smoother dynamics.
MoLF-E is the memory-constrained variant: it drops the FFT expert and routes updates between two LoRA experts, preserving the fixed-state benefit while sacrificing full-parameter expressivity.
The paper also frames LoRA-vs-FFT regimes via the singular value spectrum of the optimal update ΔW*: for heavy-tailed spectra (knowledge injection), low-rank truncation has a large unavoidable tail-energy error (Eckart–Young–Mirsky), implying a structural capacity bottleneck for LoRA; for other tasks, the low-rank constraint can act as beneficial spectral regularization under finite data, so increasing rank is not guaranteed to help monotonically.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate 3 base models (Gemma-3-1B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B) on 3 task families: CounterFact (factual/counterfactual knowledge editing), MedMCQA, and synthetic Text-to-SQL (Gretel). FFT and LoRA are tuned with substantial sweeps (LR, schedulers, LoRA ranks r∈{8,16,32,64,128}), reporting per-setting best results to demonstrate that the optimal choice (FFT vs LoRA) and optimal rank vary widely.
Empirically, CounterFact consistently favors FFT across all models (clear LoRA capacity bottleneck), while other tasks can see LoRA match or exceed FFT (regularization advantage).
MoLF is reported to be either best or within ~1.5% of the best baseline (FFT or LoRA) across the 9 settings. MoLF-E, under comparable parameter budgets, outperforms adaptive-rank baselines; the paper claims >20% improvement on the Fact setting over the lowest-performing baseline (the exact absolute numbers require checking the main tables).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
1) Read the empirical “fine-tuning regimes” section first; focus on how spectrum shape / intrinsic dimension is used to reconcile conflicting LoRA-vs-FFT narratives.
2) Then read the MoLF routing mechanism carefully: what optimizer statistics are used, how capacity-awareness is implemented, and how often/at what granularity updates are sparsified.
3) Finally, inspect the main result tables and MoLF-E comparisons to adaptive-rank methods; look for evidence that fixed optimizer state (no cold start) improves stability (loss spikes, variance) beyond just average accuracy.
If you only care about practical adoption, prioritize the design rationale around fixed parameter/optimizer state and any stability diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 读 optimizer routing 设计和消融即可；它可能改进适配流程，但还没动到预训练目标。
recommendation.en: Read the optimizer-routing design and ablations; it may improve adaptation practice but does not yet change pretraining objectives.

paper.title: Rethinking Adapter Placement: A Dominant Adaptation Module Perspective
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that places trainable low-rank adapters into frozen pre-trained models. Recent studies show that using fewer LoRA adapters may still maintain or even improve performance, but existing methods still distribute adapters broadly, leaving where to place a limited number of adapters to maximize performance largely open. To investigate this, we introduce PAGE (Projected Adapter Gradient Energy), a gradient-based sensiti

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：如果 LoRA 预算极小，adapter 到底该放在哪一个模块上，而不是沿用“多层、多投影均匀铺开”的默认做法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身不是核心贡献，但对 post-train 与 continual adaptation 有明确启发。它给出一个可操作的 adapter placement 诊断方法：用冻结模型在目标数据上的梯度敏感性来预测 LoRA 初始化时能获得多少训练信号。值得关注的点不是 DomLoRA 省了多少参数，而是论文观察到适配信号高度集中在浅层 FFN down-projection，并且在同一 backbone 上跨任务稳定。这提示不同 Transformer 模块在可适配性上并不均匀，少量模块可能承担了更强的分布迁移入口作用。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是 PAGE，即 Projected Adapter Gradient Energy。作者先在未插入 LoRA、未训练的原模型上，对每个候选投影矩阵计算 sample-wise gradient，并用经验 Fisher 形式的平方梯度均值衡量模块敏感性。由于 LoRA 的低秩增量作用在同一个有效权重上，原权重梯度可以近似反映 LoRA 因子初始化时能接收到的梯度能量。第二步是 DomLoRA：只在 PAGE 最高的单个模块上放 LoRA，其余参数全部冻结。论文的主要观察是 PAGE 并不是平滑分布在多层 attention 或 FFN 上，而是集中到一个浅层 FFN down-projection。这个模块的具体层号依赖模型架构，但在同一模型上对 instruction following、数学、代码、多轮对话等任务保持稳定。与 AdaLoRA、DoRA 这类改变 LoRA 参数化或预算分配的方法不同，DomLoRA 主要改变 placement，且可以作为外层策略叠加到这些 LoRA 变体上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-8B 与 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 两个 8B 级模型，任务包括指令跟随、数学推理、代码生成和多轮对话。核心结果是：DomLoRA 只使用 vanilla LoRA 约 0.7% 的可训练参数，平均表现仍能与 vanilla LoRA 竞争，并在作者报告的平均指标上超过 vanilla LoRA。论文还把同样的单模块 placement 用到 AdaLoRA 和 DoRA 上，报告了平均性能提升。消融的重点是 PAGE 分布与任务稳定性：同一 backbone 的 dominant adaptation module 在不同下游任务上基本一致，而不同模型家族的层位置不同，说明它更像架构和预训练模型共同形成的结构属性，而不是某个任务数据的偶然结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分对 PAGE 的定义，以及 Figure 1 中 adapter placement 三种范式的对比和 PAGE 集中现象。实验部分优先看不同任务、不同 backbone 上 dominant module 是否稳定，以及 DomLoRA 与 vanilla LoRA、AdaLoRA、DoRA 的对比表。若关心 continual pretrain 或低成本领域适配，可以进一步看 sample-wise gradient 与经验 Fisher 的实现细节：它是否依赖 probe set 规模、loss mask、LoRA 初始化方式，以及是否会随训练阶段变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies where to place LoRA adapters when the adapter budget is extremely small, instead of following the common practice of spreading adapters across many layers and projection types.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to post-training and continual adaptation than to foundation pretraining itself. Its useful signal is a practical diagnostic for adapter placement: use gradients on the frozen model to estimate how much training signal a candidate LoRA module will receive at initialization. The notable observation is that this signal concentrates on a shallow FFN down-projection and stays stable across tasks for the same backbone. This suggests that adaptability is not evenly distributed across Transformer modules; a small number of modules may serve as stronger entry points for distributional adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts. PAGE, Projected Adapter Gradient Energy, computes sample-wise gradients of each pretrained projection weight on a probe set, then uses an empirical-Fisher-style squared-gradient average as a sensitivity measure. Since a LoRA update modifies the same effective weight through a low-rank perturbation, the gradient of the frozen weight approximates the initial gradient energy available to the LoRA factors. DomLoRA then places a single LoRA adapter on the module with the highest PAGE score and freezes all other parameters. The main finding is that PAGE is not smoothly distributed over attention and FFN projections. It is sharply concentrated on one shallow FFN down-projection. The layer index changes across model families but remains stable across downstream tasks on the same backbone. Unlike AdaLoRA or DoRA, which mainly alter LoRA parameterization or budget allocation, DomLoRA changes placement and can be combined with those variants.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, with tasks covering instruction following, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn dialogue. DomLoRA uses about 0.7% of the trainable parameters of vanilla LoRA, yet remains competitive and is reported to outperform vanilla LoRA on average. The same placement strategy is also applied to AdaLoRA and DoRA, where the paper reports average gains. The most useful ablations concern the PAGE distribution and task stability: the dominant adaptation module is largely unchanged across tasks for a fixed backbone, while its layer index differs across model families. This supports the view that the selected module reflects a property of the architecture and pretrained checkpoint, not just a peculiarity of a downstream dataset.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the PAGE definition and Figure 1, which contrasts broad adapter placement with the single dominant-module pattern. In the experiments, prioritize the tables comparing DomLoRA with vanilla LoRA, AdaLoRA, and DoRA, and the plots showing task stability of the dominant module. For continual pretraining or low-cost domain adaptation, the implementation details of the gradient probe are worth a closer look, especially probe-set size, loss masking, LoRA initialization, and whether the dominant module changes across training stages.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 PAGE 定义和模块热力图；单浅层 FFN 主导适配若复现，会改变低预算 LoRA 的默认放置策略。
recommendation.en: Read the PAGE definition and module heatmaps; if the shallow-FFN dominance replicates, it changes the default placement strategy for ultra-low-budget LoRA.

paper.title: Budgeted LoRA: Distillation as Structured Compute Allocation for Efficient Inference
paper.abstract: We study distillation for large language models under explicit compute constraints, with the goal of producing student models that are not only cheaper to train, but structurally efficient at inference time. While prior approaches to parameter-efficient distillation, such as LoRA, reduce adaptation cost, they leave the dense backbone unchanged and therefore fail to deliver meaningful inference savings. We propose Budgeted LoRA, a distillation framework that treats model compression as a structur

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类参数高效蒸馏只降低适配成本、但保留 dense backbone 导致推理成本几乎不降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和推理效率方法。它把蒸馏重新表述为结构化 compute allocation，而不是固定学生架构或简单插 LoRA，对“训练便宜”和“推理便宜”的区别讲得比较清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Budgeted LoRA，在全局计算预算下分配 dense 计算和低秩路径容量。核心组件包括 module-level dense retention coefficients、自适应 low-rank allocation，以及训练后压缩步骤；压缩时选择性移除、近似或保留 dense 组件，以得到不同计算预算下的学生模型族。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是在显式计算约束下获得结构上更省推理的学生模型，但截断信息未给出具体模型规模、任务、baseline、压缩率或性能提升数值。因此实验可信度需要读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ADAPT Centre 和 Dublin City University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in LoRA-style distillation: it reduces adaptation cost but usually leaves the dense backbone intact, so inference cost barely changes.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and compression contribution. Its useful framing is to treat distillation as structured compute allocation, separating cheap training from genuinely cheaper inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Budgeted LoRA introduces a global compute budget and allocates capacity across dense and low-rank paths. It uses module-level dense retention coefficients, adaptive low-rank allocation, and a post-training compression stage that removes, approximates, or preserves dense components.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states the goal and method but does not expose model sizes, tasks, baselines, compression ratios, or quality-speed trade-offs in the provided excerpt. The empirical strength has to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the ADAPT Centre and Dublin City University.

recommendation.zh: 想做推理压缩可看方法定义；缺少实验细节前，先把它当 LoRA 稀疏化思路而不是可靠 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth a methods skim for compression work; until the curves are visible, treat it as a LoRA-structured sparsification idea, not a recipe.

paper.title: GIFT: Guided Fine-Tuning and Transfer for Enhancing Instruction-Tuned Language Models
paper.abstract: A promising paradigm for adapting instruction-tuned language models is to learn task-specific updates on a pretrained base model and subsequently merge them into the instruction-tuned model. However, existing approaches typically treat the instruction-tuned model as a passive target that is only involved at the final merging stage, without guiding the training process. We propose GIFT (Guided Fine-Tuning and Transfer), a simple and efficient framework that incorporates guidance from the instruct

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 instruction-tuned 模型任务适配中的一个老问题：直接在 instruct 模型上做微调，容易破坏原有的指令跟随、泛化和平衡；而先在 base model 上学任务更新、再 merge 回 instruct 模型的路线，虽然更稳，但 instruction model 在训练阶段几乎没有参与，只在最后被动接收更新。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何让 instruction-tuned 模型在“更新学习阶段”就提供约束和指导，从而学到更适合后续 merge 的任务适配器，而不是等训练完再看能不能合并成功。
summary.importance: 它更偏 post-train / adaptation，而不是预训练本体，但和 pretrain-posttrain 接口关系很紧。对于基座研究员，这篇文章的启发在于：同一骨干网络的 base 与 instruct 版本之间，不只是参数空间相近，还可以形成一种 teacher-like guidance 关系，用来筛掉任务数据中的低价值 token、减少对风格性 token 的过拟合，并提升 merge compatibility。这个思路对持续预训练、mid-training、domain adaptation 都有借鉴意义，因为很多时候真正难的不是“学到新知识”，而是“学到后还能无缝回到原有能力平衡”。贡献量级属于实用型方法改进，不是范式变化，但设计比较干净，且实验覆盖了多模型族和多任务。
summary.technical_approach: GIFT 的核心做法是：在 pretrained base model 上训练 LoRA/低秩适配器，但训练损失不再对所有目标 token 一视同仁，而是用 instruction-tuned 模型给出的 token-level confidence 作为权重。具体流程分三步。第一步，固定 base model 和 instruction model，对监督数据集中的每个样本做一次 instruction model 前向，得到参考答案序列上每个 token 的条件概率或相应置信度分数 q_t。第二步，在 base model 上训练 adapter 时，用这些 q_t 重加权 token-level NLL，让 instruction model 低置信度的 token 对梯度贡献更小，高置信度 token 获得更大权重。作者的动机是，参考答案里有不少 token 只是表述习惯、格式或可替换措辞，并不承载核心任务知识；若强行让 base model 精确拟合这些 token，学到的更新会更噪、更难与 instruct 参数状态兼容。第三步，把训练好的 adapter merge 回 instruction-tuned 模型，得到任务专化后的 instruct 模型。与 Shadow-FT、Chat Vector、Re-Adapt 一类方法相比，GIFT 的差别不在 merge 算子，而在训练阶段显式利用了 instruction model 的知识来重分配学习信号。全文还强调，这种 guidance 是离线预计算的，只需对数据集跑一次 instruction model，因此额外成本可控。方法上可以把它理解为一种“由 instruct model 定义的 token importance weighting”，而不是蒸馏，因为目标仍是监督标签，不是直接拟合 teacher 分布。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学和医学问答两类任务，并在多个模型家族与尺度上验证。摘要里给出的主结果是：相对 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct，GIFT 在 Math500、Minerva Math、OlympiadBench、AIME 2024、AMC 2023 等数学基准上平均提升 5.2%，在医疗问答任务上提升 6.2%。从全文叙述看，作者比较了三类基线：一是直接在 instruct 模型上微调；二是标准的 base-train-then-merge 路线；三是已有 merge-based 方法如 Shadow-FT、Chat Vector 等。GIFT 的优势主要体现在两点：任务性能更高，以及 merge 后的通用指令能力保留更好。消融的关键观察通常会落在 token weighting 上：如果去掉 instruction confidence、退化成普通 SFT，或者改用不带指导的均匀权重，效果会下降；如果把权重来源换成模型自身而不是 instruction model，校准质量也较差。作者还强调，许多 reference token 是可替换的，指导信号能减少对这些 token 的过拟合，从而让 adapter 更“干净”。如果从研究角度看，最值得注意的实验不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是它试图证明：merge compatibility 可以通过训练信号设计来改善，而不是只能靠更复杂的参数组合技巧。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction，把它放到 Shadow-FT / Chat Vector 这条技术线上理解。然后直接读 Method，重点看 token importance q_t 的定义、加权损失的形式、以及这些分数为何选择离线预计算。接着看实验主表，确认它相对 direct FT 和 merge-based baseline 的收益是否稳定。泛读时最值得看的部分是消融：一，权重是否真的来自 instruction model 才有效；二，哪些 token 被压低权重；三，merge 后通用能力是否保住。若只想快速判断是否值得进一步跟进，读完方法图、主结果表和 token weighting 相关消融即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。
summary.authors_note: SUSTech NLP 团队工作；从文中公开仓库链接可确认机构为南方科技大学相关作者团队，摘要未完整给出作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical adaptation problem for instruction-tuned LLMs. Direct fine-tuning on the instruction model often damages the balance achieved by post-training, while the common alternative—training task updates on the pretrained base model and merging them back—treats the instruction model as a passive endpoint. The authors ask whether the instruction-tuned model can guide the learning stage itself, so that the resulting adapter is not only task-useful but also easier to merge back without harming general instruction-following behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training/adaptation paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. The useful idea is that the base model and its instruction-tuned counterpart are not just nearby checkpoints in parameter space; the instruction model can also provide a quality signal about which parts of supervised targets are worth learning. That matters for continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and mid-training-like settings where the challenge is not only acquiring new capability but preserving the original capability mix. The contribution is incremental rather than paradigm-shifting, but the method is clean, cheap, and experimentally broad enough to be practically interesting.
summary_en.technical_approach: GIFT trains a low-rank adapter on the pretrained base model, but replaces uniform token-level supervision with instruction-model-guided weighting. The pipeline has three stages. First, for each training pair, the instruction-tuned model runs once offline to produce token-level confidence scores q_t on the reference response. Second, these scores are used to reweight the token-level negative log-likelihood when training the adapter on the base model: tokens that the instruction model finds uncertain contribute less, while tokens it supports confidently contribute more. The motivation is that many target tokens are stylistic, formatting-related, or otherwise substitutable, and forcing the base model to fit them equally can inject noisy updates that later merge poorly into the instruction model. Third, the learned adapter is merged into the instruction-tuned model using a standard merge operator such as LoRA merging. Relative to Shadow-FT, Chat Vector, and related base-train-then-merge methods, the novelty is not in the merge rule but in using the instruction model during training to shape the learning signal. It is closer to token-importance weighting than to full distillation, since the target remains the supervised label sequence rather than the teacher distribution itself.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers mathematical reasoning and medical QA across multiple model families and scales. The headline result reported in the paper is an average gain of 5.2% over Llama3.1-8B-Instruct on math benchmarks including Math500, Minerva Math, OlympiadBench, AIME 2024, and AMC 2023, plus a 6.2% gain on medical QA tasks. The comparisons include direct fine-tuning on the instruction model, standard base-model adaptation followed by merging, and prior merge-based baselines such as Shadow-FT and Chat Vector. The main empirical claims are that GIFT improves task performance while better preserving general instruction-following ability after merging. The most informative ablations are those on token weighting: removing instruction-model guidance, reverting to uniform weighting, or using weaker confidence sources reduces the benefit. The paper’s more interesting claim is not just higher benchmark scores, but that merge compatibility can be improved by redesigning the training signal rather than only by changing parameter-combination heuristics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction to place the work in the Shadow-FT / Chat Vector line of adaptation methods, then go straight to the method section. Focus on how q_t is defined, how it enters the weighted loss, and why the confidence scores are computed offline. After that, inspect the main result tables to see whether gains are consistent across tasks and model families. If time is limited, the most useful parts are the ablations on weighting source and the analyses of general-capability retention after merging. A practical skim should take about 20–30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the SUSTech NLP group. The repository link in the paper points to a Southern University of Science and Technology team; the full author list is not recoverable from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 把“base 上学到的 LoRA”用 instruction 模型置信度做训练期约束，属于能立刻复现的工程招；重点看它的置信度定义与 ablation，别只信总分。
recommendation.en: A reproducible engineering trick: constrain base-trained LoRA with instruction-model confidence during training; focus on how confidence is defined and the ablations, not just headline gains.

institutions: Southern University of Science and Technology
Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

paper.title: REALM: An RGB and Event Aligned Latent Manifold for Cross-Modal Perception
paper.abstract: Event cameras provide several unique advantages over standard frame-based sensors, including high temporal resolution, low latency, and robustness to extreme lighting. However, existing learning-based approaches for event processing are typically confined to narrow, task-specific silos and lack the ability to generalize across modalities. We address this gap with REALM, a cross-modal framework that learns an RGB and Event Aligned Latent Manifold by projecting event representations into the pretr

summary.core_problem: 解决事件相机缺少大规模标注、模型任务割裂的问题，尝试把事件流对齐到 RGB foundation model 的潜空间中。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值不在事件视觉本身，而在一个常见命题：能否把弱资源模态投影到强资源模态的冻结表征空间，从而复用已有基础模型的几何与语义先验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 REALM，用 LoRA 将事件表示映射到预训练 ViT 的 latent space，冻结 RGB backbone，只学习跨模态桥接层；随后直接复用在 RGB 上训练好的线性头做下游任务迁移。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其在深度估计和语义分割等任务上验证了事件到 RGB latent 对齐的可行性，重点是 zero-/low-cost head transfer，而不是训练一个原生统一多模态模型。实验更像 modality adaptation proof-of-concept。
summary.authors_note: University of Toronto。作者包括 David B. Lindell、Jonathan Kelly，均在计算成像/机器人感知方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of large labeled event-camera datasets by aligning event representations to the latent space of pretrained RGB foundation models.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not event vision per se, but a broader question: whether a weak-data modality can be projected into the latent space of a strong-data modality to reuse frozen priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: REALM uses LoRA to map event representations into the latent space of a pretrained ViT, keeping the RGB backbone frozen and learning only the cross-modal bridge. Linear heads trained on RGB can then be transferred to event inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports results on tasks such as depth estimation and semantic segmentation, emphasizing head transfer after latent alignment rather than training a native unified multimodal model. The setup is mainly a modality-adaptation proof of concept.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Toronto. David B. Lindell and Jonathan Kelly are established researchers in computational imaging and robotic perception.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座论文，但“冻结强模态 backbone + 低秩桥接弱模态”这个配方值得记；看方法图和迁移设定即可，别过度外推到统一预训练。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but the recipe—freeze a strong-modality backbone and LoRA-bridge a weak modality—is worth noting; read the setup, not the hype.

paper.title: UniVidX: A Unified Multimodal Framework for Versatile Video Generation via Diffusion Priors
paper.abstract: Recent progress has shown that video diffusion models (VDMs) can be repurposed for diverse multimodal graphics tasks. However, existing methods often train separate models for each problem setting, which fixes the input-output mapping and limits the modeling of correlations across modalities. We present UniVidX, a unified multimodal framework that leverages VDM priors for versatile video generation. UniVidX formulates pixel-aligned tasks as conditional generation in a shared multimodal space, ad

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单一视频生成任务，而是一个更一般的问题：能否把多个像素对齐的视觉模态——例如 RGB、法线、反照率、光照、alpha、前景、背景——放进同一个视频扩散框架里，让任意一部分模态作为条件，另一部分作为目标，在一个模型内完成双向或多向生成。现有做法通常为每个映射单独训练模型，输入输出关系是固定的，既浪费预训练视频扩散先验，也容易在串行预测多模态时出现跨模态不一致。UniVidX 试图把这种“固定任务头”的范式改成“统一条件生成”的范式。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在于视频任务本身，而在于它展示了如何把一个已有的生成 backbone 改造成统一多模态条件模型，同时尽量不破坏原始先验。这里有三个值得注意的点。第一，它把多任务学习问题改写成随机条件划分问题，这和统一预训练里“任意子集条件化”的思路接近。第二，它没有用全量微调去硬适配不同模态，而是用按模态解耦、按目标激活的 LoRA，强调“适配分布差异”和“保留原生先验”之间的平衡。第三，它把跨模态一致性放到注意力结构里处理，而不是只靠损失函数约束。对做统一建模、跨模态 token 设计、AR+diffusion 联合预训练的人，这些设计都有参考价值。另一方面，这篇工作仍然是面向特定视觉模态栈的下游生成框架，不是通用 LLM 预训练方法，启发大于范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。1）SCM，Stochastic Condition Masking。训练时对一组对齐模态做随机划分，把一部分模态保留为 clean conditions，另一部分作为 noisy targets 走扩散去噪。这样同一个 T2V backbone 会反复见到 text-only、visual-only、text+visual 的不同条件组合，被迫学习从任意已知子集预测未知子集，而不是绑定某个固定映射。这个设计的关键不是简单 mask，而是把“任务定义”本身随机化，因此一个模型可以覆盖 Text→X、X→X、Text&X→X 三类范式。2）DGL，Decoupled Gated LoRA。不同模态分布差异很大，如果共享一套适配参数，容易互相干扰；如果全量微调，又会破坏原始视频扩散先验。作者为每个模态分配独立 LoRA，并且只在该模态是生成目标时激活对应 LoRA。条件模态不激活其 LoRA，尽量让 backbone 继续以原生先验处理输入。这个 gating 机制比“所有模态都走同一适配器”更克制，目标是把参数更新限制在真正需要建模该模态输出分布的位置。3）CMSA，Cross-Modal Self-Attention。作者在多模态交互层中让不同模态共享 key/value，但保留模态特定 query。直觉上，共享 K/V 让各模态访问同一组时空上下文，利于对齐；保留独立 Q 则允许每个模态以自己的统计特性去读取信息。相比完全独立注意力，它更强调联合生成时的密集交互；相比完全共享注意力，它保留了模态特异性。论文把这套框架实例化到两个场景：UniVid-Intrinsic 处理 RGB 与 intrinsic maps（albedo、irradiance、normal），UniVid-Alpha 处理 blended RGB、alpha、foreground、background。两者都建立在预训练视频扩散模型之上，通过有限数据做适配。
summary.experiments: 实验结论主要有三层。第一，任务覆盖面。两个实例一共支持 15 个任务，覆盖 Text→X、X→X、Text&X→X 三类生成范式。UniVid-Intrinsic 可做 text-to-intrinsic、inverse rendering、video relighting；UniVid-Alpha 可做 text-to-RGBA、video matting、video inpainting、前后景替换等。第二，数据效率。作者强调训练数据都少于 1k 视频，但仍能在 in-the-wild 场景上保持较强泛化，这一点说明预训练 VDM 先验被较好保留下来。第三，和专用模型比较时，统一模型在多个任务上达到与现有方法相当的结果，同时避免了串行多模态预测带来的不一致。就给出的全文片段看，具体 benchmark 数字、各任务指标和完整消融表没有展开到可逐项复述的程度，但从作者总结可确认：SCM、DGL、CMSA 都做了模块级验证，且 DGL 的作用主要体现在减少模态间参数干扰，CMSA 的作用主要体现在联合生成时的跨模态一致性，SCM 则决定了模型是否真正具备 omni-directional generation 能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Fig.1，先确认它到底统一了哪些任务，而不是把它误读成普通多任务微调。然后看 Method 里的三块：SCM 决定任务定义方式，DGL 决定参数适配边界，CMSA 决定模态交互结构。这三者分别对应“统一性、稳定性、一致性”。如果时间有限，优先看消融：去掉 SCM 后是否退化成固定映射模型；把 DGL 换成共享 LoRA 后性能和泛化如何变化；去掉 CMSA 后多模态堆栈是否更不一致。最后看应用案例，尤其是 relighting、retexturing、inpainting 这类需要多个模态共同成立的任务，因为这些例子最能体现统一生成是否真的学到了联合分布。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a broader problem than a single video generation task: whether a pretrained video diffusion backbone can be turned into a unified conditional generator over multiple pixel-aligned visual modalities, such as RGB, normals, albedo, irradiance, alpha, foreground, and background. Existing methods usually train one model per mapping, which hard-codes the input-output relation and often ignores the joint structure across modalities. UniVidX reframes this as subset-to-subset generation within one model, where any subset of modalities can serve as conditions and the rest as targets.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is not the specific graphics tasks, but the way it adapts a strong pretrained generative prior into a unified multimodal conditional model without fully overwriting that prior. Three ideas matter. First, it turns multitask learning into stochastic condition partitioning, which is close to the broader goal of arbitrary-subset conditioning in unified pretraining. Second, it uses modality-decoupled, target-activated LoRA instead of blunt full fine-tuning, making the trade-off between distribution adaptation and prior preservation explicit. Third, it handles cross-modal consistency inside the attention mechanism rather than relying only on auxiliary losses. This is more of a useful design pattern than a new pretraining paradigm, but it is relevant to unified modeling, multimodal token interfaces, and AR/diffusion-style joint modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three main components. (1) Stochastic Condition Masking, SCM. During training, the aligned modality set is randomly partitioned into clean conditions and noisy targets. The targets are generated through the diffusion denoising process, while the conditions are provided as observed inputs. This forces the same text-to-video backbone to handle text-only, visual-only, and hybrid conditioning, instead of specializing to a fixed mapping. The key point is that the task definition itself is randomized, so one model can cover Text→X, X→X, and Text&X→X. (2) Decoupled Gated LoRA, DGL. Different modalities have different output distributions. Sharing one adapter across them causes interference, while full fine-tuning risks damaging the pretrained video prior. The paper assigns an independent LoRA to each modality and activates it only when that modality is a generation target. Condition modalities do not trigger their LoRA branches. This keeps adaptation localized to the output side that actually needs distributional adjustment. (3) Cross-Modal Self-Attention, CMSA. The model shares keys and values across modalities while keeping modality-specific queries. Shared K/V encourages all modalities to read from a common spatiotemporal context, improving alignment; separate Q preserves modality-specific retrieval behavior. Compared with fully separate attention, this increases dense cross-modal interaction. Compared with fully shared attention, it retains modality specificity. The framework is instantiated in two domains: UniVid-Intrinsic for RGB plus intrinsic maps, and UniVid-Alpha for blended RGB, alpha, foreground, and background, both built on top of pretrained video diffusion models with limited adaptation data.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental story has three parts. First, task coverage. The two instantiations together support 15 tasks across three paradigms: Text→X, X→X, and Text&X→X. UniVid-Intrinsic handles text-to-intrinsic generation, inverse rendering, and video relighting; UniVid-Alpha handles text-to-RGBA, video matting, video inpainting, and foreground/background replacement. Second, data efficiency. The paper emphasizes training with fewer than 1k videos while still generalizing to in-the-wild scenarios, which suggests the pretrained video diffusion prior is largely preserved. Third, compared with specialized task-specific models, the unified model remains competitive across tasks while avoiding the inconsistency issues of serial multimodal prediction. The provided full-text excerpt does not include enough tables to reproduce exact benchmark numbers, but the paper clearly attributes the gains to module-level effects: SCM enables omni-directional generation, DGL reduces parameter interference across modalities, and CMSA improves cross-modal consistency in joint synthesis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand what is actually unified here; otherwise it is easy to misread the work as ordinary multitask fine-tuning. Then read the three method blocks in order: SCM defines the task family, DGL defines the adaptation boundary, and CMSA defines the interaction pattern. These correspond to unification, stability, and consistency. If reading time is limited, focus on the ablations: what happens when SCM is removed and the model falls back to fixed mappings; how shared LoRA compares with decoupled gated LoRA; and whether removing CMSA hurts consistency across jointly generated modality stacks. End with the application examples such as relighting, retexturing, and inpainting, because these are the clearest tests of whether the model learned a joint multimodal distribution rather than isolated mappings. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看训练掩码和 gated LoRA 设计；它把“任意条件生成”做成扩散版课程，值得和 Transfusion/Show-o 的统一建模对照。
recommendation.en: Read the masking schedule and gated-LoRA design; it is a diffusion-side curriculum for arbitrary conditional generation, worth comparing with Transfusion or Show-o.

paper.title: BoostLoRA: Growing Effective Rank by Boosting Adapters
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods face a tradeoff between adapter size and expressivity: ultra-low-parameter adapters are confined to fixed low-rank subspaces, capping performance even with extended training. We propose BoostLoRA, a gradient-boosting framework that overcomes this limit by iteratively training and merging minimal adapters on the examples the current model gets wrong. A ROTATE SVD basis strategy assigns each round to an orthogonal subspace, so cumulative effective ran

summary.core_problem: 如何在保持极低参数量（ultra-low-rank）的同时，提升 PEFT（参数高效微调）方法的表达能力，打破 adapter size 和性能之间的 trade-off？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于梯度提升（gradient-boosting）的 PEFT 框架，通过迭代训练和合并极低秩 adapter，实现了有效秩的线性增长而无推理开销，为资源受限下的高效微调提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BoostLoRA 框架：1) 迭代训练极小 adapter，专门拟合当前模型预测错误的样本（类似 boosting）；2) 采用 ROTATE SVD 基策略，将每轮训练分配到正交子空间，确保累积有效秩随轮数线性增长；3) 训练后合并 adapter 并丢弃，实现零推理开销。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-3B 上，BoostLoRA 在 GSM8K (89.1%) 和 MATH-500 (68.8%) 上超越了最佳单次极低参 adapter (TinyLoRA) 和全量微调；在代码生成任务 (MBPP 57.2%, HumanEval 80.4%) 上也表现优异，且展示了跨架构迁移能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the expressivity of PEFT methods while maintaining ultra-low parameter counts, breaking the trade-off between adapter size and performance?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a gradient-boosting-based PEFT framework that achieves linear growth in effective rank without inference overhead by iteratively training and merging ultra-low-rank adapters, offering a new approach for efficient fine-tuning under resource constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces BoostLoRA: 1) iteratively trains minimal adapters focusing on examples the current model gets wrong (boosting); 2) uses a ROTATE SVD basis strategy to assign each round to an orthogonal subspace, ensuring cumulative effective rank grows linearly; 3) merges and discards adapters post-training for zero inference overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen2.5-3B, BoostLoRA achieves 89.1% on GSM8K and 68.8% on MATH-500, surpassing the best single-shot ultra-low parameter adapter (TinyLoRA) and full fine-tuning. It also excels in code generation (MBPP 57.2%, HumanEval 80.4%) and demonstrates cross-architecture transfer.

recommendation.zh: 将 boosting 思想引入 LoRA 训练，通过正交子空间迭代累积有效秩，思路有趣但主要针对极低资源微调，作为 PEFT 变体备查。
recommendation.en: Introduces boosting to LoRA training, accumulating effective rank iteratively via orthogonal subspaces; an interesting PEFT variant for ultra-low resource settings, good to know as literature.

paper.title: Praxy Voice: Voice-Prompt Recovery + BUPS for Commercial-Class Indic TTS from a Frozen Non-Indic Base at Zero Commercial-Training-Data Cost
paper.abstract: Commercial TTS systems produce near-native Indic audio, but the best open-source bases (Chatterbox, Indic Parler-TTS, IndicF5) trail them on measured phonological dimensions, and the most widely adopted multilingual base (Chatterbox, 23 languages) does not even tokenise Telugu or Tamil. We ask: what is the minimum intervention that brings such a non-Indic-native base to commercial-class output on Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi, without training a new acoustic decoder and without any commercial TTS tra

summary.core_problem: 解决非 Indic 原生的冻结 TTS 基座在 Telugu、Tamil、Hindi 上无法直接建模脚本与口音的问题，目标是在不重训声学解码器、且不使用商业训练数据的前提下逼近商用品质。
summary.importance: 对语音 LM / TTS 方向有一点启发，主要在 tokenizer 与最小改造路径：当基座不覆盖目标书写系统时，是否能通过统一音素空间和轻量适配补齐。它不是通用语音基座论文，但对跨语言离散表示设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成：BUPS 把多种 Brahmic script 确定性转写到 ISO-15919，使原有 Latin tokenizer 可处理；只在文本 token predictor 上训练 LoRA，而非重训整个声学模型；再配合 voice-prompt recovery，用同语言参考音频和采样超参覆盖来恢复更自然的说话风格。
summary.experiments: 基于冻结的非 Indic base（摘要中以 Chatterbox 为主），在约 1,220 小时授权 Indic 音频上训练 text-side LoRA，覆盖 Telugu、Tamil、Hindi。摘要声称可达到 commercial-class output，但缺少更标准的跨模型对比、主观评测设计和误差分解，结论应谨慎看。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息较弱，摘要中提到 ElevenLabs、Cartesia Sonic-3、Sarvam Bulbul 等商业系统作为比较背景，但无法据此确认正式机构归属。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to adapt a frozen non-Indic TTS base model to Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi without retraining the acoustic decoder and without using commercial training data.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is modest but real for speech LM / TTS researchers, mainly around tokenizer and minimal-intervention adaptation: when the base model does not cover a target script, can a unified phoneme space plus lightweight adaptation close the gap?
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines three pieces: BUPS, which deterministically romanizes Brahmic scripts into ISO-15919 so the original Latin tokenizer can process them; a LoRA trained only on the text-token predictor rather than the full acoustic stack; and a voice-prompt recovery recipe using same-language reference audio plus sampling overrides to recover more natural style.
summary_en.experiments: Built on a frozen non-Indic base model (the abstract centers on Chatterbox), the method trains a text-side LoRA on about 1,220 hours of licensed Indic audio for Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi. The abstract claims commercial-class output, but the evidence appears less clean than a standard large-scale benchmark with strong subjective evaluation and detailed error analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: Author background is unclear. The abstract mentions commercial systems such as ElevenLabs, Cartesia Sonic-3, and Sarvam Bulbul as comparison points, but that is not enough to confirm institutional affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 只建议做语音 tokenizer/跨语言 TTS 的人扫一眼；思路是“先修表示再做最小适配”，但实验像 recipe note，多看方法少信 headline。
recommendation.en: Only worth a quick look if you work on speech tokenization or cross-lingual TTS; the useful idea is ‘fix representation first, then adapt minimally,’ but this reads more like a recipe note than a clean scientific study.

paper.title: Evaluation without Generation: Non-Generative Assessment of Harmful Model Specialization with Applications to CSAM
paper.abstract: Auditing the fine-tunes of open-weight generative models for harmful specialization has become a new governance challenge for model hosting platforms. The standard toolkit, generative evaluation via curated prompts or red-teaming, does not scale to platform-level auditing and breaks down entirely for domains like CSAM where generation is legally constrained. This motivates the Evaluation without Generation problem: assessing model capabilities without producing outputs. We argue that in such set

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个很实际的安全评估问题：在不能生成样本、甚至法律上不允许尝试生成样本的场景下，如何判断一个上传的 LoRA 是否把生成模型专门化到了 NSFW 或 CSAM 等有害内容方向。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对模型状态评估和 fine-tune 能力审计有启发。它把能力评估从输出空间转到参数和内部激活空间，说明模型的有害专门化可以通过“模型如何响应输入”来识别，而不一定要看生成结果。这个思路对开放权重生态、LoRA 分发平台、以及未来的非生成式安全评测都有参考价值。需要注意的是，它主要解决的是 LoRA 级别的筛查问题，不是通用的模型能力解释方法，也不能证明模型不存在某类能力。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Gaussian probing。做法不是给模型输入语义 prompt 并生成图片，而是向扩散模型输入随机 Gaussian 噪声，观察挂载 LoRA 后模型内部响应如何变化。LoRA 的作用被看作对基模型计算路径的函数性扰动；这些扰动会在中间层响应中留下可测量的签名。相比直接读取 LoRA 权重，Gaussian probing 更接近“这个 LoRA 如何改变模型计算”，因此对训练轮数、rank、文件格式、表面统计等浅层线索更不敏感。论文将这些响应特征用于分类，以判断 adaptor 是否表现出成人内容或 CSAM 相关专门化。方法的关键取舍是：牺牲对具体输出样貌的直接解释，换取可扩展、prompt-free、无生成的预分发筛查能力。
summary.experiments: 实验分为两个设置。第一类是受控实验，作者训练了 SFW 和 NSFW LoRA，覆盖不同数据集、风格、架构和训练条件，用来检验方法是否能识别真实的内容专门化，而不是只抓住某个训练配置。第二类是更接近部署的自然分布实验，LoRA 来自 CivitAI 等公开平台，并包含通过授权渠道获得、按法律要求处理的 CSAM LoRA。结果显示，Gaussian probing 能较稳定地区分 NSFW 和 CSAM 相关专门化，并且比 raw-weight baseline 更不容易依赖表面训练痕迹。文中还强调了部署背景：CivitAI 级别的平台每月可能有数十万 LoRA 上传，NCMEC 2024 年收到 67,000 起 AI 生成 CSAM 报告，高于 2023 年的 4,700 起。这些数字说明输出审查难以作为唯一机制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。建议重点看 Introduction 中对 Evaluation without Generation 的问题定义，以及 Problem Formulation 中对“能力并非 LoRA 孤立属性”的讨论。方法部分要看 Gaussian probing 如何构造随机输入、选择内部响应、形成特征。实验部分重点看受控实验和自然分布实验的差异，以及 raw-weight baseline 为什么会被训练 artifact 误导。局限性部分也应看：该方法适合作为筛查信号，不应被理解成法律或政策层面的最终判定器。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a platform can assess harmful specialization in an uploaded LoRA without generating any outputs, especially in settings such as CSAM where generation-based evaluation is legally and ethically constrained.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to model-state auditing. It reframes capability assessment as inference from parameters and internal computation rather than from generated samples. This is useful for open-weight ecosystems where lightweight adapters are distributed at scale. The result should be read as a screening mechanism for LoRA specialization, not as a general proof of absence of harmful capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main method is Gaussian probing. Instead of prompting the adapted diffusion model and inspecting images, the method feeds random Gaussian inputs and measures how the LoRA changes internal model responses. The LoRA is treated as a functional perturbation of the base model, and the resulting activation signatures are used for classification. This differs from raw-weight inspection because it measures the computational effect of the adapter, not only superficial statistics of the adapter file. The tradeoff is clear: the method gives up direct semantic inspection of generated outputs, but gains scalable, prompt-free, non-generative pre-distribution screening.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation has two regimes. In controlled experiments, the authors train SFW and NSFW LoRAs under varied datasets, styles, architectures, and training conditions to test whether the probe captures content specialization rather than training artifacts. In a naturalistic setting, they evaluate LoRAs collected from public platforms such as CivitAI, together with legally accessed CSAM-related LoRAs handled through authorized entities. Gaussian probing reliably detects NSFW and CSAM specialization and is reported to be more robust than raw-weight baselines under heterogeneous and noisy deployment-like conditions. The motivation is grounded in scale: CivitAI-scale platforms may receive hundreds of thousands of LoRAs in a month, and NCMEC reported 67,000 AI-generated CSAM reports in 2024, up from 4,700 in 2023.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation, because the paper is careful about what a harmful capability means for an adapter. Then read the Gaussian probing method to see how random inputs and internal responses are converted into a specialization signature. In the experiments, compare the controlled setup with the naturalistic platform setting, and look for where raw-weight baselines fail. The limitations matter: this is a triage signal for platform governance, not a final legal or policy judgment.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain 范式，但它在提醒一件事：LoRA 改变能力可先看表征再看输出；先读方法和消融，若跨模型稳，再考虑纳入内部审计工具链。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but it makes a useful point: LoRA-induced capability shifts may be visible in representations before outputs; read the method and ablations first, then judge whether it belongs in your audit stack.

paper.title: Aligned Multi-View Scripts for Universal Chart-to-Code Generation
paper.abstract: Chart-to-code generation converts a chart image into an executable plotting script, enabling faithful reproduction and editable visualizations. Existing methods are largely Python-centric, limiting practical use and overlooking a critical source of supervision: the same chart can be expressed by semantically equivalent scripts in different plotting languages. To fill this gap, we introduce Chart2NCode, a dataset of 176K charts paired with aligned scripts in Python, R, and LaTeX that render visua

summary.core_problem: 解决 chart image 到可执行绘图代码生成时过度依赖 Python、缺少多语言等价监督的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据和轻量适配方法：Chart2NCode 提供 176K 图表及 Python、R、LaTeX 对齐脚本，能支持更贴近实际编辑需求的 chart-to-code 评测与训练。
summary.technical_approach: 数据侧用 metadata-to-template 流水线生成多语言脚本，并通过渲染验证和人工质检保证视觉等价；模型侧基于 LLaVA 风格架构，提出 CharLuMA，在多模态 projector 上加入语言条件的低秩子空间混合，让共享视觉理解和目标绘图库/语言专门化解耦。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，但未给出完整模型规模、训练 token、baseline 名称或提升幅度；可确认的是任务覆盖 Python、R、LaTeX 三种输出语言，并围绕视觉等价的 chart reproduction 评估。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore Management University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets chart-to-code generation beyond Python-only settings, where the same chart should be reproducible as executable scripts in multiple plotting languages.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a dataset and adaptation contribution: Chart2NCode contains 176K charts aligned with visually equivalent Python, R, and LaTeX scripts, enabling multi-language supervision for editable chart reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built with a metadata-to-template pipeline, rendering verification, and human quality checks. The model, CharLuMA, follows a LLaVA-style design and adds a language-conditioned mixture of low-rank subspaces to the multimodal projector, sharing chart understanding while routing generation toward the target language.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments but does not expose model sizes, data scale beyond the dataset, named baselines, or numeric gains. The confirmed setup evaluates chart reproduction across Python, R, and LaTeX.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Singapore Management University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 到结构化代码输出的数据点可扫，CharLuMA 更像任务适配模块，不会改变预训练侧 prior。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a VLM-to-structured-code data point; CharLuMA is task adaptation rather than a pretraining-level idea.

paper.title: The Override Gap: A Magnitude Account of Knowledge Conflict Failure in Hypernetwork-Based Instant LLM Adaptation
paper.abstract: Hypernetwork-based methods such as Doc-to-LoRA internalize a document into an LLM's weights in a single forward pass, but they fail systematically on conflicts: when the document contradicts pretraining knowledge, accuracy collapses to 46.4% on the deepest facts. We show the failure is a magnitude problem rather than a representational one. The hypernetwork already targets the right layers, but its adapter margin is approximately constant across documents while the pretrained margin grows with t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 hypernetwork 生成 LoRA adapter 的“即时知识内化”方法为什么难以覆盖模型已有知识。核心问题不是模型找不到文档信息，而是在文档事实与预训练事实冲突时，生成的 adapter 信号强度不足，无法压过基座模型中更强的参数化知识先验。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“知识更新失败”拆成了一个可测量的 margin 竞争问题。预训练阶段出现频率越高、被模型编码越深的事实，在推理时形成的 pretrained margin 越大；如果后续 adapter 或 hypernetwork 写入的更新幅度不随先验强度调整，就会系统性失败。这对 continual pretrain、模型编辑、参数化记忆评测都有参考意义：评估新知识注入时，不能只看新事实 recall，还要按原有知识强度分层看 override 能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三部分。第一，作者提出 magnitude account：回答冲突问题时，输出旧答案还是新答案取决于 pretrained margin 与 adapter margin 的大小。hypernetwork 训练时主要学习无冲突文档重建，因此生成的 LoRA adapter margin 在不同文档上近似恒定；而基座模型对旧事实的 margin 会随训练语料频率和事实熟悉度增加。于是深层冲突不是表征错位，而是强度不够。第二，Selective Layer Boosting 直接放大 hypernetwork 已经生成的 LoRA 矩阵，优先放大范数最高的层，因为这些层携带最多文档特定信号。它不重新训练 hypernetwork，也不盲目放大全层，避免破坏普通 recall。第三，Conflict-Aware Internalization 先用轻量 base-model probe 判断问题是否存在强先验冲突，只在检测到冲突时采用更强 boost。作者还构建 KID-Bench，将评测拆成 novel recall、cross-knowledge combination，以及按 prior strength 分层的 conflict override。
summary.experiments: 关键结果围绕 KID-Bench 展开。该 benchmark 包含 489 个问题，其中 194 个冲突样例按基座模型对旧事实的 log-probability 衡量 prior strength。基线在弱先验冲突上的准确率约 68%，在强先验冲突上降到 16%，差距为 52 个百分点，支持“先验越强越难覆盖”的解释。按事实深度划分时，当前即时内化方法在 easy、moderate、deep conflicts 上大约从 58%、56% 降到 46.4%。在 Gemma-2B backbone、hypernetwork 训练 80K steps 的设置下，方法将 deep conflict accuracy 从 46.4% 提到 71.0%，同时 novel recall 保持在 97.1%。在 medium conflicts 上，比 RAG 高 18 个百分点，但不把文档保留在上下文中。Mistral-7B 上也有类似趋势，conflict accuracy 从 53.6% 提到 72.5%。Selective Layer Boosting 的额外延迟低于 2%；Conflict-Aware 方法额外需要一次短的 base model forward。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一是 introduction 中对 failure mode 的定义，尤其是 pretrained margin 与 adapter margin 的解释；第二是理论/分析部分，确认作者如何用 base-model log-probability 度量 prior strength，以及如何证明 hypernetwork 已经定位到相关层但幅度不足；第三是实验表和 KID-Bench 设计，尤其要看 conflict 分层、novel recall 是否被 boost 破坏、以及 RAG 对照是否公平。若关注模型编辑或 continual update，可以细读 Selective Layer Boosting 的层选择规则，它提供了一个简单但有诊断价值的干预方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why hypernetwork-generated LoRA adapters for instant knowledge internalization fail when a document contradicts knowledge already encoded in the base model. The failure is framed as an insufficient intervention magnitude rather than an inability to represent or locate the new fact.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution for pretraining research is the margin-based view of parametric knowledge conflicts. Facts seen more often during pretraining induce stronger pretrained margins. If a post-hoc adapter writes an update with roughly fixed strength, it will lose against deeply encoded facts. This is relevant to continual pretraining, model editing, and knowledge-update evaluation: new-fact recall is not enough; override performance must be stratified by the strength of the old prior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper has three main components. First, it proposes a magnitude account: conflict resolution is a competition between the pretrained margin for the old answer and the adapter margin written by the hypernetwork. Since the hypernetwork is trained mostly to reconstruct non-conflicting documents, its adapter margin stays approximately constant across documents, while the pretrained margin grows with fact frequency and familiarity. Second, Selective Layer Boosting scales the generated LoRA matrices at layers with the largest generated norms, amplifying the layers that already contain the strongest document-specific signal instead of boosting all layers. Third, Conflict-Aware Internalization uses a lightweight probe of the base model to detect likely prior conflicts and applies stronger boosting only when needed. The paper also introduces KID-Bench, which separates novel recall, cross-knowledge combination, and conflict cases grouped by prior strength.
summary_en.experiments: The main benchmark is KID-Bench with 489 questions, including 194 conflict cases sorted by the base model’s log-probability on the contradicted fact. Baseline accuracy drops from about 68% on weak-prior conflicts to 16% on strong-prior conflicts, a 52-point gap. Across easy, moderate, and deep conflicts, instant internalization accuracy falls to around 58%, 56%, and 46.4%. On Gemma-2B with 80K hypernetwork training steps, the proposed methods improve deep-conflict accuracy from 46.4% to 71.0% while keeping novel recall at 97.1%. On medium conflicts, they are reported to exceed retrieval-augmented generation by 18 points without keeping the document in context. On Mistral-7B, conflict accuracy rises from 53.6% to 72.5%. Selective Layer Boosting adds less than 2% latency, while the conflict-aware variant adds one short base-model forward pass.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on the failure analysis in the introduction, the sections defining pretrained and adapter margins, and the experiments that stratify conflicts by base-model prior strength. The most useful diagnostic details are how the paper measures prior strength using base-model log-probability, why layer targeting is not the main failure, and whether boosting hurts novel recall. Readers working on model editing or continual updates should spend extra time on the layer-selection rule in Selective Layer Boosting.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新范式，但把“知识编辑失败”拆成可测的 margin 问题很干净；只看先验强度分桶实验和 selective boosting 就够，值得拿去审视你们的 adapter 写入幅度。
recommendation.en: Not a new paradigm, but it cleanly turns knowledge-edit failure into a measurable margin problem; read the prior-strength stratification and selective boosting, then audit your own adapter write amplitudes.

paper.title: Where Should LoRA Go? Component-Type Placement in Hybrid Language Models
paper.abstract: Hybrid language models that interleave attention with recurrent components are increasingly competitive with pure Transformers, yet standard LoRA practice applies adapters uniformly without considering the distinct functional roles of each component type. We systematically study component-type LoRA placement across two hybrid architectures -- Qwen3.5-0.8B (sequential, GatedDeltaNet + softmax attention) and Falcon-H1-0.5B (parallel, Mamba-2 SSM + attention) -- fine-tuned on three domains and eval

summary.core_problem: 它研究混合语言模型里 LoRA 不该默认全层均匀插入，而应按组件类型区分：attention、SSM、recurrent 分支到底该放在哪里。
summary.importance: 这是一个参数高效微调研究，但对新型 backbone 的预训练研究员也有一点参考价值，因为它揭示了 hybrid 架构中不同组件的功能分工和可塑性并不对称。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较 component-type LoRA placement，在两类 hybrid LM 上做实验：顺序式 Qwen3.5-0.8B（GatedDeltaNet + softmax attention）和并行式 Falcon-H1-0.5B（Mamba-2 SSM + attention）。核心做法是分别只适配 attention 路径、只适配 recurrent/SSM 路径或全模型适配，并观察跨任务迁移与遗忘。
summary.experiments: 模型包括 Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 Falcon-H1-0.5B，覆盖三个领域微调、五个 benchmark。结果显示 attention 路径虽然参数占比更小，却稳定优于 full-model adaptation，且只需 5-10 倍更少可训练参数；顺序式 hybrid 中适配 recurrent backbone 会明显伤害性能，在 GSM8K 上可达 -14.8pp，而并行式 hybrid 中则可能带来 +8.6pp 增益；并行式结构还表现出更好的跨任务正迁移，顺序式则更易灾难遗忘。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies where LoRA should be placed in hybrid language models, arguing that adapter placement should depend on component type rather than being applied uniformly across attention and recurrent/SSM blocks.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a parameter-efficient fine-tuning paper, but it has some value for pretraining researchers because it reveals asymmetric plasticity and functional roles across components in hybrid backbones.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically compare component-type LoRA placement on two hybrid LMs: sequential Qwen3.5-0.8B (GatedDeltaNet plus softmax attention) and parallel Falcon-H1-0.5B (Mamba-2 SSM plus attention). They test attention-only, recurrent/SSM-only, and full-model adaptation, and analyze transfer and forgetting.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses Qwen3.5-0.8B and Falcon-H1-0.5B, fine-tuned on three domains and evaluated on five benchmarks. Attention-only adaptation consistently beats full-model adaptation with 5-10x fewer trainable parameters. Adapting the recurrent backbone is harmful in sequential hybrids, including a -14.8 point drop on GSM8K, but helpful in parallel hybrids, with gains up to +8.6 points. Parallel hybrids also show more positive cross-task transfer, while sequential hybrids suffer more catastrophic forgetting.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但如果你在看 hybrid backbone 的功能分工，只读结果表和 sequential vs parallel 的对比就够了；LoRA 结论别直接外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but useful if you care about hybrid backbones: read the result tables and the sequential-vs-parallel comparison, and do not overgeneralize the LoRA findings to pretraining.

paper.title: Sub-Token Routing in LoRA for Adaptation and Query-Aware KV Compression
paper.abstract: Sub-token routing offers a finer control axis for transformer efficiency than the coarse units used in most prior work, such as tokens, pages, heads, or layers. In this paper, we study routing within a token representation itself in LoRA-adapted transformers. The motivation is that a relevant token need not be internally uniform: under a retention budget, preserved value groups are distributed unevenly both across tokens and within tokens, which suggests that KV compression need not be an all-or

summary.core_problem: 解决 KV 压缩过于粗粒度的问题：现有方法通常按 token、head、layer 做保留或丢弃，忽略了单个 token 内部不同子空间的重要性差异。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的细粒度改进。对预训练研究员的价值不在 LoRA 本身，而在于它提出一个值得注意的观察：token relevance 不是内部均匀的，KV 保留可以细化到 value-group 或子 token 级别。这对未来做表示稀疏化、分组路由和训练时结构先验可能有启发，但目前仍偏 inference engineering。
summary.technical_approach: 论文研究 LoRA 适配 Transformer 中的 sub-token routing。作者在两个场景下设计机制：一是 compression-aware language modeling，采用 query-independent 的 routed subspace LoRA，并在 KV 路径上做 value-group routing；二是 downstream-task-preserving KV compression，引入 query-aware 的 predictor-based selector，在全局预算下对 context-token/value-group 对进行条件化选择。核心思想是把“保留整个 token 的 KV”改成“只保留 token 内部更有用的值组”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、上下文长度、压缩率和提升幅度。实验应覆盖语言建模与下游任务保持两类设置，并与 token-level、head-level 或 page-level KV compression 基线比较。由于缺少数字，这篇更适合作为思路备查：先看是否在相同 retention budget 下稳定优于 token-level 方法，再决定是否值得深入。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Futurewei。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the coarse granularity of existing KV compression methods, arguing that token-level keep/drop decisions ignore heterogeneous importance within a token representation.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency paper with a fine-grained routing angle. For pretraining researchers, the main value is not LoRA adaptation itself but the observation that token relevance is internally non-uniform, suggesting that KV retention can be done at the value-group or sub-token level. That could inform future structured sparsity or routing priors, though the current work is still mostly inference engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper studies sub-token routing in LoRA-adapted transformers. In compression-aware language modeling, it uses a query-independent design with routed subspace LoRA plus value-group routing on the KV path. In downstream-task-preserving KV compression, it uses a query-aware predictor-based selector that allocates a global retention budget over context-token/value-group pairs. The key move is to replace whole-token KV retention with selective preservation of more useful internal value groups.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, context lengths, compression ratios, or exact gains. The experiments likely cover both language modeling and downstream preservation settings, compared against token-level, head-level, or page-level KV compression baselines. Given the lack of numbers, this is best treated as an idea paper unless the full results show clean gains under matched retention budgets.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Futurewei.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“token 内部不均匀重要性”这个观察值得记下；只看方法图和压缩率对比表，若预算对齐后仍赢，再考虑借到训练期稀疏化里。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the non-uniform importance within a token is the part worth keeping; read the method figure and the budget-matched compression table, then decide whether it is transferable to training-time sparsity.

paper.title: Low-Rank Adaptation Redux for Large Models
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the de facto standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of foundation models, enabling the adaptation of billion-parameter networks with minimal computational and memory overhead. Despite its empirical success and rapid proliferation of variants, it remains elusive which architectural choices, optimization techniques, and deployment constraints should guide practical method selection. This overview revisits LoRA through the lens of signal proces

summary.core_problem: 梳理 LoRA 及其变体在大模型参数高效微调中的设计选择、优化机制和部署约束，解释为什么这些方法有效。
summary.importance: 这是综述/观点型工作，不提出新的预训练方法，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有一定参考价值，尤其是理解低秩更新、内存瓶颈和适配器设计空间。
summary.technical_approach: 从信号处理视角重述 LoRA，将现有方法按架构设计、效率与系统约束、理论机制等轴线组织，试图用经典低秩建模与逆问题工具解释现代 PEFT 方案。
summary.experiments: 不是实证主导论文，摘要明确说明不做全面枚举和统一实验比较，因此不应期待新的 SOTA 或干净 benchmark；价值主要在框架化整理与机制解释。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Georgios B. Giannakis，其在信号处理与优化领域较有代表性；这篇文章更像面向 SP 社区的 LoRA 技术综述。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits LoRA and related PEFT methods for large models, aiming to clarify which design choices, optimization mechanisms, and deployment constraints matter in practice.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey/opinion-style paper rather than a new pretraining method. It is still mildly relevant at the pretrain–post-train interface, especially for understanding low-rank updates, memory bottlenecks, and the adapter design space.
summary_en.technical_approach: It reframes LoRA from a signal-processing perspective, organizing existing methods along axes such as architectural design, efficiency and system constraints, and theoretical mechanisms, while connecting them to classical low-rank modeling and inverse problems.
summary_en.experiments: This is not an empirically driven paper. The abstract explicitly says it does not aim for exhaustive empirical comparison, so one should not expect new SOTA or a clean benchmark. The value is in conceptual organization and mechanism-level interpretation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Georgios B. Giannakis, a well-known researcher in signal processing and optimization. The piece reads as a technical overview of LoRA aimed partly at the SP community.

recommendation.zh: 综述味很重，没有新实验结论；只在你要系统梳理 adapter 设计空间时有用，正文挑机制部分翻即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly a conceptual LoRA overview with little new evidence; useful only if you want a structured map of adapter design choices rather than new results.

offer new research lines benefiting the SP community in return
